5.106.m: Likewise, a dreadful time born of the Kali age will arrive; / then the sacred fields and sacred fords will perish on the surface of the earth.

5.106.s:
sattīrthaistadbhayātsarvaiḥ kṣetrametatsamāśritam ..
ānayiṣyāmyahamapi svāni kṣetrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ ..52..
5.106.d:
सत्तीर्थैस्तद्भयात्सर्वैः क्षेत्रमेतत्समाश्रितम् ..
आनयिष्याम्यहमपि स्वानि क्षेत्राणि कृत्स्नशः ..52..
5.106.m: Through fear of that, this sacred field has been resorted to by all the true sacred fords; / I too shall bring my own sacred fields here in their entirety.'

5.106.s:
tatastaṃ citraśarmāṇaṃ prāha cedaṃ maheśvaraḥ ..
śṛṇu madvacanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kuruṣva tadanaṃtaram .. 53 ..
5.106.d:
ततस्तं चित्रशर्माणं प्राह चेदं महेश्वरः ..
शृणु मद्वचनं कृत्स्नं कुरुष्व तदनंतरम् .. 53 ..
5.106.m: Then Maheśvara spoke thus to Citraśarman: / "Listen to all my words, and then act accordingly.

5.106.s:
atra kṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi madīyāni dvijottama ..
samāgacchaṃtu viprāśca prabhavaṃtu praharṣitāḥ .. 54 ..
5.106.d:
अत्र क्षेत्राणि सर्वाणि मदीयानि द्विजोत्तम ..
समागच्छंतु विप्राश्च प्रभवंतु प्रहर्षिताः .. 54 ..
5.106.m: O best of the twice-born, let all my sacred fields arrive here, / and let the brahmins have dominion, delighted.

5.106.s:
tavāpi yogyatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kariṣyāmi mahāmate ..
yadi me vartase vākye muktvā sparddhāṃ dvijodbhavām .. 55 ..
5.106.d:
तवापि योग्यतां श्रेष्ठां करिष्यामि महामते ..
यदि मे वर्तसे वाक्ये मुक्त्वा स्पर्द्धां द्विजोद्भवाम् .. 55 ..
5.106.m: I shall also grant you the highest distinction, O wise one, / if you abide by my instruction, abandoning this rivalry with the twice-born.

5.106.s:
turīyamapi te gotraṃ vedoktena krameṇa ca ..
ādyatāṃ cāpi te sarve kīrtayiṣyaṃti te dvijāḥ .. 56 ..
5.106.d:
तुरीयमपि ते गोत्रं वेदोक्तेन क्रमेण च ..
आद्यतां चापि ते सर्वे कीर्तयिष्यंति ते द्विजाः .. 56 ..
5.106.m: Even though your gotra is the fourth, according to the order declared in the Vedas, / all those twice-born will proclaim your primacy.

5.106.s:
tathānyadapi sanmānaṃ tava yacchāmi ca dvija ..
ācandrārkamasaṃdigdhaṃ putrapautrādikaṃ ca yat .. 57 ..
5.106.d:
तथान्यदपि सन्मानं तव यच्छामि च द्विज ..
आचन्द्रार्कमसंदिग्धं पुत्रपौत्रादिकं च यत् .. 57 ..
5.106.m: Likewise, O twice-born, I grant you another honor, / without doubt, enduring as long as the moon and the sun, for your sons, grandsons, and descendants:

5.106.s:
tvadanvaye bhaviṣyaṃti putrapautrāstathā pare ..
kṛtye śrāddhe tarpaṇe vā kriyamāṇe vidhānataḥ .. 58 ..
5.106.d:
त्वदन्वये भविष्यंति पुत्रपौत्रास्तथा परे ..
कृत्ये श्राद्धे तर्पणे वा क्रियमाणे विधानतः .. 58 ..
5.106.m: Whatever sons, grandsons, and other descendants are born in your lineage, / when the rite of śrāddha or tarpaṇa is being performed according to the rules,

5.106.s:
ādyasya vatsasaṃjñasya nāma uccārya gotrajam ..
tato nāmāni cāpyevaṃ kīrtayiṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ .. 59 ..
5.106.d:
आद्यस्य वत्ससंज्ञस्य नाम उच्चार्य गोत्रजम् ..
ततो नामानि चाप्येवं कीर्तयिष्यंति भक्तितः .. 59 ..
5.106.m: they shall first utter the name of the ancestor born of the gotra named Vatsa, / and then, in this manner, they will proclaim the other names with devotion.

5.106.s:
tataḥ saṃtarpayiṣyaṃti pitṝnatha pitāmahān ..
tathānyānapi baṃdhūṃśca suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavān .. .. 6.107.60 ..
5.106.d:
ततः संतर्पयिष्यंति पितॄनथ पितामहान् ..
तथान्यानपि बंधूंश्च सुहृत्संबंधिबांधवान् .. .. 6.107.60 ..
5.106.m: Then they will satisfy with water the ancestors, the paternal grandfathers, / and likewise other kin, friends, relatives, and companions.

5.106.s:
tvadanvaye vinā nāmnā tvadīyena vimohitāḥ ..
ye pitṝṃstarpayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ vyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 61 ..
5.106.d:
त्वदन्वये विना नाम्ना त्वदीयेन विमोहिताः ..
ये पितॄंस्तर्पयिष्यंति तेषां व्यर्थं भविष्यति .. 61 ..
5.106.m: If any in your lineage, deluded, satisfy the ancestors / without your name, their rite will be fruitless—

5.106.s:
śrāddhaṃ vā yadi vā dānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vā tvadudbhavam ..
tasmādahaṃkṛtiṃ muktvā māmārādhaya kevalam ..62..
5.106.d:
श्राद्धं वा यदि वा दानं तर्पणं वा त्वदुद्भवम् ..
तस्मादहंकृतिं मुक्त्वा मामाराधय केवलम् ..62..
5.106.m: whether it be śrāddha, a gift, or tarpaṇa performed by your descendant. / Therefore abandon egoism and worship only me,

5.106.s:
yena siddho'pi saṃsiddhiṃ parāmāpnoṣi śāśvatīm ..
evaṃ saṃbodhya taṃ vipraṃ kṛtvādyamapi paścimam..63..
5.106.d:
येन सिद्धोऽपि संसिद्धिं परामाप्नोषि शाश्वतीम् ..
एवं संबोध्य तं विप्रं कृत्वाद्यमपि पश्चिमम्..63..
5.106.m: so that, though already accomplished, you may attain the supreme, eternal perfection." / Having thus addressed that brahmin, making him who was last into the first,

5.106.s:
tatastānbrāhmaṇānāha prāsādaḥ kriyatāmiti ..
gotraṃgotraṃ puraskṛtya sthāpyaṃ liṃgamanuttamam ..
yena saṃkramaṇaṃ teṣu mama saṃjāyatedvijāḥ .. 64 ..
5.106.d:
ततस्तान्ब्राह्मणानाह प्रासादः क्रियतामिति ..
गोत्रंगोत्रं पुरस्कृत्य स्थाप्यं लिंगमनुत्तमम् ..
येन संक्रमणं तेषु मम संजायतेद्विजाः .. 64 ..
5.106.m: he then said to those brahmins: "Let temples be built; / honoring each gotra, an unsurpassed liṅga should be installed, / so that my entry into them may take place, O twice-born."

5.106.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāstatra bhūmibhāgānmanoharān ..
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā pracakruśca prāsādānharṣasaṃyutāḥ .. 65 ..
5.106.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र भूमिभागान्मनोहरान् ..
दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वा प्रचक्रुश्च प्रासादान्हर्षसंयुताः .. 65 ..
5.106.m: Then those brahmins, looking at the charming plots of land there, / built temples, filled with joy—

5.106.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭimitāndivyānkailāsaśikharopamān ..
teṣu saṃsthāpayāmāsu liṅgāni vividhāni ca ..
kṣetrekṣatre ca yannāma tattatsaṃjñāṃ pracakrire .. 66 ..
5.106.d:
अष्टषष्टिमितान्दिव्यान्कैलासशिखरोपमान् ..
तेषु संस्थापयामासु लिङ्गानि विविधानि च ..
क्षेत्रेक्षत्रे च यन्नाम तत्तत्संज्ञां प्रचक्रिरे .. 66 ..
5.106.m: sixty-eight divine temples, resembling the peaks of Kailāsa. / In them they installed various liṅgas, / and in each sacred field they gave them the names corresponding to each.

5.106.s:
atha teṣāṃ punardṛṣṭiṃ gatvā devastrilocanaḥ ..
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye ..
ārādhitastapaḥśaktyā liṃgasaṃsthāpanādanu .. 67 ..
5.106.d:
अथ तेषां पुनर्दृष्टिं गत्वा देवस्त्रिलोचनः ..
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं कस्मिंश्चित्कालपर्यये ..
आराधितस्तपःशक्त्या लिंगसंस्थापनादनु .. 67 ..
5.106.m: Then, having again come into their view at the end of a certain period of time, / the three-eyed god, worshiped through the power of austerity after the installation of the liṅgas, spoke sweet words:

5.106.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi vipreṃdrā yuṣmākamahamadya vai ..
etanmama kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhavadbhirakhilaṃ tataḥ .. 68 ..
5.106.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि विप्रेंद्रा युष्माकमहमद्य वै ..
एतन्मम कृतं कृत्यं भवद्भिरखिलं ततः .. 68 ..
5.106.m: The Blessed One said: / "I am exceedingly pleased with you today, O lords among the twice-born! / All this task of mine has been accomplished by you.

5.106.s:
asmadīyāni liṃgāni kṣetrāṇi ca kalerbhayāt ..
tato mānyāśca me yūyaṃ nānyairetadbhaviṣyati .. 69 ..
5.106.d:
अस्मदीयानि लिंगानि क्षेत्राणि च कलेर्भयात् ..
ततो मान्याश्च मे यूयं नान्यैरेतद्भविष्यति .. 69 ..
5.106.m: My liṅgas and sacred fields [have been brought here] out of fear of Kali; / therefore you are honored by me; this could not have been done by others.

5.106.s:
tasmāccittasthitaṃ śīghraṃ prārthayaṃtu dvijottamāḥ ..
saṃprayacchāmi yenāśu yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 6.107.70 .. ..
5.106.d:
तस्माच्चित्तस्थितं शीघ्रं प्रार्थयंतु द्विजोत्तमाः ..
संप्रयच्छामि येनाशु यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 6.107.70 .. ..
5.106.m: Therefore, O best of the twice-born, ask quickly for what is in your heart, / so that I may grant it at once, even if it is very difficult to obtain."

5.106.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi deva prasannastvamasmākaṃ ca sureśvara ..
paścimaścitraśarmā ca yathādyo bhavatā kṛtaḥ .. 71 ..
5.106.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि देव प्रसन्नस्त्वमस्माकं च सुरेश्वर ..
पश्चिमश्चित्रशर्मा च यथाद्यो भवता कृतः .. 71 ..
5.106.m: The brahmins said: / "If you are pleased with us, O god, O lord of gods, / just as Citraśarman, who was last, was made first by you,

5.106.s:
asmadīyaṃ sadā nāma kīrtanīyamasaṃśayam ..
śrāddhakṛtyeṣu sarveṣu yathā tena samā vayam ..
bhavāmastvatprasādena sāṃprataṃ citraśarmaṇā .. 72 ..
5.106.d:
अस्मदीयं सदा नाम कीर्तनीयमसंशयम् ..
श्राद्धकृत्येषु सर्वेषु यथा तेन समा वयम् ..
भवामस्त्वत्प्रसादेन सांप्रतं चित्रशर्मणा .. 72 ..
5.106.m: let our names likewise always be recited, without a doubt, / in all śrāddha rites, so that through your grace / we may now be equal to that Citraśarman."

5.106.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
yuṣmākamapi ye kecidvaśaṃ yāsyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
yuvānaḥ śāstrasaṃyuktā vedavidyāviśāradāḥ ..73..
5.106.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
युष्माकमपि ये केचिद्वशं यास्यंति मानवाः ..
युवानः शास्त्रसंयुक्ता वेदविद्याविशारदाः ..73..
5.106.m: The Blessed One said: / "Whatever men come under your authority, / youths endowed with knowledge of the śāstras and skilled in Vedic learning,

5.106.s:
ānayiṣyatha tānyūyamāmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñitān ..
nityaṃ sthitāśca te kṣetre śrāddhasyākṣayyakārakāḥ .. 74 ..
5.106.d:
आनयिष्यथ तान्यूयमामुष्यायणसंज्ञितान् ..
नित्यं स्थिताश्च ते क्षेत्रे श्राद्धस्याक्षय्यकारकाः .. 74 ..
5.106.m: you shall bring them forth as bearers of the title āmuṣyāyaṇa; / and dwelling continually in this sacred field, they will render the śrāddha imperishable."

5.106.s:
evamuktvātha deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
te'pi viprāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāstatra sthāne vyavasthitāḥ .. 75 ..
5.106.d:
एवमुक्त्वाथ देवेशस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
तेऽपि विप्राः सुसंतुष्टास्तत्र स्थाने व्यवस्थिताः .. 75 ..
5.106.m: Having spoken thus, the lord of gods vanished from there; / and those brahmins, well satisfied, settled in that place.

5.106.s:
evaṃ tatra samastāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca ..
kalibhītāni vipreṃdrā nivasaṃti sadaiva hi .. 76 ..
5.106.d:
एवं तत्र समस्तानि क्षेत्राण्यायतनानि च ..
कलिभीतानि विप्रेंद्रा निवसंति सदैव हि .. 76 ..
5.106.m: Thus all those sacred fields and abodes, afraid of the Kali age, / dwell there perpetually, O lords of the twice-born.

5.106.s:
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ prāpya siddhiṃ ceśvarapūjanāt ..
khyātāḥ sarvatra bhuvane śrāddhasyākṣayyakārakāḥ .. 77 ..
5.106.d:
एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः प्राप्य सिद्धिं चेश्वरपूजनात् ..
ख्याताः सर्वत्र भुवने श्राद्धस्याक्षय्यकारकाः .. 77 ..
5.106.m: Thus those brahmins, having attained perfection from the worship of Īśvara, / became famous throughout the world as those who make the śrāddha imperishable.

5.106.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye brāhmaṇacitraśarmaliṃgasthāpanavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 107 .. .. ..
5.106.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये ब्राह्मणचित्रशर्मलिंगस्थापनवृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम सप्तोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 107 .. .. ..
5.106.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Account of the Brahmin Citraśarman's Installation of the Liṅga' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.107.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni yāni kṣetrāṇi sūtaja ..
tvayoktāni ca tānyeva nāmato naḥ prakīrtaya .. 1 ..
5.107.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अष्टषष्टिप्रमाणानि यानि क्षेत्राणि सूतज ..
त्वयोक्तानि च तान्येव नामतो नः प्रकीर्तय .. 1 ..
5.107.m: The seers said: / The sacred fields numbering sixty-eight, O son of Sūta, / which were mentioned by you, tell us those very ones by name. // 1

5.107.s:
tathānyāni ca tīrthāni yāni saṃti dharātale ..
tāni kīrtaya kārtsnyena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 2 ..
5.107.d:
तथान्यानि च तीर्थानि यानि संति धरातले ..
तानि कीर्तय कार्त्स्न्येन परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 2 ..
5.107.m: And likewise the other sacred fords that exist on the face of the earth, / tell those in their entirety; for great indeed is our curiosity. // 2

5.107.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yāni proktāni tīrthāni bhavadbhirdvijasattamāḥ ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni tathā kṣetrāṇi bhūtale ..3..
5.107.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यानि प्रोक्तानि तीर्थानि भवद्भिर्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
अष्टषष्टिप्रमाणानि तथा क्षेत्राणि भूतले ..3..
5.107.m: Sūta said: / The sacred fords mentioned by you, O best among the twice-born, / and likewise the sacred fields on the earth numbering sixty-eight— // 3

5.107.s:
tāni sarvāṇi bhītāni praviṣṭāni rasātalam ..
tīrthāni muniśārdūlāḥ pāpe hyatra kalau yuge ..4..
5.107.d:
तानि सर्वाणि भीतानि प्रविष्टानि रसातलम् ..
तीर्थानि मुनिशार्दूलाः पापे ह्यत्र कलौ युगे ..4..
5.107.m: All those terrified sacred fords have entered Rasātala, / O tigers among sages, in this sinful Kali age. // 4

5.107.s:
etadeva purā pṛṣṭaḥ pārvatyā parameśvaraḥ ..
yadbhavadbhirahaṃ pṛṣṭastīrthayātrākṛte dvijāḥ .. 5 ..
5.107.d:
एतदेव पुरा पृष्टः पार्वत्या परमेश्वरः ..
यद्भवद्भिरहं पृष्टस्तीर्थयात्राकृते द्विजाः .. 5 ..
5.107.m: This very same thing was formerly asked of Parameśvara by Pārvatī, / which has now been asked of me by you, O twice-born, concerning pilgrimage to sacred fords. // 5

5.107.s:
kailāsaśikharāsīnaḥ purā devo maheśvaraḥ ..
sarvairgaṇagaṇaiḥ sārdhamupaviṣṭo varāsane .. 6 ..
5.107.d:
कैलासशिखरासीनः पुरा देवो महेश्वरः ..
सर्वैर्गणगणैः सार्धमुपविष्टो वरासने .. 6 ..
5.107.m: Formerly, the god Maheśvara was seated on a peak of Kailāsa, / sitting on an excellent throne together with all the hosts of Gaṇas. // 6

5.107.s:
praṇāma karaṇārthāya hyāgateṣvamareṣu ca ..
gateṣu teṣu vipreṃdrā sarveṣu tridivālayam ..
ardhāsanagatā devī vākyametaduvāca ha .. 7 ..
5.107.d:
प्रणाम करणार्थाय ह्यागतेष्वमरेषु च ..
गतेषु तेषु विप्रेंद्रा सर्वेषु त्रिदिवालयम् ..
अर्धासनगता देवी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 7 ..
5.107.m: When the immortals had come in order to pay homage, / and when all of them had returned to the abode of heaven, O leaders of brahmins, / the Goddess, seated on half of his seat, spoke this word: // 7

5.107.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
devadeva mahādeva gaṃgākṣālitaśekhara ..
vada me tīrthamāhātmyaṃ yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava . 8 ..
5.107.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
देवदेव महादेव गंगाक्षालितशेखर ..
वद मे तीर्थमाहात्म्यं यद्यहं वल्लभा तव . 8 ..
5.107.m: The Goddess said: / O god of gods, Mahādeva, whose crown is washed by the Gaṅgā, / tell me the māhātmya of the sacred fords, if I am dear to you. // 8

5.107.s:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale ..
saṃkhyayā nāmato deva mahyaṃ kīrtaya sāṃpratam . 9 ..
5.107.d:
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्धकोटी च तीर्थानामिह भूतले ..
संख्यया नामतो देव मह्यं कीर्तय सांप्रतम् . 9 ..
5.107.m: There are three and a half crores of sacred fords here on the surface of the earth; / tell me now, O god, by number and by name. // 9

5.107.s:
yāni tīrthānyanekāni kṣetrāṇi caiva me prabho ..
tāni kīrtaya deveśa sugamyaṃ caiva dehinām ..
kīrtanācca samagrāṇāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam .. 6.108.10 ..
5.107.d:
यानि तीर्थान्यनेकानि क्षेत्राणि चैव मे प्रभो ..
तानि कीर्तय देवेश सुगम्यं चैव देहिनाम् ..
कीर्तनाच्च समग्राणां तीर्थानां लभ्यते फलम् .. 6.108.10 ..
5.107.m: The many sacred fords and sacred fields, O Lord, / tell of them, O Lord of gods, and that which is easily accessible to embodied beings; / and by merely reciting all the sacred fords, their fruit is attained. // 10

5.107.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tīrthaśabdo varārohe dharmakṛtyeṣu vartate ..
dharmasthāneṣu sarveṣu tattvaṃ śṛṇu samāhitā .. 11 ..
5.107.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तीर्थशब्दो वरारोहे धर्मकृत्येषु वर्तते ..
धर्मस्थानेषु सर्वेषु तत्त्वं शृणु समाहिता .. 11 ..
5.107.m: Īśvara said: / The word tīrtha, O woman of shapely hips, is applied to acts of righteousness, / and to all abodes of righteousness; listen to the truth with an attentive mind: // 11

5.107.s:
mātā tīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ tīrtha sādhusamāgamaḥ ..
dharmānuciṃtanaṃ caiva tathaiva niyamo yamaḥ .. 12 ..
5.107.d:
माता तीर्थं पिता तीर्थं तीर्थ साधुसमागमः ..
धर्मानुचिंतनं चैव तथैव नियमो यमः .. 12 ..
5.107.m: Mother is a sacred ford, father is a sacred ford, the company of the virtuous is a sacred ford; / so too is meditation upon righteousness, as well as restraint and observance. // 12

5.107.s:
puṇyāḥ kathā varārohe devarṣīṇāṃ kṛtāstathā ..
āśrayāḥ sanmunīṃdrāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā priye .. 13 ..
5.107.d:
पुण्याः कथा वरारोहे देवर्षीणां कृतास्तथा ..
आश्रयाः सन्मुनींद्राणां देवानां च तथा प्रिये .. 13 ..
5.107.m: The sacred narratives told of celestial seers, O woman of shapely hips, / and the dwelling places of good leaders of sages and of the gods, O beloved, // 13

5.107.s:
bhūmibhāgāḥ pavitrāḥ syuḥ kīrtyate tīrthamityuta ..
teṣāṃ saṃdarśanādeva smaraṇāccāvagāhanāt ..
mucyaṃte jantavaḥ pāpairapi janmaśatodbhavaiḥ .. 14 ..
5.107.d:
भूमिभागाः पवित्राः स्युः कीर्त्यते तीर्थमित्युत ..
तेषां संदर्शनादेव स्मरणाच्चावगाहनात् ..
मुच्यंते जन्तवः पापैरपि जन्मशतोद्भवैः .. 14 ..
5.107.m: and pure regions of the earth are declared to be sacred fords. / Merely by seeing them, remembering them, and bathing in them, / living creatures are freed from sins, even those born of a hundred lifetimes. // 14

5.107.s:
tathā pātakino ye ca ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ ..
te'pi sarve tathā muktāsteṣāṃ caivāvagāhanāt.. 15 ..
5.107.d:
तथा पातकिनो ये च ये च विश्वासघातकाः ..
तेऽपि सर्वे तथा मुक्तास्तेषां चैवावगाहनात्.. 15 ..
5.107.m: Likewise, sinners and betrayers of trust— / even all of them are liberated in the same way merely by plunging into them. // 15

5.107.s:
evaṃ pāpāni saṃyāṃti nāśaṃ sarvāṃgasundari ..
api brahmavadhātpāpaṃ yadbhavediha dehinām ..
taccāpi tīrthasaṃsargātpralayaṃ yātyasaṃśayam .. 16 ..
5.107.d:
एवं पापानि संयांति नाशं सर्वांगसुन्दरि ..
अपि ब्रह्मवधात्पापं यद्भवेदिह देहिनाम् ..
तच्चापि तीर्थसंसर्गात्प्रलयं यात्यसंशयम् .. 16 ..
5.107.m: Thus sins go to destruction, O woman beautiful in all limbs; / even the sin that embodied beings might incur here through the slaying of a brahmin, / that too undoubtedly perishes through contact with a sacred ford. // 16

5.107.s:
mamāpi karasaṃlagnaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ purā ..
patitaṃ tīrthasaṃsargātteṣāṃ caivāvagāhanāt .. 17 ..
5.107.d:
ममापि करसंलग्नं कपालं ब्रह्मणः पुरा ..
पतितं तीर्थसंसर्गात्तेषां चैवावगाहनात् .. 17 ..
5.107.m: Even the skull of Brahmā that clung to my hand in former times / fell off through contact with sacred fords and by plunging into them. // 17

5.107.s:
evaṃ sarveṣu tīrtheṣu tathā hyāyataneṣu ca ..
snātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā nānyagāminā .. 18 ..
5.107.d:
एवं सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु तथा ह्यायतनेषु च ..
स्नातव्यं भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना .. 18 ..
5.107.m: Therefore, in all sacred fords and in temples, / one should bathe with devotion in one's heart, not straying to anything else. // 18

5.107.s:
yatra snātairnaraiḥ samyaksarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam ..
mamāśrayaṃ viśālākṣi sarvapātakanāśanam..
kāmadaṃ ca tathā nṝṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 19 ..
5.107.d:
यत्र स्नातैर्नरैः सम्यक्सर्वेषां लभ्यते फलम् ..
ममाश्रयं विशालाक्षि सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
कामदं च तथा नॄणां नारीणां च विशेषतः .. 19 ..
5.107.m: The fruit of all [sacred fords] is truly obtained by men who bathe where / my sanctuary is, O large-eyed woman, destroying all wickedness, / and granting the desires of men, and especially of women. // 19

5.107.s:
etadguhyatamaṃ devi mama nityavyavasthitam ..
na kasyā'pi mayākhyātaṃ deveṃdrasyāpi pṛcchataḥ .. 6.108.20 ..
5.107.d:
एतद्गुह्यतमं देवि मम नित्यव्यवस्थितम् ..
न कस्याऽपि मयाख्यातं देवेंद्रस्यापि पृच्छतः .. 6.108.20 ..
5.107.m: This is my most secret [teaching], O Goddess, perpetually maintained; / it has not been told to anyone by me, not even to the king of gods when he asked. // 20

5.107.s:
vāllabhyāttava me bhadre kathitaṃ vai varānane ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiḥ pragamyāni bhaktyā tīrthāni mānavaiḥ .. 21 ..
5.107.d:
वाल्लभ्यात्तव मे भद्रे कथितं वै वरानने ..
अष्टषष्टिः प्रगम्यानि भक्त्या तीर्थानि मानवैः .. 21 ..
5.107.m: Because you are dear to me, O auspicious one of lovely face, it is indeed told: / sixty-eight sacred fords should be visited with devotion by mortals. // 21

5.107.s:
mamāśrayāṇi tānyeva sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ..
kāmadāni varārohe matprabhāvādasaṃśayam .. 22 ..
5.107.d:
ममाश्रयाणि तान्येव सर्वपापहराणि च ..
कामदानि वरारोहे मत्प्रभावादसंशयम् .. 22 ..
5.107.m: Those very sanctuaries of mine destroy all sins; / they grant desires, O woman of shapely hips, undoubtedly through my power. // 22

5.107.s:
yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ samādhāya tatra tīrthe pumānyadi ..
kṛtvā snānaṃ tato devamarcayecca maheśvaram .. 23 ..
5.107.d:
यं यं कामं समाधाय तत्र तीर्थे पुमान्यदि ..
कृत्वा स्नानं ततो देवमर्चयेच्च महेश्वरम् .. 23 ..
5.107.m: Whatever desire a man may focus upon in that sacred ford, / if, having performed his bath, he then worships the god Maheśvara, // 23

5.107.s:
sukṛtaṃ manasi dhyātvā yairnaraiḥ pūjito hariḥ ..
āstāṃ teṣāṃ varārohe darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā ..
smaraṇādapi mucyaṃte narāḥ pāpaiḥ purākṛtaiḥ .. 24 ..
5.107.d:
सुकृतं मनसि ध्यात्वा यैर्नरैः पूजितो हरिः ..
आस्तां तेषां वरारोहे दर्शनं स्पर्शनं तथा ..
स्मरणादपि मुच्यंते नराः पापैः पुराकृतैः .. 24 ..
5.107.m: having contemplated merit in their minds, those men who have worshipped Hari— / let alone seeing and touching them, O woman of shapely hips— / even by remembering them, men are freed from previously committed sins. // 24

5.107.s:
ete śakrādayo devāsteṣu tīrtheṣu sundari ..
māṃ pūjya tridivaṃ prāptāstathānye nāradādayaḥ .. 25 ..
5.107.d:
एते शक्रादयो देवास्तेषु तीर्थेषु सुन्दरि ..
मां पूज्य त्रिदिवं प्राप्तास्तथान्ये नारदादयः .. 25 ..
5.107.m: These gods, Indra and the others, in those sacred fords, O fair one, / attained heaven after worshipping me, and likewise others, Nārada and the rest. // 25

5.107.s:
tānyahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa pṛthakpṛthak ..
nāmataḥ śṛṇu deveśi samāhitamanāḥ sthitā .. 26 ..
5.107.d:
तान्यहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि विस्तरेण पृथक्पृथक् ..
नामतः शृणु देवेशि समाहितमनाः स्थिता .. 26 ..
5.107.m: I shall tell them to you in detail, one by one; / listen to them by name, O ruler of gods, remaining with a focused mind: // 26

5.107.s:
vārāṇasī prayāgaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ cāparaṃ tathā ..
gayāśiraḥ supuṇyaṃ ca pavitraṃ kurujāṃgalam .. 27 ..
5.107.d:
वाराणसी प्रयागं च नैमिषं चापरं तथा ..
गयाशिरः सुपुण्यं च पवित्रं कुरुजांगलम् .. 27 ..
5.107.m: Vārāṇasī, Prayāga, and another, Naimiṣa, / the most meritorious Gayāśiras, and holy Kurujāṅgala; // 27

5.107.s:
prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva viśveśvaramathāparama ..
aṭṭahāsaṃ mahendraṃ ca tathaivojjayanī ca yā .. 28 ..
5.107.d:
प्रभासं पुष्करं चैव विश्वेश्वरमथापरम ..
अट्टहासं महेन्द्रं च तथैवोज्जयनी च या .. 28 ..
5.107.m: Prabhāsa, Puṣkara, and another, Viśveśvara, / Aṭṭahāsa, Mahendra, and that which is Ujjayinī; // 28

5.107.s:
marukoṭiḥ śaṃkukarṇaṃ gokarṇaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
rudrakoṭiḥ sthaleśaṃ ca harṣitaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam .. 29 ..
5.107.d:
मरुकोटिः शंकुकर्णं गोकर्णं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
रुद्रकोटिः स्थलेशं च हर्षितं वृषभध्वजम् .. 29 ..
5.107.m: Marukoṭi, Śaṅkukarṇa, the excellent sacred field Gokarṇa, / Rudrakoṭi, Sthaleśa, and delightful Vṛṣabhadhvaja; // 29

5.107.s:
kedāraṃ ca tathā kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ madhyamakeśvaram ..
sahasrākṣaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ tathānyatkārtikeśvaram .. 6.108.30 ..
5.107.d:
केदारं च तथा क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रं मध्यमकेश्वरम् ..
सहस्राक्षं तथा क्षेत्रं तथान्यत्कार्तिकेश्वरम् .. 6.108.30 ..
5.107.m: Kedāra, and likewise the sacred field Madhyamakeśvara, / the sacred field Sahasrākṣa, and another, Kārtikeśvara; // 30

5.107.s:
tathaiva vastramārgaṃ ca tathā kanakhalaṃ smṛtam ..
bhadrakarṇaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ daṇḍakākhyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 31 ..
5.107.d:
तथैव वस्त्रमार्गं च तथा कनखलं स्मृतम् ..
भद्रकर्णं च विख्यातं दण्डकाख्यं तथैव च .. 31 ..
5.107.m: and likewise Vastramārga, and Kanakhala is remembered, / celebrated Bhadrakarṇa, and likewise that called Daṇḍaka; // 31

5.107.s:
tridaṇḍākhyaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ tathaiva kṛmijāṃgalam ..
ekāmraṃ ca tathā kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ chāgalakaṃ tathā .. 32 ..
5.107.d:
त्रिदण्डाख्यं तथा क्षेत्रं तथैव कृमिजांगलम् ..
एकाम्रं च तथा क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रं छागलकं तथा .. 32 ..
5.107.m: and the sacred field named Tridaṇḍa, and likewise Kṛmijāṅgala, / the sacred field Ekāmra, and likewise the sacred field Chāgalaka; // 32

5.107.s:
kāliṃjaraṃ ca deveśi tathānyanmaṇḍaleśvaram ..
kāśmīraṃ marukeśaṃ ca hariścaṃdraṃ suśobhanam.. 33 ..
5.107.d:
कालिंजरं च देवेशि तथान्यन्मण्डलेश्वरम् ..
काश्मीरं मरुकेशं च हरिश्चंद्रं सुशोभनम्.. 33 ..
5.107.m: Kālañjara, O ruler of gods, and another, Maṇḍaleśvara, / Kāśmīra, Marukeśa, and very beautiful Hariścandra; // 33

5.107.s:
puraścaṃdraṃ ca vāmeśaṃ kukuṭeśvarameva ca ..
bhasmagātramathokāraṃ trisaṃdhyā virajā tathā .. 34 ...
5.107.d:
पुरश्चंद्रं च वामेशं कुकुटेश्वरमेव च ..
भस्मगात्रमथोकारं त्रिसंध्या विरजा तथा .. 34 ...
5.107.m: Puraścandra, Vāmeśa, and Kukuṭeśvara, / Bhasmagātra, then Oṃkāra, Trisaṃdhyā, and Virajā; // 34

5.107.s:
arkeśvaraṃ ca nepālaṃ duṣkarṇaṃ karavīrakam ..
jāgeśvaraṃ tathā devi śrīśailaṃ parvatottamam .. 35 ..
5.107.d:
अर्केश्वरं च नेपालं दुष्कर्णं करवीरकम् ..
जागेश्वरं तथा देवि श्रीशैलं पर्वतोत्तमम् .. 35 ..
5.107.m: Arkeśvara, Nepāla, Duṣkarṇa, Karavīraka, / Jāgeśvara, and likewise, O Goddess, Śrīśaila, the best of mountains; // 35

5.107.s:
ayodhyā caiva pātālaṃ tathā kārohaṇaṃ mahat ..
devikā ca nadī puṇyā bhairavaṃ pūrvasāgaraḥ .. 36 ..
5.107.d:
अयोध्या चैव पातालं तथा कारोहणं महत् ..
देविका च नदी पुण्या भैरवं पूर्वसागरः .. 36 ..
5.107.m: Ayodhyā, Pātāla, and the great Kārohaṇa, / the holy river Devikā, Bhairava, and the eastern ocean; // 36

5.107.s:
saptagodāvarītīrthaṃ tathaiva samudāhṛtam ..
nirmaleśaṃ tathānyacca karṇikāraṃ suśobhanam .. 37 ..
5.107.d:
सप्तगोदावरीतीर्थं तथैव समुदाहृतम् ..
निर्मलेशं तथान्यच्च कर्णिकारं सुशोभनम् .. 37 ..
5.107.m: Saptagodāvarī tīrtha is likewise proclaimed, / and another, Nirmaleśa, and very beautiful Karṇikāra; // 37

5.107.s:
kailāsaṃ jāhnavītīraṃ jalaliṃgaṃ ca vāḍavam..
badarītīrthavaryaṃ ca koṭitīrthaṃ tathaiva ca .. 38 ..
5.107.d:
कैलासं जाह्नवीतीरं जललिंगं च वाडवम्..
बदरीतीर्थवर्यं च कोटितीर्थं तथैव च .. 38 ..
5.107.m: Kailāsa, the bank of the Jāhnavī, Jalaliṅga, and Vāḍava, / and Badarī, the best of sacred fords, and likewise Koṭitīrtha; // 38

5.107.s:
viṃdhyācalo hemakūṭaṃ gandhamādanameva ca ..
liṃgeśvaraṃ tathā kṣetraṃ laṃkādvāraṃ tathaiva ca .. 39 ..
5.107.d:
विंध्याचलो हेमकूटं गन्धमादनमेव च ..
लिंगेश्वरं तथा क्षेत्रं लंकाद्वारं तथैव च .. 39 ..
5.107.m: the Vindhya mountain, Hemakūṭa, and Gandhamādana, / and the sacred field Liṅgeśvara, and likewise Laṅkādvāra. // 39

5.107.s:
naleśvaraṃ tu madhyeśaṃ kedāraṃ rudrajālakam ..
suvarṇākhyaṃ ca vāmoru tathānyatṣaṣṭikāpatham .. 6.108.40 ..
5.107.d:
नलेश्वरं तु मध्येशं केदारं रुद्रजालकम् ..
सुवर्णाख्यं च वामोरु तथान्यत्षष्टिकापथम् .. 6.108.40 ..
5.107.m: Naleśvara, Madhyeśa, Kedāra, Rudrajālaka, / Suvarṇākhya, O fair-thighed lady, and also another, Ṣaṣṭikāpatha. (40)

5.107.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśavarakṣetramāhātmye 'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 108 ..
5.107.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेशवरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ऽष्टषष्टितीर्थवर्णनंनामाष्टोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 108 ..
5.107.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighth chapter, named “Description of the Sixty-Eight Sacred Fords,” in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.108.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi varānane ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ sāraṃ tīrthasamuccayam .. 1 ..
5.108.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि वरानने ..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां सारं तीर्थसमुच्चयम् .. 1 ..
5.108.m: Īśvara said: / All this has been narrated to you, O fair-faced lady, as I was asked— / the collection of sacred fords, the essence of all sacred fords whatsoever. (1)

5.108.s:
eteṣvahaṃ varārohe sarveṣveva vyavasthitaḥ ..
nāmnā cānyeṣu tīrtheṣu tridaśānāṃ hitārthataḥ .. 2 ..
5.108.d:
एतेष्वहं वरारोहे सर्वेष्वेव व्यवस्थितः ..
नाम्ना चान्येषु तीर्थेषु त्रिदशानां हितार्थतः .. 2 ..
5.108.m: In all these [sacred fords], O lady of beautiful hips, I abide / under different names, and also in other sacred fords, for the benefit of the gods. (2)

5.108.s:
yo māmeteṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā paśyati mānavaḥ ..
kīrtayetkīrtanānnāmnā sa nūnaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
5.108.d:
यो मामेतेषु तीर्थेषु स्नात्वा पश्यति मानवः ..
कीर्तयेत्कीर्तनान्नाम्ना स नूनं मोक्षमाप्नुयात् .. 3 ..
5.108.m: Whichever man, having bathed in these sacred fords, beholds me / and celebrates me by name through recitation, he will surely attain liberation. (3)

5.108.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
yeṣu tīrtheṣu yannāma kīrtanīyaṃ tava prabho ..
tatkārtsyena mama brūhi yaccahaṃ tava vallabhā .. 4 ..
5.108.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
येषु तीर्थेषु यन्नाम कीर्तनीयं तव प्रभो ..
तत्कार्त्स्येन मम ब्रूहि यच्चहं तव वल्लभा .. 4 ..
5.108.m: The goddess said: / In which sacred fords which name of yours should be celebrated, O Lord? / Tell me that in full, if indeed I am dear to you. (4)

5.108.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ prayāge ca maheśvaram ..
naimiṣe devadevaṃ ca gayāyāṃ prapitāmaham .. 5 ..
5.108.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
वाराणस्यां महादेवं प्रयागे च महेश्वरम् ..
नैमिषे देवदेवं च गयायां प्रपितामहम् .. 5 ..
5.108.m: Īśvara said: / In Vārāṇasī, [I am celebrated as] Mahādeva, and in Prayāga as Maheśvara; / in Naimiṣa as Devadeva, and in Gayā as Prapitāmaha. (5)

5.108.s:
kurukṣetre viduḥ sthāṇuṃ prabhāse śaśiśekharam ..
puṣkare tu hyajāgandhiṃ viśvaṃ viśveśvare tathā .. 6 ..
5.108.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे विदुः स्थाणुं प्रभासे शशिशेखरम् ..
पुष्करे तु ह्यजागन्धिं विश्वं विश्वेश्वरे तथा .. 6 ..
5.108.m: In Kurukṣetra they know [me as] Sthāṇu; in Prabhāsa, as Śaśiśekhara; / in Puṣkara, as Ajāgandhi; and in Viśveśvara, as Viśva. (6)

5.108.s:
aṭṭahāse mahānādaṃ mahendre ca mahāvratam ( 10) ..
ujjayinyāṃ mahākālaṃ marukoṭe mahotkaṭam ..7..
5.108.d:
अट्टहासे महानादं महेन्द्रे च महाव्रतम् ( 10) ..
उज्जयिन्यां महाकालं मरुकोटे महोत्कटम् ..7..
5.108.m: In Aṭṭahāsa as Mahānāda; in Mahendra as Mahāvrata; / in Ujjayinī as Mahākāla; in Marukoṭa as Mahotkaṭa. (7)

5.108.s:
śaṃkukarṇe mahātejaṃ gokarṇe ca mahābalam ..
rudrakoṭyāṃ mahāyogaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sthaleśvare ..8..
5.108.d:
शंकुकर्णे महातेजं गोकर्णे च महाबलम् ..
रुद्रकोट्यां महायोगं महालिंगं स्थलेश्वरे ..8..
5.108.m: In Śaṅkukarṇa as Mahātejas; and in Gokarṇa as Mahābala; / in Rudrakoṭi as Mahāyoga; in Sthaleśvara as Mahāliṅga. (8)

5.108.s:
harṣite ca tathā harṣaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaje ..
kedāre caiva īśānaṃ śarvaṃ madhyamakeśvare ( 20 ).ṃ.9 ..
5.108.d:
हर्षिते च तथा हर्षं वृषभं वृषभध्वजे ..
केदारे चैव ईशानं शर्वं मध्यमकेश्वरे ( 20 ).ं.9 ..
5.108.m: In Harṣita as Harṣa; in Vṛṣabhadhvaja as Vṛṣabha; / in Kedāra as Īśāna; in Madhyamakeśvara as Śarva. (9)

5.108.s:
suparṇākṣaṃ sahasrākṣe susūkṣmaṃ kārtikeśvare ..
bhavaṃ vastrāpathe devi hyugraṃ kanakhale tathā .. 6.109.10 ..
5.108.d:
सुपर्णाक्षं सहस्राक्षे सुसूक्ष्मं कार्तिकेश्वरे ..
भवं वस्त्रापथे देवि ह्युग्रं कनखले तथा .. 6.109.10 ..
5.108.m: In Sahasrākṣa as Suparṇākṣa; in Kārtikeśvara as Susūkṣma; / in Vastrāpatha, O goddess, as Bhava; and likewise in Kanakhala as Ugra. (10)

5.108.s:
bhadrakarṇe śivaṃ caiva daṇḍake daṇḍinaṃ tathā ..
ūrdhvaretaṃ tridaṇḍāyāṃ caṇḍīśaṃ kṛmijāṃgale .. 11 ..
5.108.d:
भद्रकर्णे शिवं चैव दण्डके दण्डिनं तथा ..
ऊर्ध्वरेतं त्रिदण्डायां चण्डीशं कृमिजांगले .. 11 ..
5.108.m: In Bhadrakarṇa as Śiva; and in Daṇḍaka as Daṇḍin; / in Tridaṇḍā as Ūrdhvaretas; in Kṛmijāṅgala as Caṇḍīśa. (11)

5.108.s:
kṛttivāsaṃ tathaikāmre chāgaleye kapardinam 030) ..
kāliñjare nīlakaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ maṇḍaleśvare .. 12 ..
5.108.d:
कृत्तिवासं तथैकाम्रे छागलेये कपर्दिनम् 030) ..
कालिञ्जरे नीलकण्ठं श्रीकण्ठं मण्डलेश्वरे .. 12 ..
5.108.m: In Ekāmra as Kṛttivāsas; in Chāgaleya as Kapardin; / in Kāliñjara as Nīlakaṇṭha; in Maṇḍaleśvara as Śrīkaṇṭha. (12)

5.108.s:
vijayaṃ caiva kāśmīre jayantaṃ marukeśvare ..
hariścandre haraṃ caiva puraścandre ca śaṃkaram.. 13 ..
5.108.d:
विजयं चैव काश्मीरे जयन्तं मरुकेश्वरे ..
हरिश्चन्द्रे हरं चैव पुरश्चन्द्रे च शंकरम्.. 13 ..
5.108.m: In Kaśmīra as Vijaya; in Marukeśvara as Jayanta; / in Hariścandra as Hara; and in Puraścandra as Śaṃkara. (13)

5.108.s:
jaṭiṃ vāmeśvare vindyātsaumyaṃ vai kukkuṭeśvare ..
bhūteśvaraṃ bhasmagātre oṃkāre'marakaṇṭakam ( 40) .. 14 ..
5.108.d:
जटिं वामेश्वरे विन्द्यात्सौम्यं वै कुक्कुटेश्वरे ..
भूतेश्वरं भस्मगात्रे ओंकारेऽमरकण्टकम् ( 40) .. 14 ..
5.108.m: One should know [me] in Vāmeśvara as Jaṭin; in Kukkuṭeśvara as Saumya; / in Bhasmagātra as Bhūteśvara; in Oṃkāra as Amarakaṇṭaka. (14)

5.108.s:
tryaṃbakaṃ ca trisaṃdhyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ trilocanam ..
dīptamarkeśvare jñeyaṃ nepāle paśupālakam .. 15 ..
5.108.d:
त्र्यंबकं च त्रिसंध्यायां विरजायां त्रिलोचनम् ..
दीप्तमर्केश्वरे ज्ञेयं नेपाले पशुपालकम् .. 15 ..
5.108.m: In Trisaṃdhyā as Tryambaka; in Virajā as Trilocana; / in Arkeśvara [I am] to be known as Dīpta; in Nepāla as Paśupālaka. (15)

5.108.s:
yamaliṃgaṃ ca duṣkarṇe kapālī karavīrake ..
jāgeśvare triśūlī ca śrīśaile tripurāṃtakam .. 16 ..
5.108.d:
यमलिंगं च दुष्कर्णे कपाली करवीरके ..
जागेश्वरे त्रिशूली च श्रीशैले त्रिपुरांतकम् .. 16 ..
5.108.m: In Duṣkarṇa as Yamaliṅga; in Karavīraka as Kapālin; / in Jāgeśvara as Triśūlin; and in Śrīśaila as Tripurāntaka. (16)

5.108.s:
rohaṇaṃ tu ayodhyāyāṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ( 50) ..
kārohaṇe nakulīśaṃ devikāyāmumāpatim.. 17 ..
5.108.d:
रोहणं तु अयोध्यायां पाताले हाटकेश्वरम् ( 50) ..
कारोहणे नकुलीशं देविकायामुमापतिम्.. 17 ..
5.108.m: In Ayodhyā as Rohaṇa; in Pātāla as Hāṭakeśvara; / in Kārohaṇa as Nakulīśa; in Devikā as Umāpati. (17)

5.108.s:
bhairave bhairavākāramamaraṃ pūrvasāgare ..
saptagodāvare bhīmaṃ svayaṃbhūrnirmaleśvare .. 18 ..
5.108.d:
भैरवे भैरवाकारममरं पूर्वसागरे ..
सप्तगोदावरे भीमं स्वयंभूर्निर्मलेश्वरे .. 18 ..
5.108.m: In Bhairava as Bhairavākāra; in the eastern ocean as Amara; / in Saptagodāvara as Bhīma; in Nirmaleśvara as Svayambhū. (18)

5.108.s:
karṇikāre gaṇādhyakṣaṃ kailāse tu gaṇādhipam ..
gaṃgādvāre himasthānaṃ jala liṃge jalapriyam( 60) .. 19 ..
5.108.d:
कर्णिकारे गणाध्यक्षं कैलासे तु गणाधिपम् ..
गंगाद्वारे हिमस्थानं जल लिंगे जलप्रियम्( 60) .. 19 ..
5.108.m: In Karṇikāra as Gaṇādhyakṣa; and on Kailāsa as Gaṇādhipa; / at Gaṅgādvāra as Himasthāna; in Jalaliṅga as Jalapriya. (19)

5.108.s:
analaṃ vāḍave'gnau ca bhīmaṃ badarikāśrame ..
śreṣṭhe koṭīśvaraṃ caiva vārāhaṃ vindhyaparvate .. 6.109.20 ..
5.108.d:
अनलं वाडवेऽग्नौ च भीमं बदरिकाश्रमे ..
श्रेष्ठे कोटीश्वरं चैव वाराहं विन्ध्यपर्वते .. 6.109.20 ..
5.108.m: In the submarine fire as Anala; in Badarikāśrama as Bhīma; / in Śreṣṭha as Koṭīśvara; and on the Vindhya mountain as Vārāha. (20)

5.108.s:
hemakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ bhūrbhuvaṃ gandhamādane ..
liṃgeśvare ca varadaṃ laṃkāyāṃ ca narāṃtakam (68) .. 21 ..
5.108.d:
हेमकूटे विरूपाक्षं भूर्भुवं गन्धमादने ..
लिंगेश्वरे च वरदं लंकायां च नरांतकम् (68) .. 21 ..
5.108.m: On Hemakūṭa as Virūpākṣa; on Gandhamādana as Bhūrbhuva; / in Liṅgeśvara as Varada; and in Laṅkā as Narāntaka. (21)

5.108.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiriyaṃ devi tavākhyātā viśeṣataḥ ..
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvapātakanāśinī .. 22 ..
5.108.d:
अष्टषष्टिरियं देवि तवाख्याता विशेषतः ..
पठतां शृण्वतां वापि सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. 22 ..
5.108.m: This [group of] sixty-eight has been narrated to you in detail, O goddess; / it destroys all sins for those who recite it or listen to it. (22)

5.108.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kīrtanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
kālatraye'pi śucibhirviśeṣācchivadīkṣitaiḥ .. 23 ..
5.108.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कीर्तनीया विचक्षणैः ..
कालत्रयेऽपि शुचिभिर्विशेषाच्छिवदीक्षितैः .. 23 ..
5.108.m: Therefore, it should be recited with every effort by the wise, / who are pure, at the three junctions of the day, especially by those initiated into the rites of Śiva. (23)

5.108.s:
likhitāpi varārohe yasyaiṣā tiṣṭhate gṛhe ..
na tatra jāyate doṣo bhūtapretasamudbhavaḥ .. 24 ..
5.108.d:
लिखितापि वरारोहे यस्यैषा तिष्ठते गृहे ..
न तत्र जायते दोषो भूतप्रेतसमुद्भवः .. 24 ..
5.108.m: Even if merely kept written in one’s home, O fair-hipped lady, / no evil arising from ghosts or spirits occurs there. (24)

5.108.s:
na vyādherna ca sarpāṇāṃ na caurāṇāṃ varānane ..
nānyeṣāṃ bhūbhujādīnāṃ kadācidapi kutracit .. 25 ..
5.108.d:
न व्याधेर्न च सर्पाणां न चौराणां वरानने ..
नान्येषां भूभुजादीनां कदाचिदपि कुत्रचित् .. 25 ..
5.108.m: No [danger] from disease, serpents, thieves, O fair-faced lady, / nor ever anywhere from other [threats] such as kings [befalls it]. (25)

5.108.s: iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamāhātmya kathanaṃnāma navottaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 109 .. .. cha ..
5.108.d: इति श्रीस्कादे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽष्टषष्टितीर्थमाहात्म्य कथनंनाम नवोत्तरशततमोध्यायः .. 109 .. .. छ ..
5.108.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninth chapter, named “Account of the Māhātmya of the Sixty-Eight Sacred Fords,” in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.109.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
naiteṣvapi suraśreṣṭha sarveṣu bhuvi mānavāḥ ..
api dīrghāyuṣo bhūtvā snātuṃ śaktāḥ kathaṃcana .. 1 ..
5.109.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
नैतेष्वपि सुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषु भुवि मानवाः ..
अपि दीर्घायुषो भूत्वा स्नातुं शक्ताः कथंचन .. 1 ..
5.109.m: The goddess said: / Men on earth, even if long-lived, are by no means able / to bathe in all of these [sacred fords], O best of gods. (1)

5.109.s:
eteṣāmapi sārāṇi mama tīrthāni kīrtaya ..
yeṣu snāto naraḥ samyaksarveṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 2 .. ..
5.109.d:
एतेषामपि साराणि मम तीर्थानि कीर्तय ..
येषु स्नातो नरः सम्यक्सर्वेषां लभते फलम् .. 2 .. ..
5.109.m: Recite to me the sacred fords that are the essences even of these, / bathing properly in which a person obtains the fruit of all of them. (2)

5.109.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
eteṣāṃ madhyato devi tīrthāṣṭakamanuttamam ..
asti snātairnaraistatra sarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam .. 3 ..
5.109.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतेषां मध्यतो देवि तीर्थाष्टकमनुत्तमम् ..
अस्ति स्नातैर्नरैस्तत्र सर्वेषां लभ्यते फलम् .. 3 ..
5.109.m: Īśvara said: / From among these, O goddess, there is an unsurpassed group of eight sacred fords; / by men who bathe there, the fruit of all of them is obtained. (3)

5.109.s:
naimiṣaṃ caiva kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ kṛmijāṃgalam ..
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ hāṭakeśvaram .. 4 ..
5.109.d:
नैमिषं चैव केदारं पुष्करं कृमिजांगलम् ..
वाराणसी कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रभासं हाटकेश्वरम् .. 4 ..
5.109.m: Naimiṣa, Kedāra, Puṣkara, Kṛmijāṅgala, / Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Prabhāsa, and Hāṭakeśvara. (4)

5.109.s:
aṣṭāsveteṣu yaḥ snātaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu satyametanmayoditam .. 5 ..
5.109.d:
अष्टास्वेतेषु यः स्नातः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 5 ..
5.109.m: He who has bathed in these eight, endowed with proper faith, / has bathed in all sacred fords; this truth has been spoken by me. (5)

5.109.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
kalikāle mahādeva bhaviṣyati kathaṃcana ..
snānaṃ tasmānmama brūhi yatsāraṃ tīrthameva hi .. 6 ..
5.109.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
कलिकाले महादेव भविष्यति कथंचन ..
स्नानं तस्मान्मम ब्रूहि यत्सारं तीर्थमेव हि .. 6 ..
5.109.m: The goddess said: / In the Kali age, O Mahādeva, how can bathing / take place? Therefore, tell me the sacred ford that is the very essence [of them all]. (6)

5.109.s:
aṣṭānāmapi caiteṣāṃ devadeva trilocana ..
yadyahaṃ vallabhā bhaktā tathā cittānuvartinī .. 7 ..
5.109.d:
अष्टानामपि चैतेषां देवदेव त्रिलोचन ..
यद्यहं वल्लभा भक्ता तथा चित्तानुवर्तिनी .. 7 ..
5.109.m: Even among these eight, O God of gods, O Three-Eyed One, / if indeed I am your beloved devotee, compliant with your heart. (7)

5.109.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
aṣṭānāmapi deveśi kṣetrāṇāmasti cottamam ..
eteṣāmapi tatkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam .. 8 ..
5.109.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अष्टानामपि देवेशि क्षेत्राणामस्ति चोत्तमम् ..
एतेषामपि तत्क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 8 ..
5.109.m: Īśvara said: / Even among the eight sacred fields, O ruler of the gods, there is one supreme; / even among them, that sacred field is known by the name Hāṭakeśvara, (8)

5.109.s:
yatra sarvāṇi kṣetrāṇi saṃsthitāni mamājñayā ..
tathānyāni ca tīrthāni kalikāle'pi saṃsthite .. 9 ..
5.109.d:
यत्र सर्वाणि क्षेत्राणि संस्थितानि ममाज्ञया ..
तथान्यानि च तीर्थानि कलिकालेऽपि संस्थिते .. 9 ..
5.109.m: where all the sacred fields are situated by my command, / as well as the other sacred fords, even when the Kali age has set in. (9)

5.109.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatkṣetraṃ sevyameva hi ..
mānuṣairmokṣamicchadbhiḥ satyametanma yoditam .. 6.110.10 ..
5.109.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्क्षेत्रं सेव्यमेव हि ..
मानुषैर्मोक्षमिच्छद्भिः सत्यमेतन्म योदितम् .. 6.110.10 ..
5.109.m: Therefore, that sacred field must indeed be resorted to with every effort / by humans desiring liberation; this truth has been spoken by me. (10)

5.109.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamudbhavam ..
samuccayaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nāmadevasamanvitam .. 11 ..
yathā devena cākhyātaṃ pārvatyā guhyamuttamam ..
prasannena mayā kṛtsnaṃ yuṣmākaṃ samudāhṛtam ...2..
5.109.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातमष्टषष्टिसमुद्भवम् ..
समुच्चयं द्विजश्रेष्ठा नामदेवसमन्वितम् .. 11 ..
यथा देवेन चाख्यातं पार्वत्या गुह्यमुत्तमम् ..
प्रसन्नेन मया कृत्स्नं युष्माकं समुदाहृतम् ...2..
5.109.m:
Sūta said: / All this collection originating from the sixty-eight [sacred fords], / accompanied by the names and the deities, has been narrated to you, O best of brahmins. (11)
Just as this supreme secret was told by the God to Pārvatī, / [so] being pleased, the whole has been declared by me to you. (12)

5.109.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamudbhavam ..
snānajaṃ labhate puṇyaṃ śṛṇvānaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.109.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते भक्त्या ह्यष्टषष्टिसमुद्भवम् ..
स्नानजं लभते पुण्यं शृण्वानः श्रद्धयान्वितः .. 13 ..
5.109.m: And whoever recites with devotion this [hymn] arising from the sixty-eight, / or listens [to it] endowed with faith, obtains the merit born of bathing [in them]. (13)

5.109.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya 'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 110 ..
5.109.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य ऽष्टषष्टितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 110 ..
5.109.m: Thus ends the one hundred and tenth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Sixty-Eight Tīrthas,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.110.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śivakṣetrāṇi yairvipraiḥ samānītāni tatra ca ..
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi gotrāṇi vada sūtaja vistarāt .. 1 ..
5.110.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
शिवक्षेत्राणि यैर्विप्रैः समानीतानि तत्र च ..
तेषां सर्वाणि गोत्राणि वद सूतज विस्तरात् .. 1 ..
5.110.m:
The seers said:
Tell in detail, O son of Sūta, all the lineages (gotras) of those brahmins / by whom the sacred fields of Śiva were brought there. // 1

5.110.s:
kasya gotrodbhavairvipraiḥ kiṃ kṣetraṃ samupārjitam ..
śaṃkarasya prasādena tasminkāla upasthite ..2..
5.110.d:
कस्य गोत्रोद्भवैर्विप्रैः किं क्षेत्रं समुपार्जितम् ..
शंकरस्य प्रसादेन तस्मिन्काल उपस्थिते ..2..
5.110.m: By the brahmins born of which lineage was which sacred field obtained, / by the grace of Śaṃkara, when that time arrived? // 2

5.110.s:
kiyatyapi ca gotrāṇi camatkārapurottame ..
sthāpitāni subhaktena tenānartena sūtaja .. 3..
5.110.d:
कियत्यपि च गोत्राणि चमत्कारपुरोत्तमे ..
स्थापितानि सुभक्तेन तेनानर्तेन सूतज .. 3..
5.110.m: And how many lineages were established in the excellent city of Camatkārapura / by that deeply devoted Ānarta, O son of Sūta? // 3

5.110.s:
tvayā proktaṃ purā dattaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā dvijanmanām ..
na ca teṣāṃ kṛtā saṃkhyā tasmāttāṃ parikīrtaya .. 4 ..
5.110.d:
त्वया प्रोक्तं पुरा दत्तं पुरं कृत्वा द्विजन्मनाम् ..
न च तेषां कृता संख्या तस्मात्तां परिकीर्तय .. 4 ..
5.110.m: You mentioned previously that having founded a city he gave it to the twice-born; / but their count was not given, so proclaim that. // 4

5.110.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
upadeśaḥ purā datto dvisaptatimunīśvaraiḥ ..
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvaṃ kuṣṭharoga prapīḍitaḥ ..
śaṃkhatīrthaṃ samāgatya snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ .. 5 ..
5.110.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
उपदेशः पुरा दत्तो द्विसप्ततिमुनीश्वरैः ..
आनर्ताधिपतिः पूर्वं कुष्ठरोग प्रपीडितः ..
शंखतीर्थं समागत्य स्नानं चक्रे त्वरान्वितः .. 5 ..
5.110.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, instruction was given by seventy-two lords among sages. / In the past, the ruler of Ānarta, severely afflicted with the disease of leprosy, / having gone to Śaṅkhatīrtha, bathed in haste. // 5

5.110.s:
tena nāśaṃ gataḥ kuṣṭho bhūpatestasya tatkṣaṇāt ..
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyānnirvi ṇṇasya tanuṃ prati .. 6 ..
5.110.d:
तेन नाशं गतः कुष्ठो भूपतेस्तस्य तत्क्षणात् ..
तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यान्निर्वि ण्णस्य तनुं प्रति .. 6 ..
5.110.m: By that, the leprosy of that king instantly vanished, / through the māhātmya of that tīrtha, when he had become despondent regarding his body. // 6

5.110.s:
tataḥ sa nīrujo bhūtvā toṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ..
tānuvāca muniśreṣṭhān praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ .. 7 ..
5.110.d:
ततः स नीरुजो भूत्वा तोषेण महतान्वितः ..
तानुवाच मुनिश्रेष्ठान् प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 7 ..
5.110.m: Then, having become free from disease and filled with great joy, / he bowed repeatedly to those best among sages and said: // 7

5.110.s:
suvarṇaṃ vā gajāśvaṃ vā rājyaṃ sakalameva vā ..
bhavadbhyaḥ saṃpradāsyāmi tasmādabrūta dvijottamāḥ .. 8 ..
5.110.d:
सुवर्णं वा गजाश्वं वा राज्यं सकलमेव वा ..
भवद्भ्यः संप्रदास्यामि तस्मादब्रूत द्विजोत्तमाः .. 8 ..
5.110.m: 'Gold, or elephants and horses, or even the entire kingdom / I shall give to you; therefore speak, O best of the twice-born! // 8

5.110.s:
yadyasya rocate yāvanmātramanyadapi dvijāḥ ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya praṇatasya ca .. 9 ..
5.110.d:
यद्यस्य रोचते यावन्मात्रमन्यदपि द्विजाः ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां मह्यं दीनस्य प्रणतस्य च .. 9 ..
5.110.m: Whatever pleases whomsoever, however much, or anything else, O twice-born, / let grace be shown to me, wretched and bowed down [before you]!' // 9

5.110.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
niṣparigrahadharmāṇo vānaprasthā vayaṃ dvijāḥ ..
sadyaḥprakṣālakāḥ kiṃ no rājyena vibhavena ca .. 6.111.10 .. ..
5.110.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
निष्परिग्रहधर्माणो वानप्रस्था वयं द्विजाः ..
सद्यःप्रक्षालकाः किं नो राज्येन विभवेन च .. 6.111.10 .. ..
5.110.m:
The brahmins said:
'We are forest-dwelling twice-born observing the vow of non-possession, / washing our hands immediately [after receiving anything]; what have we to do with a kingdom or with wealth?' // 10

5.110.s:
.. rājovāca . ..
upakāraṃ samāsādya yaḥ karoti na pāpakṛt ..
upakāraṃ punastasya sa kṛtaghna udāhṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
5.110.d:
.. राजोवाच . ..
उपकारं समासाद्य यः करोति न पापकृत् ..
उपकारं पुनस्तस्य स कृतघ्न उदाहृतः .. 11 ..
5.110.m:
The king said:
'A sinner who, having received a favor, does not return / the favor to him, is called ungrateful. // 11

5.110.s:
brahmaghnaṃ ca surāpe ca caure bhagnava te śaṭhe ..
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ .. 12 ..
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ me kiṃcidbrūt dvijottamāḥ..
yenānṛṇyaṃ pragacchāmi yadyapi syātsujīvitam ...3..
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ..
paraṃ tatra bhaveddoṣo yatra dātā tu saspṛhaḥ...4..
niḥspṛho yatra rājendra hyupakāraparo bhavet..
na tatra jāyate doṣaḥ svalpo'pi ca kathaṃcana ...5..
5.110.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नं च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव ते शठे ..
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः .. 12 ..
तस्मात्कृत्वा प्रसादं मे किंचिद्ब्रूत् द्विजोत्तमाः..
येनानृण्यं प्रगच्छामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुजीवितम् ...3..
.. मुनय ऊचुः .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः..
परं तत्र भवेद्दोषो यत्र दाता तु सस्पृहः...4..
निःस्पृहो यत्र राजेन्द्र ह्युपकारपरो भवेत्..
न तत्र जायते दोषः स्वल्पोऽपि च कथंचन ...5..
5.110.m:
For the slayer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the rogue whose vows are broken, / expiation is prescribed by the virtuous; for the ungrateful, there is no expiation. // 12
Therefore, doing me a favor, speak something, O best of the twice-born, / by which I may attain freedom from debt, even if it cost my very life.' // 13
The sages said:
'This is true, O highly fortunate one, that for the ungrateful there is no expiation; / however, fault occurs there where the giver is full of desire. // 14
Where one who is free from desire acts to help others, O king of kings, / no fault whatsoever arises there in the least. // 15

5.110.s:
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha rājyaṃ svaṃ svadharmeṇa prapālaya ..
iha loke pare caiva yena saukhyaṃ prajāyate .. 16 ..
evaṃ sa bhūmipo viprairniṣiddhaḥ sa sahasradhā ..
kṛcchreṇa tānpraṇamyoccairjagāma svagṛhaṃ tataḥ ...7..
5.110.d:
तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ राज्यं स्वं स्वधर्मेण प्रपालय ..
इह लोके परे चैव येन सौख्यं प्रजायते .. 16 ..
एवं स भूमिपो विप्रैर्निषिद्धः स सहस्रधा ..
कृच्छ्रेण तान्प्रणम्योच्चैर्जगाम स्वगृहं ततः ...7..
5.110.m:
Therefore go to your own kingdom and protect it according to your duty, / by which happiness is produced in this world and in the next.' // 16
Thus forbidden a thousand times by the brahmins, / he bowed deeply to them with difficulty and then went to his home. // 17

5.110.s:
tatra gatvā prahṛṣṭā tmākṛtvā ramyaṃ maheśvaram ..
gītanṛtyasavādyaiśca rātrijāgaraṇādibhiḥ ..
cakāra pūrvavadrājyaṃ samaṃtāddhatakaṃṭakam .. 18 ..
5.110.d:
तत्र गत्वा प्रहृष्टा त्माकृत्वा रम्यं महेश्वरम् ..
गीतनृत्यसवाद्यैश्च रात्रिजागरणादिभिः ..
चकार पूर्ववद्राज्यं समंताद्धतकंटकम् .. 18 ..
5.110.m: Going there, gladdened in heart, having worshiped beautiful Maheśvara / with songs, dances, musical instruments, and night-vigils, / he ruled the kingdom as before, having removed all thorns around him, // 18

5.110.s:
ciṃtayāno divānaktaṃ brāhmaṇānprati tatsadā ..
kathaṃ teṣāṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāmupakāro bhaviṣyati ..
madīyo mama yairdattaṃ gātrametatpunarnavam .. 19 ..
5.110.d:
चिंतयानो दिवानक्तं ब्राह्मणान्प्रति तत्सदा ..
कथं तेषां द्विजेंद्राणामुपकारो भविष्यति ..
मदीयो मम यैर्दत्तं गात्रमेतत्पुनर्नवम् .. 19 ..
5.110.m: pondering day and night constantly concerning the brahmins: / 'How can a return of favor to those lords of the twice-born come to be, / on my part, who gave this body of mine made new again?' // 19

5.110.s:
te'pi sarve muniśreṣṭhāḥ khecaratva samanvitāḥ ..
tapaḥśaktyā yāṃti nānātīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ .. 6.111.20 ..
5.110.d:
तेऽपि सर्वे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः खेचरत्व समन्विताः ..
तपःशक्त्या यांति नानातीर्थेषु भक्तितः .. 6.111.20 ..
5.110.m: Those best of sages also, possessing the power to roam the skies / by the power of austerity, went to various tīrthas with devotion. // 20

5.110.s:
teṣu snānaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva pitṛtarpaṇam ..
prāṇayātrāṃ punaścakrustatrāgatya sva āśrame .. 21 ..
5.110.d:
तेषु स्नानं जपं कृत्वा तथैव पितृतर्पणम् ..
प्राणयात्रां पुनश्चक्रुस्तत्रागत्य स्व आश्रमे .. 21 ..
5.110.m: Having performed ritual ablution, silent recitation, and libation to the ancestors at them, / they returned to their own hermitage and attended to the maintenance of their lives. // 21

5.110.s:
anye tatraiva kurvaṃti nityakṛtyāni ye dvijāḥ ..
tathānye dūramāsādya tīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā manoharam .. 22 ..
5.110.d:
अन्ये तत्रैव कुर्वंति नित्यकृत्यानि ये द्विजाः ..
तथान्ये दूरमासाद्य तीर्थं दृष्ट्वा मनोहरम् .. 22 ..
5.110.m: Other twice-born performed their daily duties right there; / while others, having traveled far and seen a charming tīrtha, // 22

5.110.s:
uṣitvā rajanīṃ tatra dvirātraṃ vā punargṛham..
samāgacchaṃti cānye tu trirātreṇa samāyayuḥ .. 23 ..
5.110.d:
उषित्वा रजनीं तत्र द्विरात्रं वा पुनर्गृहम्..
समागच्छंति चान्ये तु त्रिरात्रेण समाययुः .. 23 ..
5.110.m: and having stayed there for one night or two nights, returned home; / and yet others returned after three nights. // 23

5.110.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge vā puṣkare vātha naimiṣe ..
prabhāse vā'tha kedāre hyanyasminnahi vāṃchyate .. 24 ..
5.110.d:
वाराणस्यां प्रयागे वा पुष्करे वाथ नैमिषे ..
प्रभासे वाऽथ केदारे ह्यन्यस्मिन्नहि वांछ्यते .. 24 ..
5.110.m: In Vārāṇasī, or Prayāga, or Puṣkara, or Naimiṣa, / or Prabhāsa, or Kedāra, or anywhere else that was desired. // 24

5.110.s:
kadācidatha te sarve kārtikyāṃ puṣkaratraye ..
gatā viniścayaṃ kṛtvā snānārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 25 ..
5.110.d:
कदाचिदथ ते सर्वे कार्तिक्यां पुष्करत्रये ..
गता विनिश्चयं कृत्वा स्नानार्थं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 25 ..
5.110.m: Then once, on the full-moon day of Kārttika, all those best of the twice-born / went to the three Puṣkaras, having resolved: // 25

5.110.s:
paṃcarātraṃ vasiṣyāmo vayaṃ tatra samāhitāḥ ..
tasmādvahniṣu dāreṣu rakṣā kāryā svaśaktitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.110.d:
पंचरात्रं वसिष्यामो वयं तत्र समाहिताः ..
तस्माद्वह्निषु दारेषु रक्षा कार्या स्वशक्तितः .. 26 ..
5.110.m: 'We shall dwell there for five nights with concentrated minds; / therefore, protection of the fires and the wives must be maintained according to one's power.' // 26

5.110.s:
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā gatā yāvaddvijottamāḥ..
tāvaddha patinā jñātā na kaścittatra tiṣṭhati . 27 ..
5.110.d:
एवं ते समयं कृत्वा गता यावद्द्विजोत्तमाः..
तावद्ध पतिना ज्ञाता न कश्चित्तत्र तिष्ठति . 27 ..
5.110.m: When, having made an agreement, those best of the twice-born had thus departed, / it was known by the king that no [sage] was staying there. // 27

5.110.s:
teṣāṃ madhye munīṃdrāṇāṃ sutīrthāśramavāsinām ..
damayaṃtīti vikhyātā caṃdrabiṃbasamānanā .. 28 ...
5.110.d:
तेषां मध्ये मुनींद्राणां सुतीर्थाश्रमवासिनाम् ..
दमयंतीति विख्याता चंद्रबिंबसमानना .. 28 ...
5.110.m: Among those foremost of sages living in the hermitage of the holy tīrtha, / [there was a maid] known as Damayantī, whose face was like the lunar disc. // 28

5.110.s:
tāmuvāca rahasyevaṃ vraja tvaṃ cāruhāsini.
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mamādeśo'dhunā dhruvam .. 29 ..
5.110.d:
तामुवाच रहस्येवं व्रज त्वं चारुहासिनि.
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे ममादेशोऽधुना ध्रुवम् .. 29 ..
5.110.m: In secret he said to her: 'Go, O sweetly smiling woman, / into the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara; my order is now firm. // 29

5.110.s:
tatra tiṣṭhaṃti yāḥ patnyo munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ...
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi tāsāṃ yaccha yathecchayā .. 6.111.30 ..
5.110.d:
तत्र तिष्ठंति याः पत्न्यो मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ...
भूषणानि विचित्राणि तासां यच्छ यथेच्छया .. 6.111.30 ..
5.110.m: The wives of the pure-souled sages who dwell there— / give varied ornaments to them as they desire. // 30

5.110.s:
na tāsāṃ patayo'smākaṃ prakurvaṃti pratigraham ..
kathaṃcidapi suśroṇi lobhyamānāpi bhūriśaḥ .. 31 ..
5.110.d:
न तासां पतयोऽस्माकं प्रकुर्वंति प्रतिग्रहम् ..
कथंचिदपि सुश्रोणि लोभ्यमानापि भूरिशः .. 31 ..
5.110.m: Their husbands do not accept gifts from us / in any manner, O fair-hipped one, even though tempted repeatedly. // 31

5.110.s:
strīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇajā cintā sadā caivādhikā bhavet ..
laulyaṃ ca kautukaṃ caiva sadā bhūṣaṇajaṃ bhavet .. 32 ..
5.110.d:
स्त्रीणां भूषणजा चिन्ता सदा चैवाधिका भवेत् ..
लौल्यं च कौतुकं चैव सदा भूषणजं भवेत् .. 32 ..
5.110.m: For women, concern for ornaments is always very great; / eagerness and delight always arise from ornaments. // 32

5.110.s:
api mṛnmayakaṃ kiṃcitkāṣṭhasūtramayaṃ ca vā ..
jatukācamayaṃ vāpi nārī dhatte vibhūṣaṇam .. 33 ..
5.110.d:
अपि मृन्मयकं किंचित्काष्ठसूत्रमयं च वा ..
जतुकाचमयं वापि नारी धत्ते विभूषणम् .. 33 ..
5.110.m: Even an ornament made of clay, or made of wood and thread, / or made of lacquer and glass, a woman puts on. // 33

5.110.s:
eṣa eva bhavetteṣāmupakārasyasaṃbhavaḥ ..
upāyaḥ padmapatrākṣi na cānyo'sti kathaṃcana .. 34 ..
5.110.d:
एष एव भवेत्तेषामुपकारस्यसंभवः ..
उपायः पद्मपत्राक्षि न चान्योऽस्ति कथंचन .. 34 ..
5.110.m: This alone could be the way to render a service to them, / O lotus-petal-eyed one; there is no other means whatsoever.' // 34

5.110.s:
sā tatheti pratijñāya vicitrābharaṇāni ca ..
gṛhītvā harṣasaṃyukā tatastatkṣetramāyayau ..35..
5.110.d:
सा तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय विचित्राभरणानि च ..
गृहीत्वा हर्षसंयुका ततस्तत्क्षेत्रमाययौ ..35..
5.110.m: She, having agreed, saying 'So be it,' and taking various ornaments, / went with joy to that sacred field: // 35

5.110.s:
maṇimuktāmayānyeva kuṇḍalāni śubhāni ca ..
tathā candrojjvalāhārānnūpurāṇi bṛhaṃti ca .. 36 ..
5.110.d:
मणिमुक्तामयान्येव कुण्डलानि शुभानि च ..
तथा चन्द्रोज्ज्वलाहारान्नूपुराणि बृहंति च .. 36 ..
5.110.m: Auspicious earrings made of gems and pearls, / necklaces shining like the moon, large anklets, // 36

5.110.s:
indranīlamahānīlavaiḍūryakhacitāni ca .
padmarāgaistathā vajrairmāṇikyaiśca manoramaiḥ..37..
5.110.d:
इन्द्रनीलमहानीलवैडूर्यखचितानि च .
पद्मरागैस्तथा वज्रैर्माणिक्यैश्च मनोरमैः..37..
5.110.m: and [ornaments] inlaid with sapphires, dark-blue lapis, cat's-eyes, / rubies, diamonds, and delightful pearls, // 37

5.110.s:
keśaiḥ kaṃkaṇairdivyaiḥ śakracāpanibhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
hemasūtraiśca jātyaiśca mekhalābhistathaiva ca .. 38 ..
5.110.d:
केशैः कंकणैर्दिव्यैः शक्रचापनिभैः शुभैः ..
हेमसूत्रैश्च जात्यैश्च मेखलाभिस्तथैव च .. 38 ..
5.110.m: [hair-ornaments for] hair, divine and auspicious bangles resembling Indra's rainbow, / and golden cords of pure breed, and girdles as well. // 38

5.110.s:
atha sā bodhane viṣṇoḥ saṃprāpte divase śubhe .
upavāsaparā snātā ekasminsalilāśaye .. 39 ..
5.110.d:
अथ सा बोधने विष्णोः संप्राप्ते दिवसे शुभे .
उपवासपरा स्नाता एकस्मिन्सलिलाशये .. 39 ..
5.110.m: Then, when the auspicious day of the awakening of Viṣṇu had arrived, / devoted to fasting, she bathed in a single body of water, // 39

5.110.s:
tīradeśe niveśyaiva mahābhūṣaṇaparvatam ..
yasya prabhābhirugrābhirvyāptaṃ gaganamaṃḍalam .. 6.111.40 ..
5.110.d:
तीरदेशे निवेश्यैव महाभूषणपर्वतम् ..
यस्य प्रभाभिरुग्राभिर्व्याप्तं गगनमंडलम् .. 6.111.40 ..
5.110.m: placing on the shore a veritable mountain of great ornaments, / by whose fierce radiance the circle of the sky was pervaded. // 40

5.110.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāstāpasyaḥ kautukānvitāḥ ..
kīdṛśā rājapatnī sā kiṃrūpā kiṃvibhūṣaṇā .. 41 ..
5.110.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तास्तापस्यः कौतुकान्विताः ..
कीदृशा राजपत्नी सा किंरूपा किंविभूषणा .. 41 ..
5.110.m: In the meantime, female ascetics arrived, filled with curiosity: / “What is that king’s wife like? What form does she have, and what ornaments?”

5.110.s:
atha tāstāṃ samālokya divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām..
surūpāṃgīṃ samādhisthāṃ citte cintāṃ pracakrire .. 42 ..
5.110.d:
अथ तास्तां समालोक्य दिव्यभूषणभूषिताम्..
सुरूपांगीं समाधिस्थां चित्ते चिन्तां प्रचक्रिरे .. 42 ..
5.110.m: Then, seeing her adorned with divine ornaments, / possessing beautiful limbs, and seated in deep meditation, they felt astonishment in their minds:

5.110.s:
dhanyeyaṃ bhūpaterbhāryā yaivaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ..
damayaṃtī surūpāḍhyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 43 ..
5.110.d:
धन्येयं भूपतेर्भार्या यैवं भूषणभूषिता ..
दमयंती सुरूपाढ्या सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता .. 43 ..
5.110.m: “Blessed is this wife of the king, who is thus adorned with ornaments! / Damayantī is richly endowed with great beauty, marked with all auspicious marks.”

5.110.s:
samādhyaṃtaṃ samāsādya tāpasīrvīkṣya sā'pi ca ..
damayaṃtī namaścakre tāḥ sarvā vidhipūrvakam .. 44 ..
5.110.d:
समाध्यंतं समासाद्य तापसीर्वीक्ष्य साऽपि च ..
दमयंती नमश्चक्रे ताः सर्वा विधिपूर्वकम् .. 44 ..
5.110.m: Coming to the end of her meditation and seeing the female ascetics, / Damayantī too bowed down to all of them in accordance with proper rule.

5.110.s:
tāḥ kṛtāṃjalinā prāha valguvākyaṃ manoharam ..
mayāyaṃ bhūṣaṇastoma uddiśya garuḍadhvajam..
kalpito'dya dine snātvā samupoṣya dine hareḥ .. 45 ..
5.110.d:
ताः कृतांजलिना प्राह वल्गुवाक्यं मनोहरम् ..
मयायं भूषणस्तोम उद्दिश्य गरुडध्वजम्..
कल्पितोऽद्य दिने स्नात्वा समुपोष्य दिने हरेः .. 45 ..
5.110.m: With folded hands, she spoke pleasing and charming words to them: / “This heap of ornaments was set apart by me for the Garuda-bannered [Viṣṇu] / today, having bathed and fasted on the day of Hari.

5.110.s:
tasmādgṛhṇaṃtu tāpasyo mayā dattāni vāṃchayā ...
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama .. 46 ..
5.110.d:
तस्माद्गृह्णंतु तापस्यो मया दत्तानि वांछया ...
भूषणानि विचित्राणि प्रसादः क्रियतां मम .. 46 ..
5.110.m: Therefore, let the female ascetics accept these varied ornaments / given by me with desire [to offer them]; may favor be shown to me.”

5.110.s:
tataścaikā'bravīttāsāmeṣā muktāvalī mama ..
imāṃ dehi na me vāṃchā vidyate'nyā nṛpapriye..47..
5.110.d:
ततश्चैकाऽब्रवीत्तासामेषा मुक्तावली मम ..
इमां देहि न मे वांछा विद्यतेऽन्या नृपप्रिये..47..
5.110.m: Then one among them said: “This pearl necklace is mine. / Give this one to me; I have no other desire, O beloved of the king!”

5.110.s:
tatastayā vihasyoccaiḥ prakṣālya caraṇau svayam..
dattā muktāvalī tasyā vastrairdivyaiḥ samanvitā ..
yasyāḥ ṣaṇmāṣatulyāni mauktikānyamalāni ca .. 48 ..
5.110.d:
ततस्तया विहस्योच्चैः प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ स्वयम्..
दत्ता मुक्तावली तस्या वस्त्रैर्दिव्यैः समन्विता ..
यस्याः षण्माषतुल्यानि मौक्तिकान्यमलानि च .. 48 ..
5.110.m: Then, smiling broadly and having washed her feet herself, / she gave her the pearl necklace along with divine garments, / the pearls of which were each equal to six māṣas and spotless.

5.110.s:
śaratkāle yathā vyomni nakṣatrāṇi dvijottamāḥ..
tathānyā sparddhayā yuktā yayāce'malavarcasam..
hāraṃ nirmūlyatāyuktaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param .. .. 49 ..
5.110.d:
शरत्काले यथा व्योम्नि नक्षत्राणि द्विजोत्तमाः..
तथान्या स्पर्द्धया युक्ता ययाचेऽमलवर्चसम्..
हारं निर्मूल्यतायुक्तं चित्ताह्लादकरं परम् .. .. 49 ..
5.110.m: O best of brahmins, just as stars shine in the autumn sky, / so another [woman], filled with rivalry, asked for an intensely bright necklace, / priceless and exceedingly delightful to the heart.

5.110.s:
atha sā taṃ kare kṛtvā tasyā hāraṃ prayacchati ..
tāvadanyā prajagrāha hāraṃ śṛṃgāralālasā .. 6.111.50 ..
5.110.d:
अथ सा तं करे कृत्वा तस्या हारं प्रयच्छति ..
तावदन्या प्रजग्राह हारं शृंगारलालसा .. 6.111.50 ..
5.110.m: Then, taking it in her hand, she was giving the necklace to her, / when another woman, eager for adornment, seized that necklace.

5.110.s:
tataḥ śeṣāśca tāpasyo bhūṣaṇārthaṃ samutsukāḥ ..
sasparddhā jagṛhustāni bhūṣaṇāni svayaṃ dvijāḥ .. 51 ..
5.110.d:
ततः शेषाश्च तापस्यो भूषणार्थं समुत्सुकाः ..
सस्पर्द्धा जगृहुस्तानि भूषणानि स्वयं द्विजाः .. 51 ..
5.110.m: Then the remaining female ascetics, eager for ornaments, / seized those ornaments themselves with rivalry, O brahmins.

5.110.s:
anyāścānyākare kṛtvā bhūṣaṇaṃ sumanoharam ..
balādākṛṣya jagrāha dharṣayitvā tataḥ param.. 52 ..
5.110.d:
अन्याश्चान्याकरे कृत्वा भूषणं सुमनोहरम् ..
बलादाकृष्य जग्राह धर्षयित्वा ततः परम्.. 52 ..
5.110.m: When an ornament had been placed in another’s hand, another [woman] / pulled it away by force, having overpowered her thereafter.

5.110.s:
yathāyathā pragṛhṇaṃti tāpasyo bhūṣaṇārcitāḥ ..
tathātathāsyāḥ saṃjajñe damayaṃtyā mudā hṛdi .. 53 ..
5.110.d:
यथायथा प्रगृह्णंति तापस्यो भूषणार्चिताः ..
तथातथास्याः संजज्ञे दमयंत्या मुदा हृदि .. 53 ..
5.110.m: The more the female ascetics took [the gifts], honoured with ornaments, / the more joy arose in the heart of Damayantī.

5.110.s:
anyāni ca pracikṣepa śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ..
na tṛptirjāyate tāsāṃ tathāpi dvijasattamāḥ ..54..
5.110.d:
अन्यानि च प्रचिक्षेप शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ..
न तृप्तिर्जायते तासां तथापि द्विजसत्तमाः ..54..
5.110.m: And she distributed others by hundreds and by thousands; / yet even then no satisfaction arose in them, O best of brahmins.

5.110.s:
bhūṣaṇābhāvamāsādya tataḥ sā pārthivapriyā ..
hṛṣṭā provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃtoṣaḥ kriyatāmiti..55..
5.110.d:
भूषणाभावमासाद्य ततः सा पार्थिवप्रिया ..
हृष्टा प्रोवाच ताः सर्वाः संतोषः क्रियतामिति..55..
5.110.m: Then, when the ornaments had run out, that beloved of the king, / delighted, said to them all: “Let satisfaction be had!

5.110.s:
punaścaivānayiṣyāmi prabhāte nātra saṃśayaḥ..
anyāni ca vicitrāṇi yasyā rocaṃti yāni ca..56..
5.110.d:
पुनश्चैवानयिष्यामि प्रभाते नात्र संशयः..
अन्यानि च विचित्राणि यस्या रोचंति यानि च..56..
5.110.m: I shall bring more again in the morning, without any doubt, / and other varied ones, whichever pleases each [of you].”

5.110.s:
tatastāḥ sakalāḥ procurgaccha tvaṃ pārthivapriye..
āgaṃtavyaṃ ca bhūyo'pi pragṛhyābharaṇāni ca .. 57 ..
5.110.d:
ततस्ताः सकलाः प्रोचुर्गच्छ त्वं पार्थिवप्रिये..
आगंतव्यं च भूयोऽपि प्रगृह्याभरणानि च .. 57 ..
5.110.m: Then they all said: “Go, O beloved of the king; / you must come again, having brought ornaments!”

5.110.s:
evamuktā tatastābhiḥ praṇipatya nṛpapriyā ..
prahṛṣṭā prayayau tūrṇaṃ svapuraṃ prati saddvijāḥ .. 58 ..
5.110.d:
एवमुक्ता ततस्ताभिः प्रणिपत्य नृपप्रिया ..
प्रहृष्टा प्रययौ तूर्णं स्वपुरं प्रति सद्द्विजाः .. 58 ..
5.110.m: Thus addressed by them, the king’s beloved bowed down, / and, overjoyed, went quickly to her own city, O good brahmins.

5.110.s:
tāpasyopi gṛhaṃ gatvā vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
bhūṣaṇāni ca gātreṣu sasparddhā nidadhustadā .. 59 ..
5.110.d:
तापस्योपि गृहं गत्वा वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ..
भूषणानि च गात्रेषु सस्पर्द्धा निदधुस्तदा .. 59 ..
5.110.m: The female ascetics too went home and, with rivalry, / placed the various garments and ornaments upon their bodies.

5.110.s:
tāpasīnāṃ catuṣkaṃ ca parityajya yatavratam ..
śeṣābhiḥ pragṛhītāni maṇḍanāni yathecchayā .. 6.111.60 ..
5.110.d:
तापसीनां चतुष्कं च परित्यज्य यतव्रतम् ..
शेषाभिः प्रगृहीतानि मण्डनानि यथेच्छया .. 6.111.60 ..
5.110.m: Except for a group of four female ascetics who held to their vows, / ornaments were taken by all the rest according to their desire.

5.110.s:

5.110.m: These four have arrived [first], whose wives / did not make any acceptance of a gift from that king’s wicked wife.

5.110.m:
Because this hermitage of ascetics was thereby disgraced, / therefore may you become despicable, turned into the form of a rock!”
Then, at that very moment, she indeed turned into the form of a rock, / motionless at that very moment, immediately following the words of the sage.
Then her retinue, bewildered by sorrow on her account, / with eyes filled with tears, departed despondent toward their own city.
O best of brahmins, [they] related all that occurrence concerning Damayantī, / the tale concerning her curse.
Hearing that tale born of the curse at that time, that king quickly / went to the forest in sorrow in order to propitiate the brahmins.
Then those four sages, quickly / learning that the king had approached to propitiate [them] for his wife's sake,
took their sacred fires and wives, and straightway / went swiftly through the sky to Kurukṣetra then.

5.110.m:
The king, too, having sought those sages everywhere with great effort, / became dejected, afflicted with weariness, and grieved by his wife's misfortune.
Then he went to that place where his wife turned to stone / remained, surrounded on all sides by crowds of ascetic women.
Then, seeing her in such a state, surrounded by all his attendants, / he cried out repeatedly, “Alas, alas!” and fell swooning to the earth.
Then, having regained consciousness with difficulty after being sprinkled with water, / he wept aloud, constantly remembering his beloved's virtues:
“Alas, my beloved, fawn-eyed lady, who takes away my life! / Where have you gone today, beautiful-faced one, leaving me, your loving husband?
You never ate while I had not eaten; you never went to sleep while I was awake; / you never transgressed my command out of pride in your good fortune.
I do not recall any improper word ever spoken by you, / even in private, large-eyed lady, much less in an assembly at dinner.”

5.110.m:
Sūta said: / While the king was lamenting thus with great sorrow, / his ministers arrived, having heard that the king was in such a state.
Then, comforting him with difficulty by means of many extensive examples / of ancient royal seers who had met with great calamities,
they led that wretched king away, his eyes blurred with tears, / sighing like a serpent, devoid of his splendor.
He, too, having built a very lovely abode around her on all sides, / adorned his wife, even though standing in the form of stone, / with incense of camphor, agallochum, and the like, with garments, kumkuma, and sandalwood paste.
Thus ends the one hundred and eleventh chapter, entitled “The Narration of the King of Ānarta's Grief upon Damayantī Turning to Stone through the Brahmin's Curse,” in the story of Damayantī, in the māhātmya of the sacred field of the holy Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.111.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः कतिपयाहस्य गते तस्मिन्महीपतौ ..
स्वगृहं प्रति दुःखार्ते परिवारसमन्विते .. 1 ..
5.111.m: Sūta said: / Then, after a few days had passed when that king, / afflicted with sorrow, had departed toward his home along with his retinue,

5.111.s:
padbhyāmeva samāyātā hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭirdvijottamāḥ ..
pariśrāṃtāḥ kṛśāṃgāśca dhūlidhūsaritānanāḥ .. 2 ..
5.111.d:
पद्भ्यामेव समायाता ह्यष्टषष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
परिश्रांताः कृशांगाश्च धूलिधूसरिताननाः .. 2 ..
5.111.m: the sixty-eight best brahmins arrived on foot, / exhausted, their bodies emaciated, and their faces gray with dust.

5.111.s:
yāvatpaśyati dārāḥ svā divyābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ ..
divyavastraiḥ susaṃvītā rājapatnya ivāparāḥ .. 3 ..
5.111.d:
यावत्पश्यति दाराः स्वा दिव्याभरण भूषिताः ..
दिव्यवस्त्रैः सुसंवीता राजपत्न्य इवापराः .. 3 ..
5.111.m: When [each] looked, [he saw] his wives adorned with divine ornaments, / beautifully clad in divine garments, like other queens.

5.111.s:
tataśca vismayāviṣṭāḥ papracchuste kṣudhānvitāḥ ..
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ pāpā viruddhaṃ vihitaṃ vapuḥ .. 4 ..
5.111.d:
ततश्च विस्मयाविष्टाः पप्रच्छुस्ते क्षुधान्विताः ..
किमिदं किमिदं पापा विरुद्धं विहितं वपुः .. 4 ..
5.111.m: Then, seized with astonishment, hungry as they were, they asked: / “What is this? What is this, sinful women? Why have your bodies been made improper?

5.111.s:
kathaṃ prāptāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni varāṇi ca ..
nūnamasmadgaterbhraṃśaḥ khe jāto nā'nyathā bhavet .. 5 ..
5.111.d:
कथं प्राप्तानि वस्त्राणि भूषणानि वराणि च ..
नूनमस्मद्गतेर्भ्रंशः खे जातो नाऽन्यथा भवेत् .. 5 ..
5.111.m: How were these garments and fine ornaments obtained? / Surely our power to travel in the sky has been lost; it cannot be otherwise.

5.111.s:
vikāramenaṃ saṃtyaktvā yuṣmadīyaṃ sugarhitāḥ..
atha tāḥ sarvavṛttāṃtamūcustāpasayoṣitaḥ..6..
5.111.d:
विकारमेनं संत्यक्त्वा युष्मदीयं सुगर्हिताः..
अथ ताः सर्ववृत्तांतमूचुस्तापसयोषितः..6..
5.111.m: Abandon this transformation of yours, utterly contemptible women!” / Then those wives of the ascetics told the entire account:

5.111.s:
yathā rājñī samāyātā damayantī nṛpapriyā..
bhūṣaṇāni ca dattāni tayā caiva yathā dvijāḥ .. 7..
5.111.d:
यथा राज्ञी समायाता दमयन्ती नृपप्रिया..
भूषणानि च दत्तानि तया चैव यथा द्विजाः .. 7..
5.111.m: how Queen Damayantī, the king's beloved, had arrived, / and how, O twice-born, the ornaments had been given by her;

5.111.s:
yathā śāpaśca sañjāto brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām..
atha te munayaḥ kruddhāstacchrutvā garhitaṃ vacaḥ ..
rājapratigraho niṃdyastāpasānāṃ viśeṣataḥ..8..
5.111.d:
यथा शापश्च सञ्जातो ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्..
अथ ते मुनयः क्रुद्धास्तच्छ्रुत्वा गर्हितं वचः ..
राजप्रतिग्रहो निंद्यस्तापसानां विशेषतः..8..
5.111.m: and how the curse of the high-souled brahmins had occurred. / Then those sages, enraged upon hearing those despicable words, [thought:] / “Accepting gifts from a king is blameworthy, especially for ascetics.”

5.111.s:
tato bhūpasya rāṣṭrasya nāśārthaṃ jagṛhurjalam..
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā vepamānā nirargalam..9..
5.111.d:
ततो भूपस्य राष्ट्रस्य नाशार्थं जगृहुर्जलम्..
क्रोधेन महताविष्टा वेपमाना निरर्गलम्..9..
5.111.m: Then, to destroy the king and his realm, they took up water, / seized by great anger, trembling unrestrainedly:

5.111.s:
anena pāpmanā'smākaṃ kubhūpena praṇāśitā..
khe gatirlobhayitvā tu patnyo'smākamakṛtrimāḥ ..
saralāstadgaṇāḥ sarve yenedṛgvyasanaṃ sthitam ....6.112.10..
5.111.d:
अनेन पाप्मनाऽस्माकं कुभूपेन प्रणाशिता..
खे गतिर्लोभयित्वा तु पत्न्योऽस्माकमकृत्रिमाः ..
सरलास्तद्गणाः सर्वे येनेदृग्व्यसनं स्थितम् ....6.112.10..
5.111.m: “By this wicked man, this evil king, our movement / in the sky has been destroyed, having seduced our wives who were artless / and straightforward, together with all their companions, whereby such a calamity has occurred!”

5.111.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ te munayo yāvacchāpaṃ tasya mahīpateḥ..
prayacchaṃti ca tāstāvadūcurbhāryā ruṣānvitāḥ .. 11 ..
5.111.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ते मुनयो यावच्छापं तस्य महीपतेः..
प्रयच्छंति च तास्तावदूचुर्भार्या रुषान्विताः .. 11 ..
5.111.m: Sūta said: / While those sages were just about to pronounce / the curse upon that king, their wives, filled with anger, said to them:

5.111.s:
na deyo bhūpatestasya śāpo brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
asmadīyaṃ vacastāvacchrotavyamaviśaṃkitaiḥ ...12..
5.111.d:
न देयो भूपतेस्तस्य शापो ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
अस्मदीयं वचस्तावच्छ्रोतव्यमविशंकितैः ...12..
5.111.m: “The curse must not be given to that king, O best of brahmins! / First, our words should be heard by you without doubt.

5.111.s:
vayaṃ sarvā narendrasya bhāryayā samalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
suvastrairbhūṣaṇairdivyaiḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 13 ..
5.111.d:
वयं सर्वा नरेन्द्रस्य भार्यया समलंकृताः ..
सुवस्त्रैर्भूषणैर्दिव्यैः श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 13 ..
5.111.m: All of us were adorned by the king's wife / with fine garments and divine ornaments with a heart purified by faith.

5.111.s:
vayaṃ daridradoṣeṇa sadā yuṣmadgṛhe sthitāḥ ..
karśitā na ca saṃprāptaṃ sukhaṃ martyasamu dbhavam ..14..
5.111.d:
वयं दरिद्रदोषेण सदा युष्मद्गृहे स्थिताः ..
कर्शिता न च संप्राप्तं सुखं मर्त्यसमु द्भवम् ..14..
5.111.m: Dwelling constantly in your home through the fault of poverty, / we have been emaciated, and no earthly happiness has been attained [by us].

5.111.s:
eteṣāṃ paraloko'tra vidyate ye taporatāḥ ..
na ca martyaphalaṃ kiṃcidapi svalpataraṃ bhavet ..15..
5.111.d:
एतेषां परलोकोऽत्र विद्यते ये तपोरताः ..
न च मर्त्यफलं किंचिदपि स्वल्पतरं भवेत् ..15..
5.111.m: For those who are devoted to austerity here, the other world exists; / there is not even the slightest earthly fruit for them.

5.111.s:
anyeṣāṃ viṣayasthānāmiha lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
bhogaprasaktacittānāṃ nīcānāṃ sudurātmanām .. 16 ..
5.111.d:
अन्येषां विषयस्थानामिह लोकः प्रकीर्तितः ..
भोगप्रसक्तचित्तानां नीचानां सुदुरात्मनाम् .. 16 ..
5.111.m: For other people who dwell in worldly pleasures, this world is proclaimed, / for those vile, exceedingly wicked people whose minds are attached to enjoyment.

5.111.s:
gṛhasthāśramiṇāṃ caiva svadharmaratacetasām ..
iha lokaḥ paraścaiva jāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ..17..
5.111.d:
गृहस्थाश्रमिणां चैव स्वधर्मरतचेतसाम् ..
इह लोकः परश्चैव जायते नाऽत्र संशयः ..17..
5.111.m: For householders whose minds are devoted to their own duty, / there is both this world and the next; of this there is no doubt.

5.111.s:
tā vayaṃ nātra sandeho gṛhasthāśramamuttamam ..
saṃsevya sādhayiṣyāmo lokadvayamanuttamam ..18..
5.111.d:
ता वयं नात्र सन्देहो गृहस्थाश्रममुत्तमम् ..
संसेव्य साधयिष्यामो लोकद्वयमनुत्तमम् ..18..
5.111.m: So we, having practiced the excellent householder stage of life—there is no doubt about this— / shall attain both peerless worlds.

5.111.s:
tasmādgṛhāṇi ramyāṇi pravadaṃti samāhitāḥ ..
bhūpālādbhūmimādāya vṛttiṃ caivābhivāṃchitām .. 19 ..
5.111.d:
तस्माद्गृहाणि रम्याणि प्रवदंति समाहिताः ..
भूपालाद्भूमिमादाय वृत्तिं चैवाभिवांछिताम् .. 19 ..
5.111.m: Therefore, with collected minds, declare [your desire for] delightful houses, / having taken land and the desired livelihood from the king!

5.111.s:
tataścaivātha vīkṣadhvaṃ putrapautrasamudbhavam ..
saukhyaṃ cāpi kumārīṇāṃ bāṃdhavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 6.112.20 ..
5.111.d:
ततश्चैवाथ वीक्षध्वं पुत्रपौत्रसमुद्भवम् ..
सौख्यं चापि कुमारीणां बांधवानां विशेषतः .. 6.112.20 ..
5.111.m: And then behold the happiness arising from sons and grandsons, / as well as of unmarried daughters, and especially of kinsmen!

5.111.s:
na kariṣyatha cedvākyametadasmadudīritam ..
sarvāḥ prāṇaparityāgaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ .. 21 ..
5.111.d:
न करिष्यथ चेद्वाक्यमेतदस्मदुदीरितम् ..
सर्वाः प्राणपरित्यागं करिष्यामो न संशयः .. 21 ..
5.111.m: If you do not carry out this speech uttered by us, / all of us will abandon our lives, there is no doubt.

5.111.s:
yūyaṃ strīvadhapāpena yuktāḥ santastataḥ param .
narakaṃ rauravaṃ durgaṃ gamiṣyatha suniścitam ..22..
5.111.d:
यूयं स्त्रीवधपापेन युक्ताः सन्तस्ततः परम् .
नरकं रौरवं दुर्गं गमिष्यथ सुनिश्चितम् ..22..
5.111.m: Then, being joined with the sin of killing women, / you will most certainly go to the terrible Raurava hell!”

5.111.s:
evaṃ te munayaḥ śrutvā tāsāṃ vākyāni tāni vai ..
bhūpṛṣṭhe tatyajustoyaṃ śāpārthaṃ yatkarairdhṛtam ..23..
5.111.d:
एवं ते मुनयः श्रुत्वा तासां वाक्यानि तानि वै ..
भूपृष्ठे तत्यजुस्तोयं शापार्थं यत्करैर्धृतम् ..23..
5.111.m: When those sages heard those words of theirs, / they cast onto the surface of the earth the water that was held in their hands for the curse.

5.111.s:
tatastattoyanirdagdhaṃ tadvibhāgaṃ kṣitestadā ..
ūṣaratvamanuprāptamadyāpi dvijasattamāḥ .. 24 ..
5.111.d:
ततस्तत्तोयनिर्दग्धं तद्विभागं क्षितेस्तदा ..
ऊषरत्वमनुप्राप्तमद्यापि द्विजसत्तमाः .. 24 ..
5.111.m: Then that portion of the earth scorched by that water, / O best of the twice-born, became barren land even to this day.

5.111.s:
āstāmannādikaṃ tatra yadutpaṃ na prarohati ..
na janma cāpnuyādbhūyaḥ pakṣī vā kīṭa eva vā .. 25 ..
5.111.d:
आस्तामन्नादिकं तत्र यदुत्पं न प्ररोहति ..
न जन्म चाप्नुयाद्भूयः पक्षी वा कीट एव वा .. 25 ..
5.111.m: Leaving aside grain and the like, whatever is sown there does not sprout; / neither bird nor insect attains rebirth there,

5.111.s:
tṛṇaṃ vātha mṛgastatra kiṃ punarbhaktimānnaraḥ ..
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ śraddhayā phālgune naraḥ .. 26 ..
5.111.d:
तृणं वाथ मृगस्तत्र किं पुनर्भक्तिमान्नरः ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं श्रद्धया फाल्गुने नरः .. 26 ..
5.111.m: nor grass nor deer there—how much less a devout man? / A man who performs a śrāddha there with faith in the month of Phālguna,

5.111.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ravairvāre sa pitṝnuddharennijān ..
api svakarmaṇā prāptānnarake dāruṇākṛtau .. 27 ..
5.111.d:
पौर्णमास्यां रवैर्वारे स पितॄनुद्धरेन्निजान् ..
अपि स्वकर्मणा प्राप्तान्नरके दारुणाकृतौ .. 27 ..
5.111.m: on the full moon day on a Sunday, delivers his ancestors, / even if they have arrived in terrible hell on account of their own deeds.

5.111.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye damayantyupākhyāna ūṣarotpattimāhātmyakathanaṃnāma dvādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 112 ..
5.111.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दमयन्त्युपाख्यान ऊषरोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यकथनंनाम द्वादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 112 ..
5.111.m: Thus ends the one hundred and twelfth chapter, entitled 'Narration of the Māhātmya of the Origin of the Saline Land in the Episode of Damayantī,' in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.112.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve gatakopā dadhurmatim ..
yajñakarmasu gārhasthye putrapautrasamudbhave .. 1 ..
5.112.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे गतकोपा दधुर्मतिम् ..
यज्ञकर्मसु गार्हस्थ्ये पुत्रपौत्रसमुद्भवे .. 1 ..
5.112.m: Sūta said: / Then all those brahmins, their anger gone, set their minds / upon sacrificial rites, householdership, and the begetting of sons and grandsons. // 1

5.112.s:
etasminnaṃtare rājā sa tānprāptāndvijottamān..
śrutvā bhakti samāyuktaḥ praṇāmārthamupāgataḥ .. 2 ..
5.112.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा स तान्प्राप्तान्द्विजोत्तमान्..
श्रुत्वा भक्ति समायुक्तः प्रणामार्थमुपागतः .. 2 ..
5.112.m: In the meantime, the king, hearing that those best of brahmins had arrived, / came forward filled with devotion to bow before them. // 2

5.112.s:
śrutvā kopagatāṃ vārtāmupaśāmakṛtāṃ tathā ..
gārhasthyāpratipannānāṃ vākyairbhāryāsamudbhavaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.112.d:
श्रुत्वा कोपगतां वार्तामुपशामकृतां तथा ..
गार्हस्थ्याप्रतिपन्नानां वाक्यैर्भार्यासमुद्भवैः .. 3 ..
5.112.m: He had heard the news of their anger having departed and of their pacification, / as they embraced the householder's life through the words of his wife. // 3

5.112.s:
tataḥ praṇamya tānsarvānsāṣṭāṃgaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ..
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ provāca vinataḥ sthitaḥ .. 4 ..
5.112.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तान्सर्वान्साष्टांगं स महीपतिः ..
ततः कृतांजलिपुटः प्रोवाच विनतः स्थितः .. 4 ..
5.112.m: Then the lord of the earth, having prostrated himself before all of them with eight limbs touching the ground, / stood bowed low with folded hands and spoke: // 4

5.112.s:
yuṣmadīyaprasādena saṃprāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam ..
mayā rogavināśena tasmādbrūta karomi kim .. 5 ..
5.112.d:
युष्मदीयप्रसादेन संप्राप्तं जन्मनः फलम् ..
मया रोगविनाशेन तस्माद्ब्रूत करोमि किम् .. 5 ..
5.112.m: "By your grace, the purpose of my life has been attained, / through the destruction of my disease; therefore tell me, what shall I do?" // 5

5.112.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
