bhāryayā tava rājeṃdra vayaṃ sarvatra vāsinaḥ ..
nītāḥ kṛtārthatāṃ dattvā ratnāni vividhāni ca.. 6 ..
5.112.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
भार्यया तव राजेंद्र वयं सर्वत्र वासिनः ..
नीताः कृतार्थतां दत्त्वा रत्नानि विविधानि च.. 6 ..
5.112.m: The brahmins said: / "O king of kings, by your wife we, who dwelt everywhere, / have been brought to fulfillment, having been given varied gems. // 6

5.112.s:
tasmātpuravaraṃ kṛtvā kṣetre'traiva suśobhane ..
asmākaṃ dehi gārhasthyaṃ yena samyakprajāyate .. 7 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मात्पुरवरं कृत्वा क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव सुशोभने ..
अस्माकं देहि गार्हस्थ्यं येन सम्यक्प्रजायते .. 7 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, having built an excellent city right here in this most splendid kṣetra, / give it to us so that our householdership may be properly realized. // 7

5.112.s:
yajāmo vividhairyajñaiḥ sadā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ .
imaṃ lokaṃ paraṃ caiva sādhayāmaḥ sadāsthitāḥ .. 8 ..
5.112.d:
यजामो विविधैर्यज्ञैः सदा संपूर्णदक्षिणैः .
इमं लोकं परं चैव साधयामः सदास्थिताः .. 8 ..
5.112.m: We shall sacrifice with various sacrifices, always with complete priestly gifts, / and residing here constantly, we shall attain both this world and the next." // 8

5.112.s:
tacchrutvā pārthivo hṛṣṭastathetyuktvā tataḥ param ..
anukūladine prāpte śilpānāhūya bhūriśaḥ .. 9 ..
5.112.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवो हृष्टस्तथेत्युक्त्वा ततः परम् ..
अनुकूलदिने प्राप्ते शिल्पानाहूय भूरिशः .. 9 ..
5.112.m: Hearing that, the king was delighted, and saying "So be it," / when an auspicious day arrived, he summoned numerous artisans. // 9

5.112.s:
puraṃ prakalpayāmāsa bahuprākārasaṃkulam..
prākāraparikhāyuktaṃ gopuraiḥ samalaṃkṛtam .. 6.113.10 ..
5.112.d:
पुरं प्रकल्पयामास बहुप्राकारसंकुलम्..
प्राकारपरिखायुक्तं गोपुरैः समलंकृतम् .. 6.113.10 ..
5.112.m: He had a city laid out, filled with many defensive ramparts, / endowed with boundary walls and moats, and adorned with city-gates. // 10

5.112.s:
athāṣṭaṣaṣṭiviprāṇāṃ tatra madhye nṛpottamaḥ ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭigṛhāṇyeva cakāra subṛhaṃti ca .. 11 ..
5.112.d:
अथाष्टषष्टिविप्राणां तत्र मध्ये नृपोत्तमः ..
अष्टषष्टिगृहाण्येव चकार सुबृहंति च .. 11 ..
5.112.m: Then, for sixty-eight brahmins, in its midst the best of kings / constructed sixty-eight truly magnificent houses, // 11

5.112.s:
mattavāraṇajuṣṭāni dīrghikāsahitāni ca ..
gṛhodyānaiḥ sametāni yathā rājagṛhāṇi ca .. 12 ..
5.112.d:
मत्तवारणजुष्टानि दीर्घिकासहितानि च ..
गृहोद्यानैः समेतानि यथा राजगृहाणि च .. 12 ..
5.112.m: furnished with turrets and along with step-wells, / accompanied by household gardens, like royal palaces. // 12

5.112.s:
tathā kṛtvā'tha ratnaughaiḥ pūrayitvā tathā paraiḥ.
dadau tebhyo aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram..13..
5.112.d:
तथा कृत्वाऽथ रत्नौघैः पूरयित्वा तथा परैः.
ददौ तेभ्यो अष्टषष्टिं च ग्रामाणां तदनंतरम्..13..
5.112.m: Having done so and filled them with heaps of jewels and other treasures, / he then gave to them sixty-eight villages. // 13

5.112.s:
tataḥ sarvānsamāhūya putrapautrāṃstadagrataḥ..
provāca tāranādena śrūyatāṃ jalpato mama .. 14 ..
5.112.d:
ततः सर्वान्समाहूय पुत्रपौत्रांस्तदग्रतः..
प्रोवाच तारनादेन श्रूयतां जल्पतो मम .. 14 ..
5.112.m: Then, summoning all his sons and grandsons before him, / he declared in a resonant voice: "Listen to my words! // 14

5.112.s:
etatpuraṃ mayā dattamebhirgrāmaiḥ samanvitam ..
etebhyo brāhmaṇeṃdrebhyaḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 15 ..
5.112.d:
एतत्पुरं मया दत्तमेभिर्ग्रामैः समन्वितम् ..
एतेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेंद्रेभ्यः श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 15 ..
5.112.m: This city, accompanied by these villages, has been given by me / to these lords among brahmins with a mind purified by faith. // 15

5.112.s:
tasmādrakṣā prakartavyā yathā na syātkṣatiḥ kvacit ..
kaṣṭaṃ vā brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ tathā caiva parābhavam.. 16 ..
5.112.d:
तस्माद्रक्षा प्रकर्तव्या यथा न स्यात्क्षतिः क्वचित् ..
कष्टं वा ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां तथा चैव पराभवम्.. 16 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, protection must be maintained so that at no time shall there be harm, / suffering, or humiliation for these foremost brahmins. // 16

5.112.s:
asmadvaṃśasamudbhūto yastvetāṃstoṣayiṣyati ..
anyo vā bhūpatirvṛddhimagryāṃ nūnaṃ sa yāsyati .. 17 ..
5.112.d:
अस्मद्वंशसमुद्भूतो यस्त्वेतांस्तोषयिष्यति ..
अन्यो वा भूपतिर्वृद्धिमग्र्यां नूनं स यास्यति .. 17 ..
5.112.m: Whoever born in our lineage—or any other king—shall please them, / he will surely attain the highest prosperity. // 17

5.112.s:
yaścāparādhasaṃyuktānetānkhedaṃ nayiṣyati ..
yojayiṣyati vā kleśairvividhairvā parābhavaiḥ ..
sa śatrubhiḥ parābhūto veṣṭito vividhairgadaiḥ .. 18 ..
5.112.d:
यश्चापराधसंयुक्तानेतान्खेदं नयिष्यति ..
योजयिष्यति वा क्लेशैर्विविधैर्वा पराभवैः ..
स शत्रुभिः पराभूतो वेष्टितो विविधैर्गदैः .. 18 ..
5.112.m: And whoever, treating them as wrongdoers, brings them sorrow, / or subjects them to afflictions and various indignities, / shall be defeated by his enemies and beset with diverse diseases; // 18

5.112.s:
iha loke viyogādīnprāpya kleśānsudāruṇān..
rauravādiṣu raudreṣu narakeṣu prayāsyati. 19 ..
5.112.d:
इह लोके वियोगादीन्प्राप्य क्लेशान्सुदारुणान्..
रौरवादिषु रौद्रेषु नरकेषु प्रयास्यति. 19 ..
5.112.m: having met dreadful sufferings such as bereavement in this world, / he shall depart to the horrific hells, such as Raurava." // 19

5.112.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtyaṃ mahīpatiḥ ..
svayamevākaronnityaṃ divārātramataṃdritaḥ .. 6.113.20 ..
5.112.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्वं तेषां कृत्यं महीपतिः ..
स्वयमेवाकरोन्नित्यं दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः .. 6.113.20 ..
5.112.m: Having spoken thus, the king himself unweariedly carried out / every duty for them daily, day and night. // 20

5.112.s:
atha tā brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhāryāḥ sarvāḥ dvijottamāḥ ..
damayaṃtyāḥ samāsādya prāsādaṃ snehavatsalāḥ .. 21 ..
5.112.d:
अथ ता ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां भार्याः सर्वाः द्विजोत्तमाः ..
दमयंत्याः समासाद्य प्रासादं स्नेहवत्सलाः .. 21 ..
5.112.m: Then all the wives of those best among brahmins, O excellent twice-born, / approaching the palace of Damayantī, filled with tender affection, // 21

5.112.s:
kuṃkumāgarukarpūraiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
tadarccā pūjayāmāsuḥ sa ca rājā dinedine .. 22..
5.112.d:
कुंकुमागरुकर्पूरैः पुष्पैर्गंधैः पृथग्विधैः ..
तदर्च्चा पूजयामासुः स च राजा दिनेदिने .. 22..
5.112.m: worshiped her image with saffron, aloe-wood, camphor, / flowers, and varied perfumes; and so did the king day after day. // 22

5.112.s:
atha tāḥ procuranyonyaṃ tāpasyastatpuraḥ sthitāḥ ..
tasyabhūpasya saṃtoṣaṃ janayaṃtyo dvijottamāḥ .. 23 ..
5.112.d:
अथ ताः प्रोचुरन्योन्यं तापस्यस्तत्पुरः स्थिताः ..
तस्यभूपस्य संतोषं जनयंत्यो द्विजोत्तमाः .. 23 ..
5.112.m: Then those ascetic women, standing before her, said to one another, / bringing joy to that king, O best of the twice-born: // 23

5.112.s:
yadāsmākaṃ gṛhe vṛddhiḥ kadācitsaṃbhaviṣyati ..
tadagrataśca paścācca damayaṃtyāḥ prapūjanam..
kariṣyāmo na saṃdehaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā .. 24 ..
5.112.d:
यदास्माकं गृहे वृद्धिः कदाचित्संभविष्यति ..
तदग्रतश्च पश्चाच्च दमयंत्याः प्रपूजनम्..
करिष्यामो न संदेहः सर्वकृत्येषु सर्वदा .. 24 ..
5.112.m: "Whenever there shall be an auspicious occasion in our house, / both before and after it we shall worship Damayantī, / without doubt, in all rites and at all times. // 24

5.112.s:
enāṃ dṛṣṭvā kumārī yā vedimadhyaṃ gamiṣyati..
sā bhaviṣyatyasaṃdehaḥ patyuḥ prāṇasamā sadā .. 25 ..
5.112.d:
एनां दृष्ट्वा कुमारी या वेदिमध्यं गमिष्यति..
सा भविष्यत्यसंदेहः पत्युः प्राणसमा सदा .. 25 ..
5.112.m: A maiden who, having looked upon her, goes to the middle of the sacrificial altar, / she will beyond doubt forever become as dear as life to her husband. // 25

5.112.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kanyāyajña upasthite ..
damayaṃtī pradraṣṭavyā pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ ..26..
5.112.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कन्यायज्ञ उपस्थिते ..
दमयंती प्रद्रष्टव्या पूजनीया प्रयत्नतः ..26..
5.112.m: Therefore, by every effort, when a maiden's wedding sacrifice arrives, / Damayantī is to be viewed and worshiped with devotion." // 26

5.112.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
evaṃ tatra pure tena bhūbhujā sumahātmanā .
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ ca saṃsthāpya gotrāṇāṃ nirvṛtiḥ kṛtā .. 27 ..
5.112.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
एवं तत्र पुरे तेन भूभुजा सुमहात्मना .
अष्टषष्टिं च संस्थाप्य गोत्राणां निर्वृतिः कृता .. 27 ..
5.112.m: Sūta said: / Thus in that city, by having settled sixty-eight / lineages [gotras], contentment was established by that great-souled king. // 27

5.112.s:
teṣāmapi ca catvāri gotrāṇyura gajādbhayāt..
gatāni tatra yatra syustāni pūrvodbhavāni ca .
catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ sthitā tatra pure śeṣā dvijanmanām .. 28 ..
5.112.d:
तेषामपि च चत्वारि गोत्राण्युर गजाद्भयात्..
गतानि तत्र यत्र स्युस्तानि पूर्वोद्भवानि च .
चतुःषष्टिः स्थिता तत्र पुरे शेषा द्विजन्मनाम् .. 28 ..
5.112.m: Even among them, four lineages departed from fear of the elephant / to that place where their earlier ancestors dwelt; / the remaining sixty-four of the twice-born stayed in that city. // 28

5.112.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kīdṛṅanāgabhayaṃ teṣāṃ yena te vigatā vibho .
parityajya nijaṃ sthānametanno vistarādvada .. 29 ..
5.112.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कीदृङनागभयं तेषां येन ते विगता विभो .
परित्यज्य निजं स्थानमेतन्नो विस्तराद्वद .. 29 ..
5.112.m: The ṛṣis said: / What was that fear of an elephant on their part, because of which they departed, / abandoning their own place? O powerful one, tell us this in detail! // 29

5.112.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ānarttādhipatiḥ pūrvamāsīnnāmnā prabhaṃjanaḥ ..
dharmajñaḥ supratāpī ca parapakṣakṣayāvahaḥ .. 6.113.30 ..
tatastasya suto jajñe prāpte vayasi paścime ..
aniṣṭasthānasaṃstheṣu graheṣu dvija sattamāḥ..3...
5.112.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतिः पूर्वमासीन्नाम्ना प्रभंजनः ..
धर्मज्ञः सुप्रतापी च परपक्षक्षयावहः .. 6.113.30 ..
ततस्तस्य सुतो जज्ञे प्राप्ते वयसि पश्चिमे ..
अनिष्टस्थानसंस्थेषु ग्रहेषु द्विज सत्तमाः..3...
5.112.m:
Sūta said: / Formerly there was a ruler of Ānarta named Prabhañjana, / who knew the dharma, was of great valor, and brought about the destruction of his enemies' faction. // 30
Then a son was born to him when his late age had arrived, / while the planets were situated in inauspicious positions, O best of the twice-born. // 31

5.112.s:
tatastena samāhūya daivajñāñchāstrapaṃḍitān.
teṣāṃ niveditaṃ sarvaṃ kālaṃ tasya samudbhavam..32 ..
5.112.d:
ततस्तेन समाहूय दैवज्ञाञ्छास्त्रपंडितान्.
तेषां निवेदितं सर्वं कालं तस्य समुद्भवम्..32 ..
5.112.m: Then he, summoning astrologers learned in the scriptures, / reported to them all about the moment of his birth. // 32

5.112.s:
daivajñā ūcuḥ..
eṣa te pṛthivīpāla jātaḥ putraḥ sugarhita.
kāle 'niṣṭaprade raudre gaṃḍāṃta tritayodbhave.33..
kathaṃcidapi yadyeṣa jīvayiṣyati pārthiva.
pitṛmātṛpurārthe ca deśānutsādayiṣyati .. 34 ..
5.112.d:
दैवज्ञा ऊचुः..
एष ते पृथिवीपाल जातः पुत्रः सुगर्हित.
काले ऽनिष्टप्रदे रौद्रे गंडांत त्रितयोद्भवे.33..
कथंचिदपि यद्येष जीवयिष्यति पार्थिव.
पितृमातृपुरार्थे च देशानुत्सादयिष्यति .. 34 ..
5.112.m: The astrologers said: / "O protector of the earth, this son has been born to you at a very censured time, / at a fierce moment that bestows misfortune, arising in the threefold gaṇḍānta. // 33 // / If by any means he survives, O king, / he will lay waste to lands for the sake of his parents' wealth." // 34

5.112.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
asti kaścidupāyo'tra daivo vā mānuṣo'pi vā ..
yena saṃjāyate kṣemaṃ putrasya viṣayasya ca .. 35 ..
5.112.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
अस्ति कश्चिदुपायोऽत्र दैवो वा मानुषोऽपि वा ..
येन संजायते क्षेमं पुत्रस्य विषयस्य च .. 35 ..
5.112.m: The king said: / "Is there any remedy here, divine or human, / by which security may come to both my son and my realm?" // 35

5.112.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yathā samutthitaṃ yaṃtraṃ yaṃtreṇa pratihanyate..
yathā bāṇaprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhaveta ..
tathā grahavikārāṇāṃ śāṃtirbhavati vāraṇam.. 36..
5.112.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यथा समुत्थितं यंत्रं यंत्रेण प्रतिहन्यते..
यथा बाणप्रहाराणां कवचं वारणं भवेत ..
तथा ग्रहविकाराणां शांतिर्भवति वारणम्.. 36..
5.112.m: The brahmins said: / "Just as a raised weapon is repelled by another weapon, / just as armor is the defense against the strikes of arrows, / so pacification rites are the defense against the afflictions of the planets. // 36

5.112.s:
tasmānnityamanudvignaḥ śāṃtikaṃ kuru bhūpate ..
yena sarve grahāḥ saumyā jāyaṃte ca śubhāvahāḥ .. 37 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मान्नित्यमनुद्विग्नः शांतिकं कुरु भूपते ..
येन सर्वे ग्रहाः सौम्या जायंते च शुभावहाः .. 37 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, remaining free from anxiety, constantly perform a pacification rite, O lord of the earth, / whereby all the planets become gentle and bringers of auspiciousness, // 37

5.112.s:
aniṣṭasthānasaṃstheṣu graheṣu viṣameṣu ca..
tataḥ sa satvaṃ gatvā camatkārapuraṃ nṛpaḥ..38..
5.112.d:
अनिष्टस्थानसंस्थेषु ग्रहेषु विषमेषु च..
ततः स सत्वं गत्वा चमत्कारपुरं नृपः..38..
5.112.m: even when the planets are unfavorable and stationed in inauspicious houses." / Then that king quickly went to Camatkārapura. // 38

5.112.s:
tatra viprānsamāveśya sarvānprovāca sādaram.
vayaṃ yuṣmatprasādena rājyaṃ kurmaḥ sadaiva hi..39..
5.112.d:
तत्र विप्रान्समावेश्य सर्वान्प्रोवाच सादरम्.
वयं युष्मत्प्रसादेन राज्यं कुर्मः सदैव हि..39..
5.112.m: Assembling all the brahmins there, he said respectfully: / "We always rule the kingdom solely through your favor." // 39

5.112.s:
ye 'tītā ye bhaviṣyaṃti vaṃśe 'smākaṃ nṛpottamāḥ..
bhavaṃto 'tra gatisteṣāṃ sasyānāṃ nīrado yathā..6.113.40..
5.112.d:
ये ऽतीता ये भविष्यंति वंशे ऽस्माकं नृपोत्तमाः..
भवंतो ऽत्र गतिस्तेषां सस्यानां नीरदो यथा..6.113.40..
5.112.m: Those excellent kings in our lineage who have passed away and those who will be, / you are their refuge here, just as a rain-cloud is for the crops. (40)

5.112.s:
yadatra matsuto jāto duṣṭasthānasthitairgrahaiḥ ..
daivajñaiḥ śāṃtikaṃ proktaṃ tasyāniṣṭasya śāṃtidam .. 41 ..
5.112.d:
यदत्र मत्सुतो जातो दुष्टस्थानस्थितैर्ग्रहैः ..
दैवज्ञैः शांतिकं प्रोक्तं तस्यानिष्टस्य शांतिदम् .. 41 ..
5.112.m: Since my son was born here under planets standing in inauspicious houses, / a pacifying rite has been prescribed by the astrologers to bring peace from that misfortune. (41)

5.112.s:
tasmātkuruta vipreṃdrā yathoktaṃ śāṃtikaṃ mama ..
na putraśca rāṣṭraṃ ca vibhavaśca vivardhate .. 42 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मात्कुरुत विप्रेंद्रा यथोक्तं शांतिकं मम ..
न पुत्रश्च राष्ट्रं च विभवश्च विवर्धते .. 42 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, O foremost brahmins, perform the pacifying rite for me as prescribed, / otherwise neither my son, nor my kingdom, nor my prosperity will flourish. (42)

5.112.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procuḥ saṃmaṃtryā'tha parasparam ..
kṣemāya tava bhūnātha kariṣyāmo'tra śāṃtikam ..' .. 43 ..
5.112.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः प्रोचुः संमंत्र्याऽथ परस्परम् ..
क्षेमाय तव भूनाथ करिष्यामोऽत्र शांतिकम् ..' .. 43 ..
5.112.m: Then those brahmins, having consulted with one another, said: / 'For your welfare, O lord of the earth, we shall perform the pacifying rite here.' (43)

5.112.s:
sadeva niyatāḥ saṃtaḥ śāṃtāḥ ṣoḍaśa te dvijāḥ ..
upahārāḥ sadā preṣyāstvayā bhaktyā mahīpate ..
māsāṃte cābhiṣekaśca grāhyo rudraghaṭodbhavaḥ .. 44 ..
5.112.d:
सदेव नियताः संतः शांताः षोडश ते द्विजाः ..
उपहाराः सदा प्रेष्यास्त्वया भक्त्या महीपते ..
मासांते चाभिषेकश्च ग्राह्यो रुद्रघटोद्भवः .. 44 ..
5.112.m: Sixteen of those brahmins, always restrained and calm [were selected]. / 'Offerings are always to be sent by you with devotion, O lord of the earth, / and at the month's end, an ablution born of the Rudra-pitcher must be received [by you]. (44)

5.112.s:
evaṃ prakurvatastubhyaṃ putro vṛddhiṃ prayāsyati .
tathā rāṣṭraṃ ca kośaśca yaccānyadapi kiṃcana..45..
5.112.d:
एवं प्रकुर्वतस्तुभ्यं पुत्रो वृद्धिं प्रयास्यति .
तथा राष्ट्रं च कोशश्च यच्चान्यदपि किंचन..45..
5.112.m: As you do this, your son will attain growth, / and likewise your kingdom, your treasury, and whatever else [belongs to you].' (45)

5.112.s:
tataḥ praṇamya tānhṛṣṭo gatvā nijaniveśanam..
utsavaṃ putrajanmotthaṃ cakre taiḥ preritaḥ sadā .. 46 ..
5.112.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तान्हृष्टो गत्वा निजनिवेशनम्..
उत्सवं पुत्रजन्मोत्थं चक्रे तैः प्रेरितः सदा .. 46 ..
5.112.m: Then, having bowed to them, overjoyed, he went to his own abode; / encouraged by them, he continually held a celebration for the birth of his son. (46)

5.112.s:
saṃbhārānpreṣayāmāsa camatkārapure tataḥ ..
māsāṃte cābhiṣekaśca grāhyo vai vidhipūrvakam .. 47 ..
5.112.d:
संभारान्प्रेषयामास चमत्कारपुरे ततः ..
मासांते चाभिषेकश्च ग्राह्यो वै विधिपूर्वकम् .. 47 ..
5.112.m: He then sent the sacrificial supplies to Camatkārapura; / and at the month's end, the ablution was indeed received according to the rules. (47)

5.112.s:
te'pi brāhmaṇaśārdūlāścātuścaraṇasaṃbhavāḥ ..
krameṇa śāṃtikaṃ cakrurbrahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ..48..
5.112.d:
तेऽपि ब्राह्मणशार्दूलाश्चातुश्चरणसंभवाः ..
क्रमेण शांतिकं चक्रुर्ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः..48..
5.112.m: Those tiger-like brahmins too, born of the four quarters, / devoted to celibacy, performed the pacifying rite in due order. (48)

5.112.s:
māsaṃ māsaṃ prati sadā śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ ..
tato māsā vasāne'nye cakrustacchāṃtikaṃ dvijāḥ.. 49 ..
5.112.d:
मासं मासं प्रति सदा शांता दांता जितेंद्रियाः ..
ततो मासा वसानेऽन्ये चक्रुस्तच्छांतिकं द्विजाः.. 49 ..
5.112.m: Month after month, they were ever tranquil, self-controlled, and master of their senses; / then at the end of the month, other brahmins performed that pacifying rite. (49)

5.112.s:
so'pi rājā'tha māsāṃte samāgatya subhaktitaḥ ..
abhiṣekaṃ samādāya pūjayitvā dvijottamān .. 6.113.50 ..
5.112.d:
सोऽपि राजाऽथ मासांते समागत्य सुभक्तितः ..
अभिषेकं समादाय पूजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् .. 6.113.50 ..
5.112.m: That king also, arriving at the end of the month with great devotion, / having received the ablution and worshipped the excellent brahmins (50)

5.112.s:
vāsobhirmukuṭaiścaiva gobhūdānena kevalam ..
saṃtarpyānyāṃstathā viprānsvasthānaṃ yāti bhūmipaḥ .. 51 ..
5.112.d:
वासोभिर्मुकुटैश्चैव गोभूदानेन केवलम् ..
संतर्प्यान्यांस्तथा विप्रान्स्वस्थानं याति भूमिपः .. 51 ..
5.112.m: with garments and diadems, and solely through the gift of cows and land, / and having gratified other brahmins as well, the ruler of the earth returned to his own place. (51)

5.112.s:
evaṃ pravartamāne ca śāṃtike tatra bhūpateḥ ..
jagāma sumahānkālaḥ kṣemārogyadhanāgamaiḥ .. 52 ..
5.112.d:
एवं प्रवर्तमाने च शांतिके तत्र भूपतेः ..
जगाम सुमहान्कालः क्षेमारोग्यधनागमैः .. 52 ..
5.112.m: As the pacifying rite was thus proceeding there for the lord of the earth, / a very great period of time passed in welfare, health, and acquisition of wealth. (52)

5.112.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya māsādāvapi bhūpateḥ ..
prārabdhe śāṃtike tasminmahāvyādhirajāyata .. .. 53 ..
5.112.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य मासादावपि भूपतेः ..
प्रारब्धे शांतिके तस्मिन्महाव्याधिरजायत .. .. 53 ..
5.112.m: However, after some time, at the beginning of a month for the lord of the earth, / when that pacifying rite was commenced, a great affliction arose. (53)

5.112.s:
tatputrasya viśeṣeṇa tathaivāṃtaḥpurasya ca ..
rāṣṭrasya ca samagrasya vāhanānāṃ tathā kṣayaḥ .. 54 ..
5.112.d:
तत्पुत्रस्य विशेषेण तथैवांतःपुरस्य च ..
राष्ट्रस्य च समग्रस्य वाहनानां तथा क्षयः .. 54 ..
5.112.m: Especially for his son, and likewise for his inner apartments, / for the entire kingdom, and there was destruction among the mounts and vehicles. (54)

5.112.s:
sa tataḥ preṣayāmāsa śāṃtyarthaṃ tatra satpure ..
susaṃbhārānviśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇāśca viśeṣataḥ .. 55 ..
5.112.d:
स ततः प्रेषयामास शांत्यर्थं तत्र सत्पुरे ..
सुसंभारान्विशेषेण दक्षिणाश्च विशेषतः .. 55 ..
5.112.m: He then sent to that excellent city for the sake of pacification / abundant supplies in particular, and especially priestly gifts. (55)

5.112.s:
yathāyathā dvijāstatra homaṃ kurvaṃti pāvake ..
tathā sarve viśeṣeṇa rogā vardhaṃti sarvaśaḥ .. 56 ..
5.112.d:
यथायथा द्विजास्तत्र होमं कुर्वंति पावके ..
तथा सर्वे विशेषेण रोगा वर्धंति सर्वशः .. 56 ..
5.112.m: The more the brahmins performed the fire offering in the fire there, / all the more did the diseases particularly increase on all sides. (56)

5.112.s:
mriyante vājinastasya bṛhanto vāraṇāstathā ..
śatravaḥ sarvakāṣṭhāsu vigrahārthamupasthitāḥ .. 57 ..
5.112.d:
म्रियन्ते वाजिनस्तस्य बृहन्तो वारणास्तथा ..
शत्रवः सर्वकाष्ठासु विग्रहार्थमुपस्थिताः .. 57 ..
5.112.m: His horses died, and so did his large elephants; / enemies appeared on every quarter for battle. (57)

5.112.s:
tataḥ sa vyākulībhūto rogagrasto mahīpatiḥ ..
camatkārapuraṃ prāpya sarvānviprānuvāca ha .. 58 ..
5.112.d:
ततः स व्याकुलीभूतो रोगग्रस्तो महीपतिः ..
चमत्कारपुरं प्राप्य सर्वान्विप्रानुवाच ह .. 58 ..
5.112.m: Then, distressed and overcome with illness, that lord of the earth / went to Camatkārapura and spoke to all the brahmins: (58)

5.112.s:
yuṣmābhiḥ svāmibhiḥ saṃsthairāpado'bhibhavaṃti mām..
tatkimetanmahābhāgāḥ kṣīyante mama saṃpadaḥ ..
rogāścaiva vivardhaṃte śatrusaṃghaiḥ samanvitāḥ .. 59 ..
5.112.d:
युष्माभिः स्वामिभिः संस्थैरापदोऽभिभवंति माम्..
तत्किमेतन्महाभागाः क्षीयन्ते मम संपदः ..
रोगाश्चैव विवर्धंते शत्रुसंघैः समन्विताः .. 59 ..
5.112.m: 'While you are present as my masters, calamities overcome me! / How is this, O fortunate ones? My riches are diminishing, / and diseases increase along with hosts of enemies. (59)

5.112.s:
tasmādviśeṣato homaḥ kāryo rogapraśāṃtaye ...
dānāni ca viśiṣṭāni pradāsyāmi dvijanmanām .. .. 6.113.60 ..
5.112.d:
तस्माद्विशेषतो होमः कार्यो रोगप्रशांतये ...
दानानि च विशिष्टानि प्रदास्यामि द्विजन्मनाम् .. .. 6.113.60 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, a special fire offering must be made for the pacification of disease, / and I will bestow distinguished gifts upon the twice-born.' (60)

5.112.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pratyakṣaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ ..
cakruḥ samāhitā bhūtvā śāṃtikaṃ taddhitāya ca .. 61 ..
5.112.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे प्रत्यक्षं तस्य भूपतेः ..
चक्रुः समाहिता भूत्वा शांतिकं तद्धिताय च .. 61 ..
5.112.m: Then all those brahmins, right in the presence of that lord of the earth, / became composed and performed that pacifying rite for his benefit. (61)

5.112.s:
yathāyathā prayuñjīranhomāṃte susamā hitāḥ ..
tathātathāsya bhūpasya vṛddhiṃ rogaḥ pragacchati .. 62 ..
5.112.d:
यथायथा प्रयुञ्जीरन्होमांते सुसमा हिताः ..
तथातथास्य भूपस्य वृद्धिं रोगः प्रगच्छति .. 62 ..
5.112.m: The more attentively they performed rites at the conclusion of the fire offering, / all the more did the disease of this king increase. (62)

5.112.s:
etasminnaṃtare kruddhāste sarve dvijasattamāḥ ..
grahānuddiśya sūryādīñchāpāya kṛtaniścayāḥ .. 63 ..
5.112.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे क्रुद्धास्ते सर्वे द्विजसत्तमाः ..
ग्रहानुद्दिश्य सूर्यादीञ्छापाय कृतनिश्चयाः .. 63 ..
5.112.m: In the meantime, all those best of the twice-born, filled with anger, / resolved to pronounce a curse directed at the planets beginning with the sun. (63)

5.112.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
pūjitā api sadbhaktyā vidhānena tathā grahāḥ ..
pīḍayaṃti puraṃ rājñaḥ saputrapaśubāṃdhavam .. 69 ..
evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā śucībhūya samāhitāḥ ..
yāvadyacchaṃti tacchāpaṃ grahebhyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ .. 65 ..
tāvadvahniruvācedaṃ mūrto bhūtvā dvijottamān ..
mā prayacchata vipreṃdrāḥ śāpaṃ kopātkathaṃcana .. 66 ..
grahebhyo doṣamuktebhyaḥ śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ..
māsimāsi prakurvaṃti homaṃ te ṣoḍaśa dvijāḥ .. .. 67 ..
teṣāṃ madhyasthitaścaikastrijāto brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ..
tena taddūṣitaṃ dravyaṃ samagraṃ homasaṃbhavam .. 68-..
mayā dattaṃ na gṛhṇaṃti te grahā bhāskarādayaḥ ..
tena kurvaṃti bhūpasya pīḍāmapyadhikāmimām .. 69 ..
5.112.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
पूजिता अपि सद्भक्त्या विधानेन तथा ग्रहाः ..
पीडयंति पुरं राज्ञः सपुत्रपशुबांधवम् .. 69 ..
एवं ते निश्चयं कृत्वा शुचीभूय समाहिताः ..
यावद्यच्छंति तच्छापं ग्रहेभ्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः .. 65 ..
तावद्वह्निरुवाचेदं मूर्तो भूत्वा द्विजोत्तमान् ..
मा प्रयच्छत विप्रेंद्राः शापं कोपात्कथंचन .. 66 ..
ग्रहेभ्यो दोषमुक्तेभ्यः श्रूयतां वचनं मम ..
मासिमासि प्रकुर्वंति होमं ते षोडश द्विजाः .. .. 67 ..
तेषां मध्यस्थितश्चैकस्त्रिजातो ब्राह्मणाधमः ..
तेन तद्दूषितं द्रव्यं समग्रं होमसंभवम् .. 68-..
मया दत्तं न गृह्णंति ते ग्रहा भास्करादयः ..
तेन कुर्वंति भूपस्य पीडामप्यधिकामिमाम् .. 69 ..
5.112.m:
The brahmins said: / 'Even though worshipped with true devotion and according to the rules, the planets / afflict the city of the king, together with his son, cattle, and kin.' (64)
Having made such a resolve, having purified themselves and become attentive, / as, faint with anger, they were about to deliver that curse to the planets, (65)
just then Agni, assuming a bodily form, spoke this to the excellent twice-born: / 'O foremost brahmins, do not pronounce a curse out of anger under any circumstance (66)
upon the planets, who are free from fault; listen to my word! / Month by month, those sixteen brahmins perform the fire offering. (67)
Standing in their midst is one degraded brahmin, a trijāta; / by him all that substance produced for the fire offering has been defiled. / Offered by me, those planets beginning with the Sun do not accept it; / on that account they inflict this even greater distress upon the king. (68–69)

5.112.s:
tasmādenaṃ parityajya homaṃ kuruta mā ciram ..
yena prītiṃ parāṃ yāṃti grahāḥ sarve'rkapūrvakāḥ .. .. 6.113.70 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मादेनं परित्यज्य होमं कुरुत मा चिरम् ..
येन प्रीतिं परां यांति ग्रहाः सर्वेऽर्कपूर्वकाः .. .. 6.113.70 ..
5.112.m: Therefore, cast him out and perform the fire offering without delay, / so that all the planets, beginning with the Sun, may attain supreme satisfaction. (70)

5.112.s:
ārogyaśca bhavedrājā gataśatruḥ sutānvitaḥ ..
satataṃ sukhamabhyeti macchāṃtikaprabhāvataḥ .. 71 ..
5.112.d:
आरोग्यश्च भवेद्राजा गतशत्रुः सुतान्वितः ..
सततं सुखमभ्येति मच्छांतिकप्रभावतः .. 71 ..
5.112.m: And the king will become healthy, free of enemies, and accompanied by his son; / he will continually attain happiness by the power of my pacifying rite.' (71)

5.112.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānvahniścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
te'pi viprā viṣaṇṇāsyā lajjayā parayā vṛtāḥ .. 72 ..
5.112.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्वह्निश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
तेऽपि विप्रा विषण्णास्या लज्जया परया वृताः .. 72 ..
5.112.m: Having spoken thus, the blessed Agni disappeared; / those brahmins too became dejected, overcome with great shame. (72)

5.112.s:
tatastaṃ pāvakaṃ bhūyaḥ stuvaṃtastatra ca sthitāḥ ..
procurvaiśvānaraṃ brūhi trijāto yo'tra ca dvijaḥ .. 73 ..
5.112.d:
ततस्तं पावकं भूयः स्तुवंतस्तत्र च स्थिताः ..
प्रोचुर्वैश्वानरं ब्रूहि त्रिजातो योऽत्र च द्विजः .. 73 ..
5.112.m: Then, remaining there, praising that fire again, / they said to Vaiśvānara: 'Tell [us], who is the trijāta brahmin here, (73)

5.112.s:
yena taṃ saṃparityajya kurmaḥ karma praśāṃtaye ..
niḥśeṣameva doṣāṇāṃ bhūpasyāsya mahātmanaḥ .. 74 ..
5.112.d:
येन तं संपरित्यज्य कुर्मः कर्म प्रशांतये ..
निःशेषमेव दोषाणां भूपस्यास्य महात्मनः .. 74 ..
5.112.m: so that, having abandoned him, we may perform the rite for the pacification, / completely without remainder, of the faults of this noble king.' (74)

5.112.s:
.. vahniruvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ doṣaṃ dvijedrāṇāṃ jānannapi kathaṃcana ..
bravīmi brāhmaṇā vandyā mama sarve dharātale .. 75 ..
5.112.d:
.. वह्निरुवाच .. ..
नाहं दोषं द्विजेद्राणां जानन्नपि कथंचन ..
ब्रवीमि ब्राह्मणा वन्द्या मम सर्वे धरातले .. 75 ..
5.112.m: Agni said: / 'Even though knowing it, I will not in any way declare the fault of foremost twice-born ones; / all brahmins on the earth are venerable to me.' (75)

5.112.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vahne nāsmākaṃ kīrtayiṣyasi ..
tatte śāpaṃ pradāsyāmastasmācchīghraṃ vadasva naḥ .. 76 ..
5.112.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि तं ब्राह्मणं वह्ने नास्माकं कीर्तयिष्यसि ..
तत्ते शापं प्रदास्यामस्तस्माच्छीघ्रं वदस्व नः .. 76 ..
5.112.m: The brahmins said: / 'If you do not declare that brahmin to us, O Agni, / then we will pronounce a curse upon you; therefore, tell us quickly!' (76)

5.112.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vahnirbhayasamanvitaḥ ..
ciraṃ viciṃtayāmāsa kurve'taḥ kiṃ śubhāvaham .. 77 ..
5.112.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वह्निर्भयसमन्वितः ..
चिरं विचिंतयामास कुर्वेऽतः किं शुभावहम् .. 77 ..
5.112.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that statement of theirs, Agni, filled with fear, / pondered for a long time: 'What auspicious course shall I take here? (77)

5.112.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ dūṣayiṣyāmi yadi tāvacca pātakam ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ śāpaścāpi tadudbhavaḥ .. .. 78 ..
5.112.d:
ब्राह्मणं दूषयिष्यामि यदि तावच्च पातकम् ..
भविष्यति न संदेहः शापश्चापि तदुद्भवः .. .. 78 ..
5.112.m: If I defame a brahmin, then a sin / will occur, there is no doubt, and also a curse resulting from that. (78)

5.112.s:
kīrtayiṣyāmi vā naiva vidyamānaṃ dvijottamam ..
śapiṣyati na saṃdehaḥ kruddhā āśīviṣopamāḥ .. 79 ..
5.112.d:
कीर्तयिष्यामि वा नैव विद्यमानं द्विजोत्तमम् ..
शपिष्यति न संदेहः क्रुद्धा आशीविषोपमाः .. 79 ..
5.112.m: Or if I do not mention the excellent brahmin who is present, / [these brahmins,] enraged like venomous serpents, will curse [me], there is no doubt.' (79)

5.112.s:
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya gātre svedo'bhavanmahān..
yena tatpūritaṃ kuṇḍaṃ homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam ..6.113.80...
5.112.d:
एवं चिंतयतस्तस्य गात्रे स्वेदोऽभवन्महान्..
येन तत्पूरितं कुण्डं होमार्थं यत्प्रकल्पितम् ..6.113.80...
5.112.m: As he was thinking thus, a profuse sweat appeared on his body, / by which that pit was filled which had been prepared for the fire offering. (80)

5.112.s:
tataḥ provāca tānviprānkṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ.
vepamāno bhayatrastaḥkuṇḍānniṣkramya pāvakaḥ .. 81 ..
5.112.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तान्विप्रान्कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः.
वेपमानो भयत्रस्तःकुण्डान्निष्क्रम्य पावकः .. 81 ..
5.112.m: Then the fire, emerging from the pit, trembling and terrified with fear, / stood with folded hands and said to those brahmins: / 81

5.112.s:
nāhaṃ svajihvayā doṣaṃ brāhmaṇasya samudbhavam ..
kathañcitkīrtayiṣyāmi tasmācchṛṇvantu bho dvijāḥ .. 92 ..
atra sveda jale viprā ye sthitāḥ ṣoḍaśa dvijāḥ ..
te snānamadya kurvaṃtu praviśuddhyarthamātmanaḥ .. 83 ..
eteṣāṃ madhyago yaśca trijātaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ..
tasya visphoṭakairyuktaṃ snātasyāṃgaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 84 ..
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kramāttatra nimajjanam ..
cakruḥ śuddhiṃ gatāścāpi muktvaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadā .. .. 85..
hāhākārastato jajñe mahāṃstatra janodbhavaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā visphoṭakairyuktamakasmāttaṃ dvijottamam .. 86 ..
so'pi lajjānvito vipraḥ kṛtvā'dho vadanaṃ tataḥ ..
niṣkrāṃto'tha sabhāmadhyātsthānādviprasamudbhavāt .. 87 ..
.. vahniruvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sādhitaṃ kṛtyaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ.
tasmādyāsye nijaṃ sthānaṃ bhavadbhiḥ pāramāpitaḥ .. 88 ..
5.112.d:
नाहं स्वजिह्वया दोषं ब्राह्मणस्य समुद्भवम् ..
कथञ्चित्कीर्तयिष्यामि तस्माच्छृण्वन्तु भो द्विजाः .. 92 ..
अत्र स्वेद जले विप्रा ये स्थिताः षोडश द्विजाः ..
ते स्नानमद्य कुर्वंतु प्रविशुद्ध्यर्थमात्मनः .. 83 ..
एतेषां मध्यगो यश्च त्रिजातः स भविष्यति ..
तस्य विस्फोटकैर्युक्तं स्नातस्यांगं भविष्यति .. 84 ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे क्रमात्तत्र निमज्जनम् ..
चक्रुः शुद्धिं गताश्चापि मुक्त्वैकं ब्राह्मणं तदा .. .. 85..
हाहाकारस्ततो जज्ञे महांस्तत्र जनोद्भवः ..
दृष्ट्वा विस्फोटकैर्युक्तमकस्मात्तं द्विजोत्तमम् .. 86 ..
सोऽपि लज्जान्वितो विप्रः कृत्वाऽधो वदनं ततः ..
निष्क्रांतोऽथ सभामध्यात्स्थानाद्विप्रसमुद्भवात् .. 87 ..
.. वह्निरुवाच .. ..
एतद्वः साधितं कृत्यं मया पूर्वं द्विजोत्तमाः.
तस्माद्यास्ये निजं स्थानं भवद्भिः पारमापितः .. 88 ..
5.112.m:
"I will by no means proclaim with my own tongue a fault born of a brahmin. / Therefore, O twice-born ones, listen! / 82
Here in this water of sweat, let those sixteen brahmins who are standing / take a bath today for the sake of their purification. / 83
And whoever among them is trijāta, / his body, once he has bathed, will become covered with boils." / 84
Then all those brahmins took a plunge there in succession, / and attained purification, except for one brahmin at that time. / 85
Then a great cry of grief arose there among the people, / seeing that best of brahmins suddenly covered with boils. / 86
He too, the brahmin, filled with shame, hanging his head downward, / departed from the midst of the assembly, from that gathering place of the brahmins. / 87
Fire said: / "This duty of yours has been accomplished by me beforehand, O best of brahmins. / Therefore, having been brought to an end by you, I shall go to my own place. / 88

5.112.s:
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādapi svapre dvijottamāḥ ..
tasmātsamprārthyatāṃ kiṃcidabhīṣṭaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam .. 89 ..
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
etattava jalaṃ vahne svedajaṃ sarvadaiva tu ..
sthiraṃ bhavatu cātraiva viśuddhyarthaṃ dvijanmanām .. 6.113.90..
anyajāto naro yo'tra prakaroti nimajjanam ..
tasya cihnaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ visphoṭakasamudbhavam .. 91 ..
bāḍhamityeva sa procyā gatoṃ'tardhānameva hi.. ..
pāvakaste dvijāḥ sarve maṃtraṃ cakruḥ parasparam ..92..
5.112.d:
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्यादपि स्वप्रे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तस्मात्सम्प्रार्थ्यतां किंचिदभीष्टं हृदि संस्थितम् .. 89 ..
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
एतत्तव जलं वह्ने स्वेदजं सर्वदैव तु ..
स्थिरं भवतु चात्रैव विशुद्ध्यर्थं द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6.113.90..
अन्यजातो नरो योऽत्र प्रकरोति निमज्जनम् ..
तस्य चिह्नं त्वया कार्यं विस्फोटकसमुद्भवम् .. 91 ..
बाढमित्येव स प्रोच्या गतोंऽतर्धानमेव हि.. ..
पावकस्ते द्विजाः सर्वे मंत्रं चक्रुः परस्परम् ..92..
5.112.m:
The sight of me should not be in vain, even in a dream, O best of brahmins; / therefore, let something desired that dwells in your hearts be requested." / 89
The brahmins said: / "O Fire, let this water of yours, born of sweat, remain forever right here / for the purification of the twice-born. / 90 / Whichever man born of another takes a plunge here, / on him a mark born of boils must be made by you." / 91
Saying 'So be it,' he vanished from sight. / The fire having vanished, all those twice-born took counsel with one another: / 92

5.112.s:
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samudbhavam ..
śuddhiratra prakartavyā pitṛmātṛsamuddbhavā ..93..'
5.112.d:
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणानां समुद्भवम् ..
शुद्धिरत्र प्रकर्तव्या पितृमातृसमुद्द्भवा ..93..'
5.112.m: "From this day forward, purification regarding maternal and paternal origin / must be performed here for all born brahmins. / 93

5.112.s:
camatkārapurottho yaḥ kaścidvipraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
so'tra snāto viśuddhaśca vijñeyaḥ kulaputrakaḥ .. 94 ..
5.112.d:
चमत्कारपुरोत्थो यः कश्चिद्विप्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
सोऽत्र स्नातो विशुद्धश्च विज्ञेयः कुलपुत्रकः .. 94 ..
5.112.m: Whatever brahmin is proclaimed as originating from Camatkārapura, / having bathed here and been purified, is to be recognized as of noble lineage. / 94

5.112.s:
tasmai kanyā pradātavyā sa śrāddhārho bhaviṣyati. ..
dharmakṛtyeṣu sarveṣu yojanīyaḥ sa eva hi .. 95 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मै कन्या प्रदातव्या स श्राद्धार्हो भविष्यति. ..
धर्मकृत्येषु सर्वेषु योजनीयः स एव हि .. 95 ..
5.112.m: A maiden should be given to him; he will be worthy of śrāddha rites; / he alone indeed should be engaged in all religious acts. / 95

5.112.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu militeṣu yathākramam ..
tatpratyakṣaṃ viśuddho yaḥ sa śuddhaḥ paṃktipāvanaḥ .. 96 ..
5.112.d:
अष्टषष्टिषु गोत्रेषु मिलितेषु यथाक्रमम् ..
तत्प्रत्यक्षं विशुद्धो यः स शुद्धः पंक्तिपावनः .. 96 ..
5.112.m: When the sixty-eight lineages have assembled in proper order, / he who is purified before their eyes is pure and sanctifies the assembly. / 96

5.112.s:
apavādāśca ye kecidbrahmahatyādikāḥ sthitāḥ ..
anye'pi durjanaiḥ proktā dharmasandehakārakāḥ .. 97 ..
5.112.d:
अपवादाश्च ये केचिद्ब्रह्महत्यादिकाः स्थिताः ..
अन्येऽपि दुर्जनैः प्रोक्ता धर्मसन्देहकारकाः .. 97 ..
5.112.m: And whatever slanders exist, such as the killing of a brahmin, / and others spoken by wicked men that cause doubt about religious law— / 97

5.112.s:
te sarve'tra viśuddhāḥ syurvijñeyāḥ kulaputrakāḥ ..
apavādāstathā cānye nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti cākhilāḥ .. 98 ..
5.112.d:
ते सर्वेऽत्र विशुद्धाः स्युर्विज्ञेयाः कुलपुत्रकाः ..
अपवादास्तथा चान्ये नाशं यास्यंति चाखिलाः .. 98 ..
5.112.m: all those [men] who are purified here are to be recognized as of noble lineage, / and all other slanders will likewise perish. / 98

5.112.s:
yāvannātra kṛtaṃ snānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ca dvijanmanām..
sarveṣāṃ tāvadevā'tra na sa vipro bhavetsphuṭam .. 99 ..
5.112.d:
यावन्नात्र कृतं स्नानं प्रत्यक्षं च द्विजन्मनाम्..
सर्वेषां तावदेवाऽत्र न स विप्रो भवेत्स्फुटम् .. 99 ..
5.112.m: As long as a bath is not performed here before the eyes of all the twice-born, / so long indeed he shall clearly not be a brahmin here." / 99

5.112.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā camatkārapurodbhavāḥ ..
brāhmaṇāḥ śāṃtikaṃ cakrurhitārthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ ....6.113.100...
5.112.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ते समयं कृत्वा चमत्कारपुरोद्भवाः ..
ब्राह्मणाः शांतिकं चक्रुर्हितार्थं तस्य भूपतेः ....6.113.100...
5.112.m: Sūta said: / Having thus made an agreement, those brahmins born in Camatkārapura / performed an expiatory rite for the welfare of that king. / 100

5.112.s:
tasminkuṇḍe tataḥ snānaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvairmahātmabhiḥ ..
bhayatrastairviśuddhyarthaṃ śeṣairapi mahātmabhiḥ .. 101 ..
5.112.d:
तस्मिन्कुण्डे ततः स्नानं कृतं सर्वैर्महात्मभिः ..
भयत्रस्तैर्विशुद्ध्यर्थं शेषैरपि महात्मभिः .. 101 ..
5.112.m: Then in that pit, a bath was taken by all the noble souls, / and terrified by fear, by the remaining noble souls also, for the sake of purification. / 101

5.112.s:
tato nīrogatāṃ prāptaḥ sa bhūpastatkṣaṇādvijāḥ ..
yastatra kurute snānamadyāpi dvijasattamāḥ .. 102 ..
5.112.d:
ततो नीरोगतां प्राप्तः स भूपस्तत्क्षणाद्विजाः ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानमद्यापि द्विजसत्तमाः .. 102 ..
5.112.m: Then that king instantly attained freedom from disease, O twice-born ones. / Whoever takes a bath there even today, O best of the twice-born, / 102

5.112.s:
kārtikyāṃ paradārotthaiḥ sa vimucyeta pātakaiḥ ..
eṣāṃ yugatraye śuddhirāsīttatra dvijanmanām .. .. 103 ..
5.112.d:
कार्तिक्यां परदारोत्थैः स विमुच्येत पातकैः ..
एषां युगत्रये शुद्धिरासीत्तत्र द्विजन्मनाम् .. .. 103 ..
5.112.m: on the full moon of Kārttika, is freed from sins born of another's wife. / In the three ages, this purification of twice-born men was performed there. / 103

5.112.s:
kulaśīlavihīnānāmanyeṣāmapi pāpmanām ..
matvā kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ paradārasuraṃjitam ..
tatra śuddhistataḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtā vipraiśca vācikā .. .. 104..
purato devadevasya brahmaṇo dvijasattamāḥ ..
pitṛmātṛjavaṃśasya viśuddhyarthamataṃdritaiḥ ....5..
5.112.d:
कुलशीलविहीनानामन्येषामपि पाप्मनाम् ..
मत्वा कलियुगं घोरं परदारसुरंजितम् ..
तत्र शुद्धिस्ततः सर्वैः कृता विप्रैश्च वाचिका .. .. 104..
पुरतो देवदेवस्य ब्रह्मणो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
पितृमातृजवंशस्य विशुद्ध्यर्थमतंद्रितैः ....5..
5.112.m:
Considering the terrible Kali age, filled with the lust for other men's wives, / to affect even others who are devoid of good lineage and conduct and sinful, / then a verbal purification was instituted there by all the brahmins, / 104
in the presence of the god of gods, of Brahmā, O best of the twice-born, / by the unwearied ones, for the purification of maternal and paternal descent. / 105

5.112.s:
adyāpi kurute tatra yaḥ snānaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
trijāto dahyate tatra vahninā sa na saṃśayaḥ .. 106 ..
5.112.d:
अद्यापि कुरुते तत्र यः स्नानं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
त्रिजातो दह्यते तत्र वह्निना स न संशयः .. 106 ..
5.112.m: Even today, O best of the twice-born, whoever takes a bath there, / if he is trijāta, he is burned there by fire; there is no doubt. / 106

5.112.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakevarakṣetramāhātmye damayantyupākhyāne trijātakaviśuddhaye'gnikuṃḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 113 ..
5.112.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेवरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दमयन्त्युपाख्याने त्रिजातकविशुद्धयेऽग्निकुंडमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 113 ..
5.112.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Agnikuṇḍa for the Purification of the Trijātaka', in the Story of Damayantī, in the Glory of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. / 113

5.113.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
so'pi vipro dvijaśreṣṭhā visphoṭakapariplutaḥ ..
lajjayā parayā yukto gatvā kiṃcidvanāṃtaram .. 1 ..
5.113.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सोऽपि विप्रो द्विजश्रेष्ठा विस्फोटकपरिप्लुतः ..
लज्जया परया युक्तो गत्वा किंचिद्वनांतरम् .. 1 ..
5.113.m: Sūta said: / That brahmin too, O best of the twice-born, covered in boils / and filled with utter shame, went away into another forest. / 1

5.113.s:
tato vairāgyamāpanno raudre tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ..
tyaktvā gṛhādikaṃ sarvaṃ snehaṃ dārasutodbhavam.. 2 ..
5.113.d:
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नो रौद्रे तपसि संस्थितः ..
त्यक्त्वा गृहादिकं सर्वं स्नेहं दारसुतोद्भवम्.. 2 ..
5.113.m: Then, having attained dispassion, he engaged in terrible austerity, / having abandoned all his home and possessions, and the affection born of wife and sons. / 2

5.113.s:
niyamaiḥ saṃyamaiścaiva śoṣayannātmanastanum ..
kiṃcijjalāśrayaṃ gatvā sthāpayitvā maheśvaram .. 3 ..
5.113.d:
नियमैः संयमैश्चैव शोषयन्नात्मनस्तनुम् ..
किंचिज्जलाश्रयं गत्वा स्थापयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
5.113.m: Emaciating his body through observances and restraints, / he went to a certain body of water and established Maheśvara there. / 3

5.113.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ..
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā prārthayasva yathepsitam .. 4 ..
5.113.d:
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टस्तस्य महेश्वरः ..
प्रोवाच दर्शनं गत्वा प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम् .. 4 ..
5.113.m: Then, after a long time, Maheśvara was pleased with him, / and appearing before him, said, "Ask for whatever you desire." / 4

5.113.s:
.. trijāta uvāca .. ..
mātṛdoṣādahaṃ deva vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
madhye brāhmaṇamukhyānāmānarttādhipatestathā .. 5 ..
5.113.d:
.. त्रिजात उवाच .. ..
मातृदोषादहं देव वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः ..
मध्ये ब्राह्मणमुख्यानामानर्त्ताधिपतेस्तथा .. 5 ..
5.113.m: The trijāta said: / "O Lord, through my mother's fault I have attained supreme embarrassment / in the midst of the leading brahmins and of the ruler of Ānarta. / 5

5.113.s:
ahaṃ śaknomi no vaktuṃ kasyaciddarśituṃ vibho ..
trijāto'smīti vijñāya bhūrividyānvito'pi ca .. 6 ..
5.113.d:
अहं शक्नोमि नो वक्तुं कस्यचिद्दर्शितुं विभो ..
त्रिजातोऽस्मीति विज्ञाय भूरिविद्यान्वितोऽपि च .. 6 ..
5.113.m: I am not able to speak to anyone or show myself, O omnipresent Lord, / knowing that I am a trijāta, even though endowed with abundant learning. / 6

5.113.s:
tasmātsarvottamasteṣāmahaṃ caiva dvijanmanām ..
yathā bhavāmi deveśa tathā nītirvidhīyatām ..7.. ..
5.113.d:
तस्मात्सर्वोत्तमस्तेषामहं चैव द्विजन्मनाम् ..
यथा भवामि देवेश तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ..7.. ..
5.113.m: Therefore, O Lord of gods, let a plan be devised so that / I may become the very best among those twice-born." / 7

5.113.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
camatkārapure viprā ye vasaṃti dvijottama ..
teṣāṃ sarvottamo nūnaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyasi .. 8 ..
5.113.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
चमत्कारपुरे विप्रा ये वसंति द्विजोत्तम ..
तेषां सर्वोत्तमो नूनं मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि .. 8 ..
5.113.m: The Holy Lord said: / "O best of the twice-born, among the brahmins who dwell in Camatkārapura, / you shall surely become the best of all by my grace. / 8

5.113.s:
tasmātkālaṃ pratīkṣasva kañcittvaṃ brāhmaṇottama ..
samaye samanuprāpte tvāṃ ca neṣyāmi tatra vai .. 9 ..
5.113.d:
तस्मात्कालं प्रतीक्षस्व कञ्चित्त्वं ब्राह्मणोत्तम ..
समये समनुप्राप्ते त्वां च नेष्यामि तत्र वै .. 9 ..
5.113.m: Therefore, wait for some time, O best of brahmins; / when the time arrives, I will surely take you there." / 9

5.113.s:
evamuktvā sa deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
brāhmaṇo'pi tapastepe tathā saṃpūjayanharam .. 6.114.10 ..
5.113.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
ब्राह्मणोऽपि तपस्तेपे तथा संपूजयन्हरम् .. 6.114.10 ..
5.113.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord of gods disappeared from sight. / The brahmin too performed austerity, likewise worshipping Hara. / 10

5.113.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya matkārapure dvijāḥ ..
maudgalyānvayasaṃbhūto devarāto'bhavaddvijaḥ .. 11 ...
5.113.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य मत्कारपुरे द्विजाः ..
मौद्गल्यान्वयसंभूतो देवरातोऽभवद्द्विजः .. 11 ...
5.113.m: Now after some time, O twice-born ones, in Camatkārapura / there was a brahmin named Devarāta, born in the lineage of Mudgala. / 11

5.113.s:
tasya putraḥ krathonāma yauvanoddhatavigrahaḥ ..
sadā garvasamāyuktaḥ pauruṣe ca vyavasthitaḥ..12..
5.113.d:
तस्य पुत्रः क्रथोनाम यौवनोद्धतविग्रहः ..
सदा गर्वसमायुक्तः पौरुषे च व्यवस्थितः..12..
5.113.m: His son was named Kratha, haughty in body on account of his youth, / always filled with pride, and devoted to manly prowess. / 12

5.113.s:
sa kadācidyayau vipro nāgatīrthaṃ prati dvijāḥ ..
śrāvaṇasyāsite pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ paryaṭanvane ..13..
5.113.d:
स कदाचिद्ययौ विप्रो नागतीर्थं प्रति द्विजाः ..
श्रावणस्यासिते पक्षे पंचम्यां पर्यटन्वने ..13..
5.113.m: Once, O twice-born ones, that brahmin went toward Nāgatīrtha / on the fifth day in the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, wandering in the forest. / 13

5.113.s:
athāpaśyatsa nāgendratanayaṃ bhūrivarccasam ..
rudramālamiti khyātaṃ jananyā saha saṃgatam ..14..
5.113.d:
अथापश्यत्स नागेन्द्रतनयं भूरिवर्च्चसम् ..
रुद्रमालमिति ख्यातं जनन्या सह संगतम् ..14..
5.113.m: Then he saw the son of the lord of serpents, radiant with great luster, / known as Rudramāla, accompanied by his mother.

5.113.s:
athā'sau taṃ samālokya sulaghuṃ sarpa putrakam ..
jalasarpamiti jñātvā laguḍena vyapothayat ..15..
5.113.d:
अथाऽसौ तं समालोक्य सुलघुं सर्प पुत्रकम् ..
जलसर्पमिति ज्ञात्वा लगुडेन व्यपोथयत् ..15..
5.113.m: Then, seeing that very small young serpent / and thinking it was a water snake, he struck it down with a club.

5.113.s:
hanyamānena tenātha pramuktaḥ sumahānsvanaḥ ..
hā mātastāta tāteti vipanno'smi nirāgasaḥ..16..
5.113.d:
हन्यमानेन तेनाथ प्रमुक्तः सुमहान्स्वनः ..
हा मातस्तात तातेति विपन्नोऽस्मि निरागसः..16..
5.113.m: As he was being beaten, he uttered a very loud cry: / 'Ah, mother! Father, father! Innocent as I am, I am ruined!'

5.113.s:
so'pi śrutvā'tha taṃ śabdaṃ brāhmaṇo mānuṣodbhavam ..
sarpasya bhayasaṃtrastaḥ satvaraṃ svagṛhaṃ yayau ..17..
5.113.d:
सोऽपि श्रुत्वाऽथ तं शब्दं ब्राह्मणो मानुषोद्भवम् ..
सर्पस्य भयसंत्रस्तः सत्वरं स्वगृहं ययौ ..17..
5.113.m: Hearing that human-like sound from the serpent, / the brahmin, terrified with fear, quickly went to his own house.

5.113.s:
atha sā jananī tasya niṣkrāṃtā salilāśrayāt..
yāvatpaśyati tīrasthaṃ tāvatputraṃ nipātitam..18..
5.113.d:
अथ सा जननी तस्य निष्क्रांता सलिलाश्रयात्..
यावत्पश्यति तीरस्थं तावत्पुत्रं निपातितम्..18..
5.113.m: Then his mother came out of the water; / when she looked on the bank, there she saw her son struck down.

5.113.s:
tato mūrcchāmanuprāptā dṛṣṭvā putraṃ tathāvidham..
yaṣṭiprahāranirbhinnaṃ sarvāṃgarudhirokṣitam..19..
5.113.d:
ततो मूर्च्छामनुप्राप्ता दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं तथाविधम्..
यष्टिप्रहारनिर्भिन्नं सर्वांगरुधिरोक्षितम्..19..
5.113.m: Then she fell into a swoon, seeing her son in such a state, / shattered by blows of the stick, his whole body drenched in blood.

5.113.s:
atha labdhvā punaḥ saṃjñāṃ pralāpānakarodbahūn..
karuṇaṃ śokasaṃtaptā vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā ..6.114.20...
5.113.d:
अथ लब्ध्वा पुनः संज्ञां प्रलापानकरोद्बहून्..
करुणं शोकसंतप्ता वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा ..6.114.20...
5.113.m: Then, regaining consciousness, she uttered many laments, / sorrowfully afflicted with grief, her eyes blurred with tears:

5.113.s:
hāhā putra parityaktvā māṃ ca kvāsi vinirgataḥ ..
anāvṛttikaraṃ sthānaṃ kiṃ sneho nāsti te mayi..21...
5.113.d:
हाहा पुत्र परित्यक्त्वा मां च क्वासि विनिर्गतः ..
अनावृत्तिकरं स्थानं किं स्नेहो नास्ति ते मयि..21...
5.113.m: 'Alas, alas, my son, having abandoned me, where have you gone, / to that place from which there is no return? Have you no love for me?

5.113.s:
kena tvaṃ nihataḥ putra pāpena ca durātmanā ..
niṣpāpo'pi ca putra tvaṃ kasya kruddho'dyavai yamaḥ..22..
5.113.d:
केन त्वं निहतः पुत्र पापेन च दुरात्मना ..
निष्पापोऽपि च पुत्र त्वं कस्य क्रुद्धोऽद्यवै यमः..22..
5.113.m: By what sinful, wicked soul have you been slain, my son? / Though you were sinless, my son, against whom has Yama become enraged today?

5.113.s:
sapurasya sarāṣṭrasya sakuṭuṃbasya durmateḥ ..
yena tvaṃ nihato'dyāpi paṃcamyāṃ pūjito na ca ..23..
5.113.d:
सपुरस्य सराष्ट्रस्य सकुटुंबस्य दुर्मतेः ..
येन त्वं निहतोऽद्यापि पंचम्यां पूजितो न च ..23..
5.113.m: [May ruin come] to the town, realm, and family of the evil-minded one / by whom you were slain today, on the fifth [tithi], without being worshipped!

5.113.s:
rajasā krīḍayitvā'dya samāgatya cirādatha..
kāmenotsaṃgamāgatya glāniṃ naiṣyati cāṃbaram ..24..
5.113.d:
रजसा क्रीडयित्वाऽद्य समागत्य चिरादथ..
कामेनोत्संगमागत्य ग्लानिं नैष्यति चांबरम् ..24..
5.113.m: Playing in the dust today, coming back after a long time, / lovingly climbing into my lap, who will soil my garment?

5.113.s:
gadgadāni manojñāni janahāsyakarāṇi ca ..
tvayā vinā'dya vākyāni ko vadiṣyati me puraḥ ..25..
5.113.d:
गद्गदानि मनोज्ञानि जनहास्यकराणि च ..
त्वया विनाऽद्य वाक्यानि को वदिष्यति मे पुरः ..25..
5.113.m: Without you, who will speak before me today / stammering, delightful words that bring smiles to people's faces?

5.113.s:
piturutsaṃgamāśritya kūrcākarṣaṇapūrvakam ..
kaḥ kariṣyati putrā'dya satoṣaṃ bhavatā vinā .. 26 ..
5.113.d:
पितुरुत्संगमाश्रित्य कूर्चाकर्षणपूर्वकम् ..
कः करिष्यति पुत्राऽद्य सतोषं भवता विना .. 26 ..
5.113.m: Resting on your father's lap and pulling at his beard, / who, without you, my son, will bring him delight today?

5.113.s:
niṣiddho'si mayā vatsa tvamāyāto'nupṛṣṭhataḥ ..
martyalokamimaṃ tāta bahudoṣasamākulam .. 27 ..
5.113.d:
निषिद्धोऽसि मया वत्स त्वमायातोऽनुपृष्ठतः ..
मर्त्यलोकमिमं तात बहुदोषसमाकुलम् .. 27 ..
5.113.m: You were forbidden by me, child, yet you followed behind / to this mortal world, dear son, full of many dangers!'

5.113.s:
evaṃ vilapya nāgī sā saṃkruddhā śokakarṣitā ..
taṃ mṛtaṃ sutamādāya jagāmānaṃtasaṃnidhau .. 28 ..
5.113.d:
एवं विलप्य नागी सा संक्रुद्धा शोककर्षिता ..
तं मृतं सुतमादाय जगामानंतसंनिधौ .. 28 ..
5.113.m: Lamenting thus, enraged and consumed by sorrow, the nāgī / took her dead son and went into the presence of Ananta.

5.113.s:
tatastadagrataḥ kṣiptvā taṃ mṛtaṃ nijabālakam ..
pralāpānakaroddīnā viyuktā kurarī yathā .. 29 ..
5.113.d:
ततस्तदग्रतः क्षिप्त्वा तं मृतं निजबालकम् ..
प्रलापानकरोद्दीना वियुक्ता कुररी यथा .. 29 ..
5.113.m: Then, casting down her dead child before him, / she uttered laments, miserable like a forlorn osprey.

5.113.s:
nāgarājo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā svaputraṃ vinipātitam ..
jagāma so'pi mūrcchāṃ ca putraśokena pīḍitaḥ .. 6.114.30 ..
5.113.d:
नागराजोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा स्वपुत्रं विनिपातितम् ..
जगाम सोऽपि मूर्च्छां च पुत्रशोकेन पीडितः .. 6.114.30 ..
5.113.m: The serpent king too, seeing his own son struck down, / fell into a swoon, tormented by grief for his son.

5.113.s:
tataḥ sikto jalaiḥ śītaiḥ saṃjñāṃ labdhvā sa kṛcchrataḥ ..
pralāpānkṛpaṇāṃścakre prākṛtaḥ puruṣo yathā ..31...
5.113.d:
ततः सिक्तो जलैः शीतैः संज्ञां लब्ध्वा स कृच्छ्रतः ..
प्रलापान्कृपणांश्चक्रे प्राकृतः पुरुषो यथा ..31...
5.113.m: Then, sprinkled with cool water, he regained consciousness with difficulty, / and made pitiable laments like an ordinary man.

5.113.s:
etasminnaṃtare nāgāḥ sarve tatra samāgatāḥ..
rurudurduḥkhitāḥ saṃto bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ..32..
5.113.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे नागाः सर्वे तत्र समागताः..
रुरुदुर्दुःखिताः संतो बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः..32..
5.113.m: At that moment, all the serpents gathered there; / grieving, they wept, their eyes blurred with tears:

5.113.s:
vāsukiḥ padmajaḥ śaṃkhastakṣakaśca mahāviṣaḥ..
śaṃkhacūḍaḥ sacūḍaśca puṃḍarīkaśca dāruṇaḥ .. 33 ..
5.113.d:
वासुकिः पद्मजः शंखस्तक्षकश्च महाविषः..
शंखचूडः सचूडश्च पुंडरीकश्च दारुणः .. 33 ..
5.113.m: Vāsuki, Padmaja, Śaṅkha, and the highly venomous Takṣaka, / Śaṅkhacūḍa, Sacūḍa, and the dreadful Puṇḍarīka,

5.113.s:
añjano vāmanaścaiva kumudaśca tathā paraḥ ..
kambalāśvatarau nāgau nāgaḥ karkoṭakastathā .. 34 ..
5.113.d:
अञ्जनो वामनश्चैव कुमुदश्च तथा परः ..
कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ नागः कर्कोटकस्तथा .. 34 ..
5.113.m: Añjana, Vāmana, and another, Kumuda, / the two nāgas Kambala and Aśvatara, and the nāga Karkoṭaka,

5.113.s:
puṣpadaṃtaḥ sudaṃtaśca mūṣako mūṣakādanaḥ ..
elāpatraḥ supatraśca dīrghāsyaḥ puṣpavāhanaḥ .. 35 ..
5.113.d:
पुष्पदंतः सुदंतश्च मूषको मूषकादनः ..
एलापत्रः सुपत्रश्च दीर्घास्यः पुष्पवाहनः .. 35 ..
5.113.m: Puṣpadanta, Sudanta, Mūṣaka, Mūṣakādana, / Elāpatra, Supatra, Dīrghāsya, and Puṣpavāhana—

5.113.s:
ete cānye tathā nāgāstatrā''yātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
putraśokābhisataptaṃ jñātvā taṃ pannagādhipam.. 36 ..
5.113.d:
एते चान्ये तथा नागास्तत्रा'ऽयाताः सहस्रशः ..
पुत्रशोकाभिसतप्तं ज्ञात्वा तं पन्नगाधिपम्.. 36 ..
5.113.m: these and other serpents arrived there by the thousands, / knowing the lord of snakes was burning with grief for his son.

5.113.s:
tataḥ saṃbodhya te sarve tamīśaṃ pavanāśanam..
pūrvavṛttaiḥ kathodbhedairdṛṣṭāṃtairvividhairapi .. 37 ..
5.113.d:
ततः संबोध्य ते सर्वे तमीशं पवनाशनम्..
पूर्ववृत्तैः कथोद्भेदैर्दृष्टांतैर्विविधैरपि .. 37 ..
5.113.m: Then they all consoled that lord of wind-eaters / with past events, narratives, and various parables.

5.113.s:
evaṃ saṃbodhitastaistu cirātpannagasattamaḥ ..
agnidāhyaṃ tataścakre tasya putrasya duḥkhitaḥ .. 38 ..
5.113.d:
एवं संबोधितस्तैस्तु चिरात्पन्नगसत्तमः ..
अग्निदाह्यं ततश्चक्रे तस्य पुत्रस्य दुःखितः .. 38 ..
5.113.m: Having been thus consoled by them at last, the best of snakes, / full of sorrow, performed the cremation by fire for his son.

5.113.s:
jaladānasya kāle ca sarpānsarvānuvāca saḥ ..
sarvānnāgānpradānārthaṃ toyasya samupasthitān.. 39 ..
5.113.d:
जलदानस्य काले च सर्पान्सर्वानुवाच सः ..
सर्वान्नागान्प्रदानार्थं तोयस्य समुपस्थितान्.. 39 ..
5.113.m: And at the time of offering water, he spoke to all the serpents, / to all the nāgas who had assembled to offer water:

5.113.s:
nāhaṃ toyaṃ pradāsyāmi svaputrasya kathaṃcana ..
bhavadbhiḥ prerito'pyevaṃ tathānyairapi bāṃdhavaiḥ .. 6.114.40 ..
5.113.d:
नाहं तोयं प्रदास्यामि स्वपुत्रस्य कथंचन ..
भवद्भिः प्रेरितोऽप्येवं तथान्यैरपि बांधवैः .. 6.114.40 ..
5.113.m: 'I shall not offer water for my own son in any way, / even though urged by you and by other kinsmen,

5.113.s:
yāvattasya na duṣṭasya mama putrāṃtakāriṇaḥ ..
sadāraputrabhṛtyasya vihito na parikṣayaḥ .. 41 ..
5.113.d:
यावत्तस्य न दुष्टस्य मम पुत्रांतकारिणः ..
सदारपुत्रभृत्यस्य विहितो न परिक्षयः .. 41 ..
5.113.m: until complete destruction is wrought upon that wicked one / who caused my son's death, along with his wife, sons, and servants.'

5.113.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ śeṣaḥ śodhayāmāsa taṃ dvijam ..
yena saṃsūditaḥ putro daṃḍakāṣṭhena pāpmanā .. 42 ..
5.113.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः शेषः शोधयामास तं द्विजम् ..
येन संसूदितः पुत्रो दंडकाष्ठेन पाप्मना .. 42 ..
5.113.m: Having spoken thus, Śeṣa then sought out that brahmin / by whom, the sinner, his son had been slaughtered with a wooden stick.

5.113.s:
tataḥ provāca tānnāgānpārśvasthānpannagādhipaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yāṃtu me suhṛduttamāḥ .. 43 ..
5.113.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तान्नागान्पार्श्वस्थान्पन्नगाधिपः ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यांतु मे सुहृदुत्तमाः .. 43 ..
5.113.m: Then the lord of snakes said to the serpents standing beside him: / 'Let my excellent friends go to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.113.s:
putraghnaṃ taṃ nihatyā''śu sakuṭumbaparigraham..
camatkārapuraṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣaṇīyaṃ tataḥ param .. 44 ..
5.113.d:
पुत्रघ्नं तं निहत्या'ऽशु सकुटुम्बपरिग्रहम्..
चमत्कारपुरं सर्वं भक्षणीयं ततः परम् .. 44 ..
5.113.m: Quickly slay the killer of my son along with his family and dependents; / after that, the whole of Camatkārapura must be devoured!

5.113.s:
tatraiva vasatiḥ kāryā samastaiḥ pannagottamaiḥ ..
yathā bhūyo vasennaiva tathā kāryaṃ ca tatpuram .. 45 ..
5.113.d:
तत्रैव वसतिः कार्या समस्तैः पन्नगोत्तमैः ..
यथा भूयो वसेन्नैव तथा कार्यं च तत्पुरम् .. 45 ..
5.113.m: All the best of snakes must take up residence right there; / and that town must be made such that no one may ever dwell there again.'

5.113.s:
evamuktāstatastena nāgāḥ prādhānyataḥ śrutāḥ ..
gatvātha satvaraṃ tatra prathamaṃ taṃ dvijottamam .. 46 ..
5.113.d:
एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन नागाः प्राधान्यतः श्रुताः ..
गत्वाथ सत्वरं तत्र प्रथमं तं द्विजोत्तमम् .. 46 ..
5.113.m: Having been spoken to thus by him, the chief serpents, having heard [his order], / went quickly there and first [killed] that excellent brahmin,

5.113.s:
devarātasutaṃ suptaṃ bhakṣayitvā tataḥ param ..
tatkuṭuṃbaṃ samagraṃ ca krodhena mahatānvitāḥ .. 47 ..
5.113.d:
देवरातसुतं सुप्तं भक्षयित्वा ततः परम् ..
तत्कुटुंबं समग्रं च क्रोधेन महतान्विताः .. 47 ..
5.113.m: devouring the son of Devarāta while he was asleep, and after that, / his entire family, filled with great fury.

5.113.s:
tato'nyānapi saṃkruddhā bālānvṛddhānkumārakān ..
bhakṣayāmāsuḥ sarve te tiryagyonigatā api .. 48 ..
5.113.d:
ततोऽन्यानपि संक्रुद्धा बालान्वृद्धान्कुमारकान् ..
भक्षयामासुः सर्वे ते तिर्यग्योनिगता अपि .. 48 ..
5.113.m: Then, enraged, they devoured others too—children, the old, and young boys; / all of them [devoured] even those born in animal wombs.

5.113.s:
etasminnaṃtare jātaḥ pure tatra sudāruṇaḥ ..
ākraṃdo brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ sarpabhakṣaṇasaṃbhavaḥ .. 49 ..
5.113.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे जातः पुरे तत्र सुदारुणः ..
आक्रंदो ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां सर्पभक्षणसंभवः .. 49 ..
5.113.m: Meanwhile, in that town, a dreadful outcry / of the foremost brahmins arose, born of the devouring by serpents.

5.113.s:
tatra bhūmau tathā'nyacca yatkiṃcidapi dṛśyate ..
tatsarvaṃ pannagairvyāptaṃ raudraiḥ kṛṣṇavapurdharaiḥ .. 6.114.50 ..
5.113.d:
तत्र भूमौ तथाऽन्यच्च यत्किंचिदपि दृश्यते ..
तत्सर्वं पन्नगैर्व्याप्तं रौद्रैः कृष्णवपुर्धरैः .. 6.114.50 ..
5.113.m: On the ground there and wherever anything was seen, / all of that was overrun by serpents, terrifying and black-bodied.

5.113.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kecinmṛtyuvaśaṃ gatāḥ ..
viṣasaṃ ghūrṇitāḥ kecitpatitā dharaṇītale .. 51 ..
5.113.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः केचिन्मृत्युवशं गताः ..
विषसं घूर्णिताः केचित्पतिता धरणीतले .. 51 ..
5.113.m: In the meantime, some succumbed to death; / others, reeling from poison, collapsed onto the surface of the earth.

5.113.s:
anye gṛhādikaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya sutādi ca ..
vitrastāḥ paridhāvaṃti vanamuddiśya dūrataḥ .. 52 ..
5.113.d:
अन्ये गृहादिकं सर्वं परित्यज्य सुतादि च ..
वित्रस्ताः परिधावंति वनमुद्दिश्य दूरतः .. 52 ..
5.113.m: Others, abandoning house and all, sons and the rest, / terrified, ran afar toward the forest.

5.113.s:
anye maṃtravido viprāḥ prayataṃte samaṃtataḥ ..
maṃdaṃ dhāvaṃti saṃtrastā gṛhītvauṣadhayaḥ pare .. 53 ..
5.113.d:
अन्ये मंत्रविदो विप्राः प्रयतंते समंततः ..
मंदं धावंति संत्रस्ता गृहीत्वौषधयः परे .. 53 ..
5.113.m: Other brahmins, knowers of mantras, strove on all sides; / still others, carrying herbs, ran slowly, terrified.

5.113.s:
evaṃ tatpuramuddiśya sarve te pannagottamāḥ ..
pracaraṃti yathā kaścinna tatra brāhmaṇo vaset .. 54 ..
5.113.d:
एवं तत्पुरमुद्दिश्य सर्वे ते पन्नगोत्तमाः ..
प्रचरंति यथा कश्चिन्न तत्र ब्राह्मणो वसेत् .. 54 ..
5.113.m: Thus, directed against that town, all those best of snakes / moved about so that no brahmin might dwell there.

5.113.s:
atha śūnyaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā sarve te pannagottamāḥ ..
vyacaransvecchayā tatra tīrtheṣvāyataneṣu ca .. 55 ..
5.113.d:
अथ शून्यं पुरं कृत्वा सर्वे ते पन्नगोत्तमाः ..
व्यचरन्स्वेच्छया तत्र तीर्थेष्वायतनेषु च .. 55 ..
5.113.m: Then, having depopulated the town, all those best of snakes / ranged at will there, in sacred fords and temples.

5.113.s:
na kaścitpannagaḥ kṣetrāttyaktvā niryāti bāhyataḥ ..
praviśenna paraḥ kaścittatra kṣetre ca mānavaḥ .. 56 ..
5.113.d:
न कश्चित्पन्नगः क्षेत्रात्त्यक्त्वा निर्याति बाह्यतः ..
प्रविशेन्न परः कश्चित्तत्र क्षेत्रे च मानवः .. 56 ..
5.113.m: No snake leaves the sacred field to go outside, / nor does any other human enter that sacred field.

5.113.s:
vyavasthaivaṃ samudbhūtā sarpāṇāṃ mānuṣaiḥ saha .
vadhabhakṣaṇajā nyonyaṃ bāhyābhyaṃtarasaṃbhavā .. 57 ..
5.113.d:
व्यवस्थैवं समुद्भूता सर्पाणां मानुषैः सह .
वधभक्षणजा न्योन्यं बाह्याभ्यंतरसंभवा .. 57 ..
5.113.m: Thus arose this mutual arrangement between serpents and humans, / arising from killing and devouring, across the outside and inside.

5.113.s:
etasminnaṃtare śeṣo muktvā duḥkhaṃ sutodbhavam ..
prahṛṣṭaḥ pradadau toyaṃ tasya jātibhiranvitaḥ .. 58 ..
5.113.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शेषो मुक्त्वा दुःखं सुतोद्भवम् ..
प्रहृष्टः प्रददौ तोयं तस्य जातिभिरन्वितः .. 58 ..
5.113.m: In the meantime, Śeṣa, casting aside his sorrow born of his son, / rejoiced and gave water [libation], accompanied by his kinsmen.

5.113.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ kecitsarpebhyo bhayavihvalāḥ ..
saśokā diṅmukhānyāśu te sarve saṃgatā mithaḥ ..59..
5.113.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः केचित्सर्पेभ्यो भयविह्वलाः ..
सशोका दिङ्मुखान्याशु ते सर्वे संगता मिथः ..59..
5.113.m: Then some of those brahmins, agitated with fear of the serpents, / full of grief, swiftly gathered together, facing all directions.

5.113.s:
tato vanaṃ samājagmustrijāto yatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
haralabdhavaro hṛṣṭaḥ sumahattapasi sthitaḥ .. 6.114.60 ..
5.113.d:
ततो वनं समाजग्मुस्त्रिजातो यत्र संस्थितः ..
हरलब्धवरो हृष्टः सुमहत्तपसि स्थितः .. 6.114.60 ..
5.113.m: Then they came to the forest where Trijāta was staying, / who had obtained a boon from Hara, was joyful, and was established in great austerity.

5.113.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā tāñjanānsarvāṃstathā duḥkhapariplutān ..
putradārādikaṃ smṛtvā rudataḥ karuṇaṃ bahu .. 61 ..
5.113.d:
स दृष्ट्वा ताञ्जनान्सर्वांस्तथा दुःखपरिप्लुतान् ..
पुत्रदारादिकं स्मृत्वा रुदतः करुणं बहु .. 61 ..
5.113.m: Seeing all those people thus overwhelmed by sorrow, / weeping copiously and piteously as they remembered their sons, wives, and others,

5.113.s:
so'pi duḥkhasamāyukto dṛṣṭvā tānsvapurodbhavān ..
brāhmaṇeṃdrāṃstataḥ prāha bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ .. 62 ..
5.113.d:
सोऽपि दुःखसमायुक्तो दृष्ट्वा तान्स्वपुरोद्भवान् ..
ब्राह्मणेंद्रांस्ततः प्राह बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः .. 62 ..
5.113.m: he too was filled with sorrow upon seeing those born in his own city; / then, his eyes troubled with tears, he spoke to the best of brahmins:

5.113.s:
śṛṇvaṃtu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vacanaṃ mama sāṃpratam ..
mayā vinirgatenaiva tatpurāttoṣito haraḥ .. 63 ..
5.113.d:
शृण्वंतु ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे वचनं मम सांप्रतम् ..
मया विनिर्गतेनैव तत्पुरात्तोषितो हरः .. 63 ..
5.113.m: “Let all the brahmins listen to my words now: / by me, upon leaving that city, Hara was propitiated.

5.113.s:
tena mahyaṃ varo datto vāṃchito dvijasattamāḥ ..
gṛhīto na mayādyāpi prārthayiṣyāmi sāṃpratam ..64..
5.113.d:
तेन मह्यं वरो दत्तो वांछितो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
गृहीतो न मयाद्यापि प्रार्थयिष्यामि सांप्रतम् ..64..
5.113.m: By him a desired boon was granted to me, O best of the twice-born; / it has not been taken by me even today; I shall request it now,

5.113.s:
yathā syātsaṃkṣayasteṣāṃ nāgānāṃ sudurātmanām ..
yaiḥ kṛtaṃ naḥ puraṃ kṛtsnamudrasaṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ .. 65 ..
5.113.d:
यथा स्यात्संक्षयस्तेषां नागानां सुदुरात्मनाम् ..
यैः कृतं नः पुरं कृत्स्नमुद्रसं पापकर्मभिः .. 65 ..
5.113.m: so that there may be the destruction of those extremely wicked nāgas / by whose sinful deeds our whole city has been ruined.”

5.113.s:
evamuktvā'tha vipraḥ sa trijātaḥ parameśvaram ..
prārthayāmāsa me deva taṃ varaṃ yaccha sāṃpratam ..66..
5.113.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ विप्रः स त्रिजातः परमेश्वरम् ..
प्रार्थयामास मे देव तं वरं यच्छ सांप्रतम् ..66..
5.113.m: Having spoken thus, that brahmin Trijāta requested the Supreme Lord: / “O God, grant me that boon now.”

5.113.s:
tataḥ provāca deveśaḥ prārthayasva drutaṃ dvija..
yenābhīṣṭaṃ prayacchāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 67 .. ..
5.113.d:
ततः प्रोवाच देवेशः प्रार्थयस्व द्रुतं द्विज..
येनाभीष्टं प्रयच्छामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 67 .. ..
5.113.m: Then the Lord of gods said: “Quickly ask, O twice-born, / so that I may grant the desired [boon], even if it should be exceedingly difficult to obtain.”

5.113.s:
.. trijāta uvāca .. ..
nāgairasmatpuraṃ kṛtsnaṃ kṛtaṃ janavivarjitam ..
tattasmātte kṣayaṃ yāṃtu sarve vṛṣabhavāhana .. 68 ..
5.113.d:
.. त्रिजात उवाच .. ..
नागैरस्मत्पुरं कृत्स्नं कृतं जनविवर्जितम् ..
तत्तस्मात्ते क्षयं यांतु सर्वे वृषभवाहन .. 68 ..
5.113.m: Trijāta said: / “Our whole city has been rendered devoid of people by the nāgas; / therefore let them all go to destruction, O rider of the bull,

5.113.s:
yena tatpūryate viprairbhūyo'pi surasattama ..
mamāpi jāyate kīrtiḥ svasthānoddharaṇodbhavā .. 69 ..
5.113.d:
येन तत्पूर्यते विप्रैर्भूयोऽपि सुरसत्तम ..
ममापि जायते कीर्तिः स्वस्थानोद्धरणोद्भवा .. 69 ..
5.113.m: so that it may be filled with brahmins once again, O best of gods, / and that fame arising from delivering my own abode may also accrue to me.”

5.113.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
nāyuktaṃ vihitaṃ vipra pannagaistairmahātmabhiḥ ..
nirdoṣaścāpi putro'tra yeṣāṃ vipreṇa sūditaḥ .. 6.114.70 ..
5.113.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
नायुक्तं विहितं विप्र पन्नगैस्तैर्महात्मभिः ..
निर्दोषश्चापि पुत्रोऽत्र येषां विप्रेण सूदितः .. 6.114.70 ..
5.113.m: The Lord said: / “Nothing improper was done, O brahmin, by those noble serpents / whose blameless son was slain here by a brahmin,

5.113.s:
viśeṣeṇa dvijaśreṣṭha saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..
tatrā'pi śrāvaṇe māsi pūjyaṃte yatra pannagāḥ .. 71 ..
5.113.d:
विशेषेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..
तत्राऽपि श्रावणे मासि पूज्यंते यत्र पन्नगाः .. 71 ..
5.113.m: especially, O best of the twice-born, when the fifth day [of the lunar fortnight] had arrived, / and that too in the month of Śrāvaṇa, when serpents are worshipped.

5.113.s:
tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhamaṃtramanuttamam ..
yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa sarppāṇāṃ naśyate viṣam .. 72 ..
5.113.d:
तस्मात्तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सिद्धमंत्रमनुत्तमम् ..
यस्योच्चारणमात्रेण सर्प्पाणां नश्यते विषम् .. 72 ..
5.113.m: Therefore, I shall tell you an infallible, unsurpassable mantra, / merely by the recitation of which the poison of serpents is destroyed.

5.113.s:
taṃ maṃtraṃ tatra gatvā tvaṃ tadviprairakhilairvṛtaḥ ..
śrāvayasva mahābhāga tāraśabdena sarvaśaḥ ..73..
5.113.d:
तं मंत्रं तत्र गत्वा त्वं तद्विप्रैरखिलैर्वृतः ..
श्रावयस्व महाभाग तारशब्देन सर्वशः ..73..
5.113.m: Having gone there surrounded by all those brahmins, / recite that mantra, O fortunate one, in a loud voice everywhere.

5.113.s:
taṃ śrutvā ye na yāsyaṃti pātālaṃ pannagādhamāḥ ..
yuṣmadvākyādbhaviṣyaṃti nirviṣāste na saṃśayaḥ .. 74 .. ..
5.113.d:
तं श्रुत्वा ये न यास्यंति पातालं पन्नगाधमाः ..
युष्मद्वाक्याद्भविष्यंति निर्विषास्ते न संशयः .. 74 .. ..
5.113.m: Those vilest of serpents who, having heard it, do not go to Pātāla, / will become venomless on your word; of this there is no doubt.”

5.113.s:
.. trijāta uvāca .. ..
brūhi taṃ me mahāmaṃtraṃ sarvatīkṣṇavināśanam ..
yena gatvā nijaṃ sthānaṃ sarpānutsādayāmyaham ..75..
5.113.d:
.. त्रिजात उवाच .. ..
ब्रूहि तं मे महामंत्रं सर्वतीक्ष्णविनाशनम् ..
येन गत्वा निजं स्थानं सर्पानुत्सादयाम्यहम् ..75..
5.113.m: Trijāta said: / “Tell me that great mantra which destroys all virulent [poisons], / by which I, having gone to my own place, may eradicate the serpents.”

5.113.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
garaṃ viṣamiti proktaṃ na tatrāsti ca sāṃpratam ..
matprasādāttvayā hyetaduccāryaṃ brāhmaṇottama .. 76
5.113.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
गरं विषमिति प्रोक्तं न तत्रास्ति च सांप्रतम् ..
मत्प्रसादात्त्वया ह्येतदुच्चार्यं ब्राह्मणोत्तम .. 76
5.113.m: The Lord said: / “Gara is called poison; and it is not there now. / By my grace, this is to be uttered by you, O best of brahmins:

5.113.s:
na garaṃ na garaṃ caitacchrutvā ye pannagādhamāḥ..
tatra sthāsyaṃti te vadhyā bhaviṣyaṃti yathāsukham .. 77 ..
5.113.d:
न गरं न गरं चैतच्छ्रुत्वा ये पन्नगाधमाः..
तत्र स्थास्यंति ते वध्या भविष्यंति यथासुखम् .. 77 ..
5.113.m: ‘Na garaṃ, na garaṃ!’ [‘No poison, no poison!’] And hearing this, whichever vilest serpents / remain there, they can be killed at will.

5.113.s:
adyaprabhṛti tatsthānaṃ nagarākhyaṃ dharātale ..
bhaviṣyati suvikhyātaṃ tava kīrtivivardhanam .. 78 ..
5.113.d:
अद्यप्रभृति तत्स्थानं नगराख्यं धरातले ..
भविष्यति सुविख्यातं तव कीर्तिविवर्धनम् .. 78 ..
5.113.m: From this day forward, that place will become widely renowned / on the surface of the earth by the name ‘Nagara’, increasing your fame.

5.113.s:
tathānyopi ca yo vipro nāgaraḥ śuddhavaṃśajaḥ ..
nagarākhyena maṃtreṇa abhimaṃtrya tridhā jalam .. 79 ..
5.113.d:
तथान्योपि च यो विप्रो नागरः शुद्धवंशजः ..
नगराख्येन मंत्रेण अभिमंत्र्य त्रिधा जलम् .. 79 ..
5.113.m: Likewise, whatever other Nāgara brahmin born of a pure lineage, / having consecrated water three times with the mantra named Nagara,

5.113.s:
prāṇinaṃ kāla saṃdaṣṭamapi mṛtyuvaśaṃgatam ..
prakariṣyati jīvāḍhyaṃ prakṣipya vadane svayam ..6.114.80...
5.113.d:
प्राणिनं काल संदष्टमपि मृत्युवशंगतम् ..
प्रकरिष्यति जीवाढ्यं प्रक्षिप्य वदने स्वयम् ..6.114.80...
5.113.m: shall pour it himself into the mouth of a living being bitten by death / and even fallen into the power of death, will restore him to life.

5.113.s:
anyatrāpi sthito martyo maṃtrametaṃ trirakṣaram ..
yaḥ smariṣyati saṃsupto na hiṃsyaḥ syādaherhi saḥ ..81...
5.113.d:
अन्यत्रापि स्थितो मर्त्यो मंत्रमेतं त्रिरक्षरम् ..
यः स्मरिष्यति संसुप्तो न हिंस्यः स्यादहेर्हि सः ..81...
5.113.m: Even a mortal staying elsewhere who, when asleep, / remembers this three-syllable mantra, shall not be harmed by a serpent.

5.113.s:
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vāpi kṛtrimaṃ vā garaṃ hi tat ..
tadanena ca maṃtreṇa saṃspṛṣṭaṃ tvamṛtāyitam ..82..
5.113.d:
स्थावरं जंगमं वापि कृत्रिमं वा गरं हि तत् ..
तदनेन च मंत्रेण संस्पृष्टं त्वमृतायितम् ..82..
5.113.m: Whether mineral, vegetable, animal, or artificial, that poison / touched by this mantra indeed turns into nectar.

5.113.s:
ajīrṇaprabhavā rogā ye cānye jaṭharodbhavāḥ..
maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvena sarve yāṃti drutaṃ kṣayam ..83..
5.113.d:
अजीर्णप्रभवा रोगा ये चान्ये जठरोद्भवाः..
मंत्रस्यास्य प्रभावेन सर्वे यांति द्रुतं क्षयम् ..83..
5.113.m: Diseases arising from indigestion and whatever other ailments originate in the belly, / all quickly go to destruction through the power of this mantra.”

5.113.s:
evamuktvā'tha taṃ vipraṃ bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
jagāmādarśanaṃ paścādyathā dīpo vitailakaḥ ..84..
5.113.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ तं विप्रं भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
जगामादर्शनं पश्चाद्यथा दीपो वितैलकः ..84..
5.113.m: Having spoken thus to that brahmin, the Lord whose banner is the bull / then vanished, just like a lamp without oil.

5.113.s:
trijāto'pi samaṃ viprairhataśeṣaistu tairdrutam ..
jagāma saṃprahṛṣṭātmā camatkārapuraṃ prati .. 85 ..
5.113.d:
त्रिजातोऽपि समं विप्रैर्हतशेषैस्तु तैर्द्रुतम् ..
जगाम संप्रहृष्टात्मा चमत्कारपुरं प्रति .. 85 ..
5.113.m: Trijāta, too, with a joyful mind, went quickly towards Camatkārapura / along with those brahmins who had survived the slaughter.

5.113.s:
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve trijātena samanvitāḥ ..
na garaṃ na garaṃ proccairuccaraṃtaḥ samāyayuḥ .. 86 ..
5.113.d:
एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे त्रिजातेन समन्विताः ..
न गरं न गरं प्रोच्चैरुच्चरंतः समाययुः .. 86 ..
5.113.m: Thus all those brahmins, accompanied by Trijāta, / arrived, loudly chanting: “Na garaṃ, na garaṃ!”

5.113.s:
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ yattadvyāptaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
raudrairāśīviṣaiḥ krūraiḥ śeṣasyādeśamāśriteḥ ..87..
5.113.d:
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं यत्तद्व्याप्तं समंततः ..
रौद्रैराशीविषैः क्रूरैः शेषस्यादेशमाश्रितेः ..87..
5.113.m: That sacred field belonging to Hāṭakeśvara was completely overrun / by terrible, cruel venomous snakes who followed the order of Śeṣa.

5.113.s:
atha te pannagāḥ śrutvā siddhamaṃtra śivodbhavam ..
nirviṣāstejasā hīnāḥ samantātte pradudravuḥ ..88..
5.113.d:
अथ ते पन्नगाः श्रुत्वा सिद्धमंत्र शिवोद्भवम् ..
निर्विषास्तेजसा हीनाः समन्तात्ते प्रदुद्रवुः ..88..
5.113.m: Then those serpents, hearing the accomplished mantra born of Śiva, / became venomless and devoid of energy, and fled in all directions.

5.113.s:
valmīkānkecidāsādya citraraṃdhrāṃtarodbhavān ..
anye cāpi prajagmuśca pātālaṃ daṃdaśūkakāḥ .. 89 ..
5.113.d:
वल्मीकान्केचिदासाद्य चित्ररंध्रांतरोद्भवान् ..
अन्ये चापि प्रजग्मुश्च पातालं दंदशूककाः .. 89 ..
5.113.m: Some of the biting snakes retreated to ant-hills situated among various holes, / while others departed for Pātāla.

5.113.s:
ye kecidbhayasaṃtrastā vārddhakyena nipīḍitāḥ ..
vālatvena tathā cānye śaknuvaṃti na sarpitum .. 6.114.90 ..
5.113.d:
ये केचिद्भयसंत्रस्ता वार्द्धक्येन निपीडिताः ..
वालत्वेन तथा चान्ये शक्नुवंति न सर्पितुम् .. 6.114.90 ..
5.113.m: Certain ones, terrified with fear, afflicted by old age, / or others because of infancy, were unable to slither away.

5.113.s:
te sarve brāhmaṇendraistaiḥ kṛtasya pratikārakaiḥ ..
nihatāḥ pannagāstatra daṃḍakāṣṭhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 91 ..
5.113.d:
ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणेन्द्रैस्तैः कृतस्य प्रतिकारकैः ..
निहताः पन्नगास्तत्र दंडकाष्ठैः सहस्रशः .. 91 ..
5.113.m: All those serpents, in their thousands, were slain there with wooden sticks / by those best of brahmins, who retaliated for what had been done.

5.113.s:
evamutsādya tānsarvānbrāhmaṇāste gatavyathāḥ .
taṃ trijātaṃ puraskṛtya sthānakṛtyāni cakrire .. 92 ..
5.113.d:
एवमुत्साद्य तान्सर्वान्ब्राह्मणास्ते गतव्यथाः .
तं त्रिजातं पुरस्कृत्य स्थानकृत्यानि चक्रिरे .. 92 ..
5.113.m: Having thus eradicated them all, those brahmins, freed from distress, / placed Trijāta at their head and performed the duties of their settlement.

5.113.s:
evaṃ tannagaraṃ jātamasmātkālādanaṃtaram ..
devadevasya bhargasya prasādena dvijottamāḥ .. 93 ..
5.113.d:
एवं तन्नगरं जातमस्मात्कालादनंतरम् ..
देवदेवस्य भर्गस्य प्रसादेन द्विजोत्तमाः .. 93 ..
5.113.m: Thus from that time onward that city came into being, / by the grace of Bharga, the god of gods, O best of the twice-born.

5.113.s:
etadyaḥ paṭhate nityamākhyānaṃ nagarodbhavam ..
na tasya sarpajaṃ kvāpi kathaṃcijjāyate bhayam . 94 ..
5.113.d:
एतद्यः पठते नित्यमाख्यानं नगरोद्भवम् ..
न तस्य सर्पजं क्वापि कथंचिज्जायते भयम् . 94 ..
5.113.m: Whoever constantly recites this narrative concerning the origin of Nagara, / for him no fear arising from serpents arises anywhere or in any way.

5.113.s: iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nagarasaṃjñotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 114 ..
5.113.d: इति श्रीस्कादे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नगरसंज्ञोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 114 ..
5.113.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, named “Description of the Origin of the Name Nagara”, in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
